source_doc: Buy them! I bought these 20 inch extensions about 3 years ago and they are still in such great shape. I dyed to match my hair, I hardly style them, I like the natural curl in them, it matches my own hair texture. Just ordered the 14 inch which is still about an inch longer than my real hair since my real hair is extremely fine and thin. That will give me a naturally voluminous look. These are super soft, curl, straighten and color with ease. For the price of $100 I can look like I spent $500 on tape ins at the salon. And I can reuse far past the 3 month mark on my tape ins. I will also say being a person with incredibly fine/thin hair, I have tried all types of hair pieces, weaves, ponytails, wigs, you name it. And my scalp is very tender. I can wear the full set of the 20 inches for 8 hrs with no headache. Not heavy at all. I can't wait to get my new 14 inch ones colored and in rotation. Love this company! Wish they made ponytail pieces and lace fronts too because the hair is SO nice for the price! Minimal shedding and minimal tangling. Buy it!!!

source_doc: So disappointed. I am really disappointed. I contacted customer service because the vegan leather on my bag is pealing after just a few months of use. The best they can do is nothing? They said I must be rubbing it on rough surfaces. I am not rubbing or bumping it on rough surfaces. I have had another Itzy Ritzy bag and used it the exact same way and it has very little wear and tear on it after years of use. It was also vegan leather. The surface of the vegan leather is just peeling in places where there is not much friction. I am careful to take good care of my bags. I have really enjoyed being an Itzy Ritzy customer. As a mom of 7, I have carried their bags for years as well as used many other products including toys and pacifiers. I also recommend the brand because of the quality, however I have sadly learned that the customer care is lacking. For an item to peel like this is unacceptable and not normal wear and tear. I guess their quality standards have lowered as well, previous bags did not do this. If they will only stand by products purchased directly from their website and not other merchants such as Amazon, what is the point of selling there? I will no longer purchase or recommend Itzy Ritzy.

source_doc: Excellent guitar for beginner intermediate, minimal setup was required. The guitars fit and finish was perfect.  The fret ends were polished and smooth, the action was fine, there were no blemishes.  Upon tuning the guitar, I noticed the intonation was slightly off. Upon further examination, I found the one “holiday” , the setup man went on.  The bridge was pulling up, when the guitar was tuned.  I took off the back plate, the tension screws were tensioned too loosely and unevenly.  Two minutes I had it sorted, and this fixed the intonation.  I have included a picture of my practice setup. It included a Pock Rock, headphone amp, and effects processor(approx 40 bucks on Amazon), an old Fire tablet I had lying around, hooked into the line in, on the Pock Rock, and a pair of Vintage Sansui head phones.  I have a behringer ppa200(also available on Amazon approx 350 on Amazon), that I also use for my karaoke/movie night, senior charity,when I want to Amp the setup(also through the Pock Rock).  I know quite a few chords, but haven’t played in years.  Even though my next door neighbor says I’m not loud, and don’t bother her, the majority of time, I play with the headphones.  This little setup, is loads of fun, and I’m really enjoying it.

source_doc: EXCEEDS EXPECTATIONS. A friend suggested I purchase this pair of hand warmers before a ski trip I had planned with my family. In the past, I would typically buy disposable single-use "pouch" style hand warmers but wanted something that was reusable and would last longer. Boy was I impressed with these. As I was putting on all my ski equipment, I fired these up and put them in my boots. When I was ready to put my boots on, they were already nice and toasty so I moved the warmers to my jacket pockets and zipped them closed. Once I went outside the lodge into the cold, I put my hands in my pockets and they were nice and warm. I had the warmers on the lowest setting and they kept my pockets warm all day. It was great to take my gloves off on the chair lift, stick my hands in my pockets before each run, and it made the day a much better experience overall. I highly recommend these if you're a skiier, hiker, go to an outdoor sporting event, etc.!

source_doc: Excellent mid-size carrying case. The reason I got this case for my Steam Deck is I wasn't happy with the velcro on the JSAUX case and had a couple other issues with it where I didn't feel like my deck was properly secured. This fella however solves all those issues. First, this case is a LOT bigger than the JSAUX case, the top is as wide as the bottom. There's a massive top pocket that you could shove a small Nintendo Switch carrying case into but otherwise it's perfect for batteries, controllers, docks, etc. I really wasn't expecting it to be that spacious! The bottom compartment isn't quite as big as the JSAUX one but I was able to cut out a slot for my charging brick using a boxcutter so no big deal, the interior material cut very easily. The protection for this felt wayyy better than the JSAUX case. The straps are excellent and the velcro is very good. The interior is also a bit padded which feels nice. It has microsd storage slots as well as fullsize SD storage slots. I was worried about the microSD's falling out so I kept them in their SD adapters anyways. The only feature I couldn't quite get working was the kickstand strap so I just shoved that down in the bottom and put a different kickstand in the top storage so I have one if I ever need it.

They were very easy to put together, and they are very sturdy because two of my cats are pretty big and pretty sturdy! If I get any of the cats to stay on the hammock, when I have my phone out, then I will indeed take a picture and add the picture at a later date! I’m very happy with this product and I do believe my three cats plus the one that I’m babysitting is very happy with these hammocks! I was very surprised when I open the box and seen that there was two hammocks. I just assumed that was only one. They’re fantastic and again I’m very pleased with them. Thank you for letting me review these hammocks.

source_doc: Not the Quality I Was Expecting. Typically I love JRPG's. The ones published by Square Enix have often become some of my favorite games so I was surprised to find myself having trouble getting into this one. First off, I felt the player movement was too slow and to me it seemed pretty laggy on my PS4. I didn't feel any sense of flow in the movement or the battles and found this to be one of the few non first person games to give me motion sickness which greatly influenced my negative opinion of the game. The battles weren't anything super complicated which usually I would enjoy as I like to just enjoy the story on my first playthrough of a game. Unfortunately there was keeping me hooked on the story so I didn't feel the need to continue forcing myself to play hoping at least that would be worth it in the end. I also found the world itself didn't feel worth exploring as I wasn't finding anything notable in the treasure chests or making interesting discoveries along the way so I will admit I have not finished the game. If it were to get updated at some point I would consider trying to play again, but as of right now I don't feel it's worth playing.

I even heard my controllers click into place. I never did get them to charge but the headset charges fine so I think my product may have been defective.

source_doc: Auto headrest tablet and hat holder that works OK with an additional installation step. I had a bit of trouble installing this. Rotating the knob behind the tablet holder is not as easy as they make it sound in the instructions. I couldn't get it tight enough to keep my 11" iPad Pro from drooping, so I thought I had it cross threaded. Through my efforts to tighten it by hand, I broke the knob. I glued and tried again the next day, but this time I used a pipe wrench to grip the knob while hand turning the tablet holder, which worked well enough so that now the tablet does not droop so easily. It's probably best for use with cellphones or lighter tablets.I love the hat holder feature. I keep large brim hats in the van to protect against the sun when going out for walks. Before I installed this holder, I was constantly moving the hats around in the van because I didn't have a good permanent place for them. As seen in the photo, I have two hats in the hat holder, the one in the back is hanging by it's chin strap.I wish I could use the nicely collapsible tray AND the hat holder but one is forced to choose between them.Now that it's installed and working, I'm happy to have this auto tablet and hat holder.

source_doc: Nearly useless. After receiving these, but prior to using them, I left a raving review, but now they are nearly useless. I followed the instructions for washing them, which I did, of course, before planning to use them. I placed the lids in the top rack of my dish washer, and when the cycle finished I TRIED to secure the lids onto the bowls. I was able to snap shut only one or two of the four sides in place. The only bowl that I was able to fully secure the lid onto was the smallest. Granted, I have arthritis in my hands, but never have I had this issue with a set like this from another manufacturer. So, here I am with bowls without the advantage of a proper lid. Again, this is the only set of bowls with snapping lids that has not worked out for me. I absolutely do NOT recommend this product. I left a previous glowing review, but that was prior to washing this set and attempting to secure the lids to the bowls.

source_doc: THE MEASUREMENTS/SIZE GIVEN ARE NOT CORRECT but a nice cover for the price. I purchase alot of car covers.  I usually purchase Budge because they are economical for what I need them for.  This review is not against the seller but the mfg.  I followed directions and measure this car from front to back, I also went online to confirm the length....204" or 17'.  I ordered 2 covers that the mfg states are 228' or 19" for extra caveats to the car itself.  Mind you I know this is a universal fit, the fit overall for a sedan is fine, however, this cover is not 19' long so I am very disappointed.  I cannot return because it was such a tight fit a small corner ripped.  I also used this cover on another car of same dimensions, it did not fit.  This is a lightweight cover which I knew that is fine.  Not happy spending $64+ dollars for something that didn't cover 100%.  Again, not made at the seller, just the mfg and to let people know that Budge misrepresents the measurements.  This is the first time this has happened to me on their covers.

source_doc: Great aftermarket upgrade for you Sony Pulse headset. I decided to try these replacement earpads because I often found the factory pads getting too warm on my head, and they weren't exactly the most comfortable.  These new pads are noticeably cooler and are a decent improvement in comfort as well.  I really like them!I found the process of replacing the earpads to be a pain.  Taking the earpads off is simple, but for whatever reason I couldn't get two of the clips to snap into place, so there was a gap, which I knew wasn't right.  I didn't want to break anything either, as I thought I was pressing too hard already.  After failing to snap them in place I found the factory ones didn't want to go back on either.  So then I knew it wasn't the fault of these earpads, but the design of the headset.  Turns out you have to use more force than you are comfortable with to snap two of the clips of the earpads onto the headset.All turned out well, but man I really thought I was going to snap some plastic while installing the earpads.  Again, not the fault of these pads.  I love these and would recommend them to anyone.

source_doc: Works great on my long haired Maine Coon. I have a Maine Coon cat with really long hair. This comb really helps pull the loose hair out of his coat. I use it about once a week on him and I am always shocked at how much hair I get, between a golf ball size to tennis ball sized clump of hair when I am done. You would think after pulling up that much hair that he would be thinned out, but every week there is more. I think it really helps with the fur ball problem because I don't hear him trying to cough up the fur balls as much since I started using this every week. You just have to go slow, don't pull to hard, and if it starts to have resistance just pull up away from the body. Just watch if he likes it or not, if he is purring I good to go but if I start getting the look and the wagging tail I had better slowdown or back off. He is 24 pound cat that you want to treat right. Afterwards I give him some freeze dried chicken as a treat and he is very happy with me. I like this comb, very happy with it, best out of the five I had prior to this one.

source_doc: I love everything about this, except for the price. I'm 32, acne prone, with combination skin (oily tzone, but dry around my chin). I don't use social media at all, but I am in Korea and my family gifted me some of this. I've been here a month and just finished a stick of it (well there's a bit more, but it's at the bottom and I can no longer glide it over my face). I did not apply it sparingly, used it most days and most evenings as I had forgotten my normal moisturizer. I found that sometimes I'd feel a pimple coming on and I think it actually helped it heal much faster. I haven't noticed wrinkle reduction, but my skin feels healthier and brighter. I tried slugging over it with CeraVe healing ointment, but that's too heavy together, unnecessary. I really like the scent and the packaging, I think I will repurchase, but if you're looking for wrinkle reduction - microneedling and/or retinol products will be more affective. This would be a nice product to alternate when not using retinol.

I took a chance on these because there wasn't a lot of reviews at the time so I felt like leaving one myself will definitely help. These diapers are great for the price point, and I actually prefer this shape of wet bag that it comes with; much larger than other brands I've purchased but I use it to store the clean ready to go diapers. The diapers themselves are great the snaps are strong and have a good size range, the lining is soft and haven't had any staining thus far. The liners I feel like are basic microfiber liners I did wash them about 4 times before use to help with absorbancy but I still wouldn't use just one alone for overnight or long car rides etc I would put the microfiber in the pocket and use a bamboo or something that can be close to the skin on the inside for those long periods of time. It looks like there is a snap in the pocket itself so if you have liners with snaps you are covered. I honestly have no complaints and I love the prints haven't seen any like it and I'm obsessed!

source_doc: Beautiful drawer handles! I was upset when I opened these because I had ordered the rose gold, and I was only going to give three stars for receiving the wrong color. The pictures really don’t do them justice, it’s so hard to tell from a photo but these really are extremely nice drawer handles. I’m waiting until I get my cabinets refinished to use them in the kitchen, but I tested out the screws and they fit seamlessly into the handles. I like that the screws are cuttable too, depending on the thickness of your drawer front/cabinet. Overall these are what I would call deluxe drawer/cabinet handles, and I would highly recommend them.

source_doc: It's noisy but there's a cheap and easy fix. For the price it is a great elliptical. The resistance levels are good and I get a whole body workout on this thing. It's sturdy enough for the asking price, but the bolts on the main strut make an extremely irritating noise after a while due to the metal washer rubbing against the metal of the strut. I was pulling my hair out over this for a long time, because for a while I wasn't even sure exactly where the sound was coming from. Eventually I narrowed it down to the bolts holding together the two parts of the main support beam. I tried tightening them, lubricating them with WD-40, but nothing worked. I was about ready to throw the whole unit away until I had an epiphany one day. What if I put some rubber in between the metal washers and the strut? All I did was take a spare koozie I had lying around and cut 1-inch squares out of it. In the squares I cut a slit half way up the center and a 1/4" hole in the middle. I then loosened the bolts and slid the rubber koozie square between the washer and the main support and tightened the bolts again. Now the machine is silent! I couldn't be happier now.

source_doc: Absolute Garbage. These things are absolute garbage. I have had two now, one which I just threw in the trash last night, was a black HZ model. source_doc: Good Soap; Very Fragrant. I got this dish soap specifically to take to the office. I work in a shared environment where dish soap is provided by the workers, not the organization, and I have seen a variety of soaps of varying quality run through. I have had good success with Amazon's store brands, so I had good expectations here. It's good soap that gets the job done. The most notable aspect of this soap is the fragrance.In use this soap works as well or better than the rest of the soaps I have seen in the kitchen. It clears grease and it gets dirty dishes clean, There's no mystery there. It rinses off well and I have not had problems with residue after using this soap.The fragrance is the most noticeable feature of this soap. It has a strong lemony smell to it that doesn't smell like fresh lemons, exactly, but it is much stronger than that of most soaps I have used. It's a pleasant fragrance and it actually makes the kitchen smell nice when I use it.This is fine dish soap that works well and smells nice. It's at least on par with name brand soaps I have used, and it is very fragrant. When it's gone, I will buy more.

source_doc: Wonderful company! [EDIT] The company reached out to me and sent me a replacement controller right away! The new controller works perfectly and I love it. I really appreciate them taking the time to talk to me about the problem and send me one that works. Thank you so much![Original] I don't understand what's happening. I was playing Mario Party and one of the games said I hit the A button too many times. So I started playing it separately so I can see exactly what's happening. Every time I hit the A button it basically ended up hitting it 5 times or so. I thought it was a feature of the controller that if you hit the button and hold it, it would keep going. I ended up being able to toggle it on and off but now I can't get it to do it at all. I have no idea if the A button is broken, if it does have that weird toggle feature and that button is broken, or if this is faulty. I'm so confused and sad because I was so excited for this controller. I honestly can't figure out what's wrong.

source_doc: Beautiful. I love this little bowl and lid!  Two things I wish the makers could change, though.  One is that there is a little crease around the lid underneath.  I wish that was not there due to the difficulty to clean it.  Second, I wish the knob was easier to grasp and hold on the lid.  When this bowl is hot, you have to use a potholder to remove the lid.  That lid knob is too small.  I dropped it once because it slipped out of my potholders.  It could have broken, and my heart would be broken too.  I have tried to figure out how I can get the bowl out of the microwave, burning hot, rather than using potholders on each side.  I love it for its looks, but I want to use it, too.OK, sad news.  I could not find any way to remove the lid when it was very hot.  I tried gloves, mit's, and little pinchers.  Nothing worked.  I sadly sent it back.

source_doc: They are OK. I've got a bunch of par lights, and I guess I was hoping for a little more with these. Most of my lights are about the same size. Their LEDs are in different patterns, but when I put them all on my truss, they look comparable. These guys are smaller. I guess you can call them compact. But they won't look right in-line with my other pars. They are bright... in fact, they are brighter than a name brand pair that I have. However, the blue had more purple in it. The red and green looked OK. The spread is wider when I tested these side-by-side with my name brand. The name brand gave me an even circle on my ceiling. This pair washed a larger area with a hot spot in the middle. What I do NOT like is the plug. It is ungrounded. If I use them inside, they will work OK. I will probably use them behind a scrim or façade since the brackets are extremely flimsy. I didn't expect name brand quality for sure. But I think I expected just a little bit better.

source_doc: Takes fabric pilling off sweaters, couches.... Well, I did it.  I read several of the reviews and took the plunge.  Usually I take a pair of old hair clippers and shave my sweaters but that has caused too many snags.  This little shaver DOES NOT create snags.  You charge this little bugger up and in no time you're digging through your closet and bringing out stuff you forgot you had and shaving everything down.  After that now I have sweaters ready to wear and a pile destined for a Lawn Sale.  What can I say... it's the cycle of clothing.  I like just about everything about this shaver.  It's small, rechargeable, fits in my hand well the only thing that I found a tad irritating is emptying out the collection of sweater lint/nubs.  It was really difficult at first and to pop it off I had to ask my husband hoping that he wouldn't break it.  He got it off and we emptied the bin and it was a hard snap back in.  It kinda scared me at the amount of force that had to be used.  It did NOT break (phew) and I've been using it practically weekly.  Overall - I would agree with the reviews and the amount of people who have purchased this item.  It really gets the job done. Enjoy and I hope you don't become a fanatic about keeping your sweaters pristine like I have. (slight nervous laugh).

I will update this one to let you know when I get good enough to have broke a drum stick. Five stars because it's so inexpensive, well thought out and a great way to learn the basics.

source_doc: I LOVE This Pan. This pan is one of the most remarkable pans I have ever used in my life.  First, let's talk heat distribution, which is often a factor in cooking and also, often a problem with a lot of pans.  Whatever process they have for making this pan, they have figured out the best and truly, I need an entire set of them.  We have several, high-end expensive sets and I could replace them all with just a different plethora of these pans.  This pan, will sear, but not "burn" anything.  I have actually tried- it just won't do it.  I love that feature and it doesn't seem to matter which burner I put it on, the pan cooks evenly through it's entire surface.  The handle is not only a "stay cool" handle, it's comfortable to hold and the overall pan is just extremely well-balanced.  It's very easy to clean and this is one of, if not THE go-to pan I use for most things I am cooking unless I need a bigger pan.  Although, this pan is quite big.  This would make a good pan for any gift, and they would LOVE you for it.  I intend to buy several more in different sizes and I feel like this company has really figured it out, through and through.  I highly recommend this and you can thank me later!  I hope you find this review helpful!!

source_doc: Nice. I just got into doing my own press on nail designs. I got this one so I can do multiple nails on my nail painting stands. I love the size, the preset times, and being light weight. I can fit both my hands and still have room. Enough room to not make a mistake and touch the inside. I haven’t a problem curing either. I would say (I probably need to read the instructions) I don’t like once I put my hand in the light comes on. I get that it’s convenient for nail techs, but I’d rather it come on after I hit the time. The whole reason I wanted to do this was to keep my hands from under UV lights. Other then that, great product.

source_doc: Awesome oil. I for years I used to use only the Subaru synthetic oil in my 2018 forester. After reading reviews and friends telling me about this oil I tried it out.It is a little more expensive that the Subaru oil but I wanted to try it and I was willing to pay the price 1x. I took the averages on both oils after I put 1000mi on.I will update if there’s any changes. On a side note it does say it’s a once a year oil but that’s only if you drive freeway. I drive stop and go in the city so I still plan to change it out in 5 months. I’m also going to put it in our HRV.Thanks royal purple!!

source_doc: Not Enjoying All the Possibilities. In 2020 I bought this preorder from the manufacturer (before they were shipping). It came with no user manual. I found a manual on their internet site, but I wasn't able to find much that was helpful to me. My initial problem was that the app did not work on my i-phone 6 operating system. I set the amp aside until I recently bought an i-phone 14. I recently (2023) downloaded the App. First message was that I needed to download a firmware update for the Spark40. That required a computer. I tried a computer with Windows 11. Then I tried one with Windows 10 Pro. Neither computer recognizes the amplifier. After contacting customer service (very nice response), I connected to a different USB port on the Windows 11 computer and the update worked. This amp is supposed to do wonderful things, and many are happy with it. In my small amount of time using it, I found adjustments on the App difficult to make because of the small phone screen size. Maybe an i-pad would be easier, but that would cost a lot to gain that capability. I'm impressed by all the Spark40 is supposed to do, but not very pleased with the learning curve and the amount of supporting equipment needed (App capable phone or tablet, and a computer for updates of firmware). Make sure you have a phone with an operating system that can run the App.

source_doc: VERY STRONG FRAGRANCE!!!! Smell is extraordinarily fragranced. I left this box on my bathroom counter for a half day while I did other things. Returning to my bathroom area, I could smell it out in the hallway. I ended up double bagging it in ziplocks.I don’t like scents and I can have allergic reactions but usually shampoo smells are okay. So, I kept it. Finally tried it this morning. The black shampoo + the green conditioner. Worked okay but again, the smell was EXTREMELY STRONG. I felt my lips tingling in the shower so I was definitely having a reaction.Anyways, an hour later I got migraine. I get them very infrequently - maybe once a year or less. This one was only visual but the strongest visual one I’ve ever had. Kinda suspicious I got it right after using a new product. No one to know for sure.Long story short, everything was double bagged and put into the trash.I really, really would like to be doing better and using and discarding less plastic but not at the expense of my health.Definitely not a good product if you are sensitive to fragrances.

source_doc: great for cat hair and taking on the go. my uniform for work is 100% black and having 6 cats, yeah my clothes get covered in hair. now, using a lint roller isn't anything new to me, but the one i had ran out of paper and i had no clue it was out. so ofc i ran to amazon to buy one that would arrive quickly. this one came up and i was intrigued by the design, i've only ever had the straight ones. so i took a chance on this one and omg i'm never going back. the design of this one somehow makes it easier to roll. and i love the fact that it has a cover, because a lot of the time i forget to lint roll before i leave, so it's nice that i can just keep this in my bag and use it once i get to work.it was a little hard to figure out how to peel the paper off but once i did figure it out, it became easy.

source_doc: Nice low glow color ring. I wanted an adjustable light in my bedroom but I didn't have a ceiling mount (where I wanted to put it) in place with the wires to the breaker box. Since the lamp itself was very lightweight, I wired with old lamp parts that plugged into a wall socket. It worked out perfectly for me. I like that I can turn off the main light with the color ring on for the late nights and serves as a nicely dimmed nightlight. There are several light settings to choose from to please any mood or brightness needed. The main light is impressively bright and can be toned down to my preference at that moment. When I turn everything off and turn it on the next day, it remembers my last settings of both lights. To me at first, the remote was a little complicated to figure out and remember each buttons capabilities. Even after a week I was fiddling around with the remote to change the settings where I wanted. Now that I got the hang of it, I love this light and happy that I decided to order this one out of several different choices I was considering. This lamp has many setting option and I would recommend it for any room.

I covered all of them and have enough fabric to change all of them once more with a little bit to spare, but if you cover from the front I would say you should have enough for a good 28 vents.

source_doc: Really Works to Prevent Color Bleeding. I usually separate my whites from darker clothing out of fear that the dye from the dark clothing will stain the white. So I was excited to try this product.Basically the sheets look like fabric softener sheets, only they're meant for "grabbing" the color shed by darker clothes and preventing them from bleeding onto the lighter ones. I dropped 2 sheets in my load of laundry, started the machine, and added detergent.To test the product, I threw in a pair of burgundy colored corduroy pants that explicitly said "Wash separate from light colors" and even stated "dye may bleed." I threw them into the same wash as my lighter colored shirts and socks.After the wash was done, I saw that the two "color grabber" sheets had turned gray (they were originally white). They had absorbed the color and when I checked my clothing, I saw no color "bleeds."Now, I haven't tested it with a hot water wash, but for the cold water wash, they definitely work. I love it. Usually I have to separate the whites from the other clothing and it wastes money because the all-white bundle is usually small and could easily fit with the rest of the clothing's washer. But I had always had to separate. Not anymore! I can toss one of these sheets in and it will prevent any color bleeding.Great product.

source_doc: I like it! I had read that COQ10 is good for your heart, blood pressure and cholesterol so I decided to try it. I found the taste was not unpleasant although the consistency was a little thick. I found that after a couple of days I seemed to feel a little more energetic and I felt less anxiety.  I have never taken a COQ10 supplement in a form such as this, but since I hate to take pills, this works better for me. The only thing I dislike is that this has to be refrigerated after opening which makes it more difficult to remember to take.  The bottle is supposed to be used within 45 days of opening so if I miss a few days, the product will still be good.  I won’t know of course if consuming this supplement will help with my cholesterol levels until the next time it is checked so if there is a marked improvement, I will update this review.  In the meantime, I really like this supplement.

source_doc: Incredible audio and customer service! I purchased this monitor in June of 2021. I use it for monitoring my mom with severe Alzheimer's. The sound quality is amazing! I can hear her breathing from across the room on this monitor. Sunday morning about 2 am, I started getting a notification beep that the battery was about dead on my monitor. I checked the cord, battery, everything. I emailed customer support at 2:30 in the morning on a Sunday morning, I had a response later Sunday. Long story short, they expedited a replacement cord to me and I received it just now (Tuesday morning). Free of charge. Wow!The picture quality is pretty good, just small on this camera, but as I said the audio is amazing. $49 is a steal for this camera! I have purchased a lot of baby monitors to find the best one. This has much better sound pickup than any of the others I tried- including expensive ones. Expensive price is not equivalent to quality. This is a great buy! I can't say enough good about them. Oh yeah, the monitor also will pick up across the street as well. I can carry it over to visit with a neighbor and keep an eye on my mom as she sleeps.Buy it!

source_doc: Fluffier than expected. It is hard to order something online and know if you will like it or not, even if you base your decision on the reviews. I must have spent a week almost daily searching for a comforter. So, I took a chance on this one because my old comforter was flat and faded. And hello, I like being spoiled by two day shipping with Prime!The comforter arrived in a vacuum sealed tight bag and looked pretty thin. No weird smells, either. It was late and I wanted to use it that night, so I overlooked the instructions and tossed it into the washing machine. (The instructions state to air it out over a 24 hour period outside, but it is winter here and I have nowhere to safely hang it or leave it.) I washed it on "warm" on the delicate cycle and the tag said to "line dry" but seriously, who does that anymore? Being the rebel that I am, I forego the instructions and shove it into my regular sized dryer on "medium" and waited. Well, it took about 2 hours to dry. When it was done, it smelled great and was very fluffy! I put it on the bed and loved the look and feel of it. I slept great that night snuggled up with this wonderful, and did I mention fluffy? new comforter. I'm very happy with my purchase.

source_doc: A Practice Tool. I bought this transmitter specifically for practice.  I don't think I'd ever use a low-end wireless for a live performance.  There are too many cross signals that will cause signal drop.  I was surprised when I got some drop in my practice room.  To be fair, not long after it dropped a few times, the battery died about 10 minutes later. So that was probably the cause so kudos because it didn't drop more frequently.  The volume control is not linear, at least by my experience.  It went from to quite to booming with just a few touches.  I had to play with it a bit to get the level where I wanted it.  I also noticed the wireless is tonally different than the cord.  Actually, I like the sound a bit better.  I didn't notice that difference with my other wireless system.  I have only used this device in my practice room so, I don't know how it will react if practicing with a group, especially if there are other wireless devices in the room.  When I know, I'll update this review.

source_doc: Overly sensitive - may need therapy! I love the individually programmable key light colors! Granted, the color/brightness varies a little across the keyboard, but most people would not likely notice. I like the volume control, contrary to other reviews. The keyboard is full-size but compact - like a Tardis! With light use, the battery has lasted well. The only thing I don't care for is that the keys are very sensitive - it is easy to mistype with a very light touch. I find myself making corrections or opening windows that I didn't intend. I could use the power cable to keep the backlight from sleeping, but that's not why I bought a wireless model. I wish I could extend the sleep timer. I don't think there is a competitive model with similar features for this price and I highly recommend this Red Dragon keyboard if you can train yourself to use the very sensitive keys.

source_doc: Great office chair! This seems like a nicely made computer chair. I am not very good at putting things together, but I managed to get this chair together all by myself! It suggests having two people put it together, and I agree that two people would make things much easier! I didn't have an issue until I tried to put the back of the seat on. I just couldn't get it in the right spot because I needed two hands to screw the bolts in. It took awhile, but I got it!The chair is very sturdy and the seat is very comfortable! The neck support is nice. The only issues I noticed were some of the wheels wouldn't roll as I pushed it back to my office. I assume with use, these wheels will start working. Also, I had planned on using it for my bar-height desk, but it is a few inches too short, so I will have to find another use for it. I think I assumed it would adjust that high, but I should have looked at the measurements.

source_doc: Excellent feed. I bought this for my green winged macaw because her other food went up $20 and I wanted something a little less expensive. Despite what some people said about their birds rejecting it I decided to try it anyways. It had a good pellet size, smelled good and had a nice crumble factor to it. My bird usually dives into her other food but only ate a little bit of it when I put it in her dish. Usually she eats all her food by 5 pm which is her second feeding time. There were pellets left over. I waited a few days for her to get used to it but she never did. I did not want her to go to many more days without eating so I broke down and despite the cost  bought her, her old food which is what I will keep her on from now on. I have nothing negative to say about this product except you have a 50/50 chance of your bird liking it. I didnt want this to go to waste so I gave it to my friend who owns a bunch of parrots.

source_doc: Very strong. This thing is so much better than the mighty mule I mean I’ve only had it working for a couple weeks now, but it is so much stronger and quieter than the mighty mule. I have a 14 1/2 foot gate that I made myself out of 2 3/8  thin wall pipe no I don’t know the exact weight of the gate but I’m guessing 250 maybe 300 pounds and this thing swings it like it’s not even there I like the soft close feature. and the electric lock takes a lot of pressure off of the actuator on a windy day. I’ve had two of the mighty mules granted they were the smaller models.3500 I believe is what the model was but I burn two of them up in one year like I said I’ve only had this one going for a bout a month so it’s a little premature I will give a year end review but so far, I’m really liking it. It’s faster than the mighty mule as well. The only thing I don’t like is the cheap ass remote control the damn buttons. Get stuck it’s just cheaply made but other than that I love the gate opener I can’t say much about tech-support because I have not had to use them. It is pretty simple to install and I’ve had no problems with it. I highly recommend it if you have a heavy gate well worth the money.

So basically I have a 50$ charging dock for my left controller 😢😩Well I’m only giving this 3 stars unfortunately I only get to use this to charge my controllers which works great. However the magnetic piece that is supposed to plug into my oculus to be able to charge it wasn’t in the box so I have no idea how well that one works and if you have silicone skins on your headset, it will not fit into the holder, which is not a huge deal. I assume You just take them off and back on like I do with the controllers

source_doc: Nice Scent. I love my fur babies but I do not want my house to smell like a litter box.  I got these OdorTrap refills to use with my Litter Robot because they are much less expensive than what I was using.  I like that the scent is not overpowering because I have found that if I use anything that smells too strong, the cats avoid the litter box…definitely not something you want happening lol.  These refills are made to go in the pod that goes in the drawer of the Litter Robot but I think they could even be used without that near any type of litter box.  I have another litter box that is in an enclosure.  I put one of these packs behind it and it is helping to remove the odor quite well.  I definitely will be stocking up on these.  Great product.  Great price.

source_doc: Nice breast massager. I wish I had discovered this for my first baby! I love the massage and heat function. It truly helps for engorgement. I haven’t tried it on clogged ducts yet.I tuck it into my pumping bra during pumping sessions and the heat feels so good. The silicone feels soft on the skin. The heat is only on one side, which makes sense. I never use it during breastfeeding and I don’t think it’s a good idea to have vibration with the baby attached to you.I wish the battery life were longer. I also think it would have been better that the inlet for the charger had a hole to begin with. I kinda created a slit while trying to pierce through the hole (see picture). So I guess it’s not waterproof anymore. I wasn’t planning to use it in the shower anyway.Overall, I’m happy with this product. Even though it says I’ve received it for free, I still need to pay about 30% tax on all products received for review. Regardless, that doesn’t affect my review.

source_doc: Like the semi transparent ones better ---- Fits Acura Sedan & similar model -- Read review. I ordered these sun shades during Amazon prime day, but since it is winter time I didn't use them. Well, I recently got some moles and freckles removed from my face, so I am in complete vampire mode. That means I apply globs of sunscreen on face and hiss at the sight of sunlight, that is ......... until my skin heals.Yesterday, I pulled out these shades, happy that there was a dark option to help me stay in vampire mode, but both of the dark shades would not stick to my window. Only the two transparent ones worked. The transparent one is ok, but not nearly enough shade for those who need to be out of the sun. The darker ones are much better.  In fact, I would rather have bought 4 semi transparent ones instead of 2 transparent and 2 semi transparent.I guess I received a defective batch, but I still give them 5 stars because I sent them a message explaining the above situation, and they promptly responded stating they stand by their products and will ship me 2 working ones. 5 stars for the amazing customer service. I wish all companies were like them. Anyway, don't be like me and use this a month later. Check to make sure all shades work right when you receive them.Hope my review helps!

source_doc: I have owned this now for just over 3 years. So, I kind of forgot where I bought this. source_doc: This battery delivers its rated capacity of 100Ah. I have a Bluetti AC200P connected to a 6 circuit manual transfer panel and this works well.  I was looking for some extra battery capacity and watched many reviews of the different brands of 100Ah LifePo4 batteries.  Power Queen was a highly rated battery and their price was equal to about all the others.  However, Power Queen was running a promotion where you would get a 12.8V 6Ah battery for free with each battery purchase so I took advantage of that.  I decided to go with 2 of the Power Queen 100Ah batteries.  I use the smaller battery in my electric start gas generator.  I was able to test their capacity to ensure that I was getting the advertised 100Ah from them and I am pleased to say that each one delivered about 101Ah.  I now have them wired together in series to get 24V and then attach them to the solar generator through an adapter.  This works well although the solar generator only charges at about 340W.  I can't speak for the life cycle of these batteries but with a 5 year warranty, I am not to concerned about that.  I did have the opportunity to ask a question via email to Power Queen and they responded within a day.  I think that they were a good value and would buy again.

source_doc: It’s fun and enjoyable. I’ve never picked up a guitar in my life until this was delivered so I can’t attest to playability or quality. I did swap out the strings when I got it but more because I wanted to learn how to do it than any perceived problem with the strings that came with it. I can say I have enjoyed experimenting and learning with this guitar.  I paired it with an “Orange” amp and despite not having a clue what I’m doing have been able to replicate sounds like ‘old school’ heavy metal to clear/clean tones that could pass for country or blues if played by someone who knew more than 2 cords. I suspect in trained or experienced hands this guitar would be a good, but not great, guitar.A few things I did notice…1. There are some exposed wires coming out from under one of the pickups and the middle pickups are not level. 2. There is some discoloration on the body of the guitar  3. The tuning peg for the high E is finicky and sometimes feels unresponsive which can make tuning a pain.For what I paid, I didn’t expect perfection, and I have no idea if the uneven pickups impact playability or sound quality, the remainder are cosmetic or just frustrating. I think this probably represents a solis starter guitar or a good rehearsal/travel guitar for more experienced players.

source_doc: Good for quick cleaning. This electric spinning scrubber is really good for quick cleanings. I'm not a fan of cleaning the tub and this helps to move things along. It's a good quality handle with various types of brush heads. Right out of the box I could use it because it was charged which I like. I put the large brush head on to tackle the tub and turned it on...well hold on because I wasn't ready for the brush to take off once it made contact. It's spinning so it kind of spun right along on it's own, I had to get used to it to hold the brush down to clean the area I wanted. The main thing is you have to hold it at the right angle for the brush to make solid contact because the tip of the handle where you attach the heads is at an angle. With the attachment I have been using it's a little difficult to keep it in full contact so I feel like I am missing areas while I'm cleaning. That's why I say it's good for quick cleaning, not necessarily a thorough cleaning. The power also lasted awhile for me, I've used it about 4 times and it still has a charge. I like having this tool but at $75 the price is high in my opinion.

source_doc: Thin and lightweight. I first started sleeping on a memory foam pillow some 20+ years ago. It radically changed the way I sleep. Though I fell asleep on my side, I always woke on my back. It was so much more comfortable for me that I won't use anything else. I got this pillow so I would have a spare. I was a bit taken aback by how small, thin, and lightweight it is compared to standard bed pillows. Even so, it is pristine, with a very nice quilted zippered case that can be removed for cleaning. It is firmer than the pillow I am used t, and I had my doubts that I would like it. But I slept on it last night and it was great! It will take a few more nights to determine if this is my new pillow of choice, but at the very least it will be a close second and will certainly be the one I take along when traveling!

source_doc: Excellent so far. The box came in good condition. There were not a whole lot of pieces to assemble. I put this together myself in about 30 minutes and only because I did not look at the directions as carefully as I should have. I always look at the pieces in the box compared to the directions of what is to be be sent in the box. What I didn’t notice was the fine print that said some of those pieces came pre-assembled. I scratched my head at some of the other directions, but if you think it through, it will make sense.This machine is smaller than a magnetic rower and the arm motions are like rowing on water as opposed to just pulling back and forth. I used it the first time last night after putting it together. I could only take the number 1 setting in the tension as I have gotten out of shape except for indoor biking. I ended up using my VR headset to play Holofit and lost track of the time. It ended up being about 40 minutes. Today, I am sore all over, but a good sore. This machine really works the arms, back, and legs. After a few months, if this machine is as good as it is now, I will give it 5 stars.

source_doc: Probably my favorite mouse of all time. I had a G502 Hero wired mouse before this one. The way I had my cables routed I was constantly dealing with drag issues. I would leave the mouse still and watch the cursor move as the cable sagged. It's a minor annoyance at best...and I could have fixed it...but I treated myself to a new mouse and I'm not disappointed in the slightest. I'm not really a huge gamer but I do IT work from home and am at the computer for 8 - 12 hours pretty much every day. A comfortable mouse is a must and this is it! The battery seems to last about 2 - 3 weeks between charges. If I ever have to go back to the office, the fact that this is the non-RGB version works in my favor and it won't attract too much attention.The software is a bit on the finicky side. I like to run mine at 6400dpi. The defaults are not great and when the software updates I'm stuck waiting for the speed to pick up again while watching the splash animation play out. source_doc: Great option for a wireless lav mic without breaking the bank! I had middle of the road expectations for this wireless last mic, compared to some other brands that I am more familiar with. But I saw that there was an excellent Black Friday sale, and I was desperately in need of a new wireless microphone like this, And it was recommended on one tech YouTube channel I saw, so I decided to give it a shot. I’m really glad that I did! A lot of times I am filming in an area where I am away from my phone, and the way this plugs into the charging port on the bottom is super convenient. The sound quality is also very good for what it is, and is  impressive to me more than I thought it would be. I would definitely buy this again, and I would recommend it to others.

source_doc: Not anti-kink hose. I've had this hose for over 4 years now and have used it many times in the travel trailer.  I also have the 10' version to use when the trailer is much closer to the water outlet at campgrounds.  I wish I could use the 10 footer all the time, but many times I need to get the 25' hose out, which drives me nuts.  It's a real pain to put back in the storage bin if it's slightly cold out as it won't coil up neatly and I have to fling it all around to get it to curve correctly so it goes in the bin.  It has several kinks in it that won't go away.  So, yeah, not anti-kink in my opinion and it's been that way ever since I got it.  (Didn't realize I hadn't reviewed it until I was searching my orders for another hose I purchased a few years ago.)  I'm about ready to toss it as I just ordered another 10 footer and will connect the two together when I need to.  The good thing about the hose - knock wood, it's never leaked or split in the years of periodic usage.  But, yeah, anti-kink is a lie.  Can't really address the hooking issue as I have it hooked to a Hose-Grip from J Wright Concepts, which is wonderful and a device every camper needs!

source_doc: Best sleep ever!!! Okay, so I know this is an "Air Bed" (super-sized mattress) and not a standard or "real" bed but I've tried a bunch of "real" beds and have consistently had lower-back pain when I got up each morning. In desperation I thought I couldn't lose by buying and trying this Air Bed. Changed my life!!! EXTREMELY comfortable ALL NIGHT LONG! As you can see from the pics, I use it differently than most: (a) I found the fabric side with the channels to be less comfortable than the bottom so I inverted it with wonderful results; (b) by inverting the bed, the fabric catches on the carpet better than the smooth side so it doesn't shift when I get on or off of it; and (c) I didn't want to have to deal with fitting sheets so I just bought an inexpensive sleeping bad and it worked perfectly. I have the twin xl version and a double sleeping bag fits just right. I use this EVERY NIGHT and have been doing so for weeks. I do have to top off the air each night for about 10 or 15 seconds as there is a tiny leak. I couldn't find any air escaping so I'm assuming it's getting out through the built-in fan assembly. No biggee, though. I highly recommend this critter!!

source_doc: Couldn't tell any difference in my curls.. I've heard so many good things about Olaplex so I thought I'd give it a whirl. Given how expensive it is, I was expecting a drastic change and moisturized curls. I literally could not tell any difference in my hair. I have 3a curls, shoulder length. I washed my hair like normal and followed with Okaplex. I even kept it on for about an hour (each product) then rinse and style as usual. My curls weren't moisturized, shinier, and weren't as defined as I was expecting. I used the products twice to make sure and followed instructions from a few YouTube tutorials. No luck. I ended up returning both products because I didn't want to waste $63 on hair products that didn't even work. I don't recommend for tight curls - it might do better on straight hair or waves.

source_doc: Good wireless earbuds. These are nice wireless earbuds. They fit pretty good, I have had one fall out a few times at the gym (I may need to change to a different ear cushion, which are included). I think the sound is very good, I like the bass-heavy music while working out. They seem to hold a charge a long time. The controls are a bit sensitive and I’ve accidentally skipped the controls I wanted. I have not used this for phone calls, so I cannot comment on the quality of talking on the phone. When I first connected my phone to these, the Bluetooth for the ear buds came up twice, and I only could hear out of one speaker (depending which one I chose, the left or the right) and I couldn’t get them to sync. The way I resolved it was “forgetting” both and shutting my Bluetooth off, then after turning it back on, it was only listed once, and they’ve worked fine ever since.

source_doc: American AF. I have a really extensive, high quality knife collection and this particular knife I believe would be the one knife I would take if I could only have one. I have knives that cost much more, made of "better steel", superior finish etc, but this is the one. On mine I used a manual mill and a 3/8 endmill (better than filing imo) to take off just enough to give it a sharp 90 deg spine. Not necessary but that's what I did and that is the only mod that I wanted to do. May get a leather dangler sheath for when I want it like on my rat7, but I love this sheath. It's kinda tacticool, but rides high for my liking. SOLID locking in the sheath though. Surprisingly easy to unsheath with a little thumb push. This thing just works well, feels intuitive and doesn't leave you wanting. It's high enough quality that it always looks the part if ya know what I mean. A no brainier. As a (I hate "as a" comments) American, I believe we should be issued on of these at birth.

source_doc: Just as described! My machine was delivered Feb 4th. I started using it that day. Easy assembly. Only took 30 min. source_doc: easy on belly, works as topper to kibble and/or home cooked. I also use in treat toys. So far so good. I have been giving my 7 years old baby girl home cooked meals, but wanted to make sure she has a good base. Recently she hasn't wanted her usual kibble, and this coincides with a cancer diagnosis.To whet her appetite, I focused more on the foods she loves, and then began adding in more vegetables. I happened to have a bag of Purina Beyond Organic dry food that when I offered it to her she seemed to like it. So then I decided to use that as a base, add the home cooked foods, then top off with some wet food. I basically want to make sure I am not missing out on anything nutrient wise. She seems to like this wet food.It is chunks with gravy, not a pate. She is on prednisone which has increased her appetite. I give her food in between regular meals to keep her belly happy. I have put some of this into treat toys for her to work on. I haven't totally figured out the best diet for her, but so far the combo of food I have been giving her has been easy on her stomach, has been making good poops, and seems to enjoy it a lot. I have already ordered some other variations from Purina Beyond offerings.

source_doc: I actually live these. I live alone and have two doors in the back of my house that I don't use that often. But that was just my preference.All in all I think these are great locks to have as just an extra lock for any door.

source_doc: A Most Excellent Mouse. The M913 is an excellent office and gaming mouse.  I have been a Razer user for years.  I was having problems gripping my mouse due to injuries to both hands and wrist so I went on Amazon to find a new mouse that wasn't over $100.  I came across the M913 and found the features perfect for me and I bought it and the gaming pad.A week after I had been using it I was misusing the software (I forgot to turn the mouse on) and was trying to turn it on thru the software.  Strictly a user error.  I contacted the company thru their website by filling out the form.  Since it was late Sunday night and it was one of those fill out the form and hope for the best I did not expect an answer for several days.  I was surprised and very happy when a tech support person sent me an e-mail with the easy fix.  My mouse was fixed in less than 10 minutes!  I am now a dye hard fan of Red Dragon perifels.  Thank you Red Dragon for a superior product.

source_doc: Poor packaging. Are you kidding me ??? I was looking for ice packs that will last for hours without sweating too much. I Came across these and made the purchase. When they arrived the package was not at all what I expected.It was not completely sealed and therefore, parts were missing.there was only 4 ice packs included instead of the 5 as described. The funnel was missing as well as the cork-type pieces that are supposed to be used to fill the packs then seal the openings. In all fairness, I contacted Amazon and a replacement set will be sent to me. I do, however must return this set so I won’t be charged twice. Obviously I am quite disappointed with this product and company. I am looking forward to finding out if the new set will work as I originally anticipated.  As of right now, I do not recommend this product!UPDATE : well the second set was delivered and WHAT…the package was open and contents are missing. AGAIN !  How does this happen twice in one month ? Although this time I did get all 5 ice packs, but the funnel and 5 blue stoppers are missing. I’m done. This time I am returning and expecting my money back! At a price of $18.98 I truly expected better quality in the packing from manufacturer. Do not waste your time or money on this frustration !

source_doc: I don't game, but this is a great mouse for CAD and every day use. I switch between my Chromebook, MacBook Pro, and Windows desktop consistently, but I carry this one mouse around with me everywhere. Switching between bluetooth and the WiFi dongle is a blessing. I can switch the mouse to control different machines easily and on the go ;)When it comes to like buttons and comfort and clickyness and DPI and other miscellaneous gamery super-into-it mouse nerd kinda stuff, I have no idea. I like it. I CAD and do, like, normal computer stuff for work and personal stuff. Cool mouse. For CAD I map the two side buttons to whichever button is the orbit/pan modifier key, which has been pretty useful for switching between CAD programs. The other button I use as the esc key.I only wish I could pair it with more than one dongle so I can use the mouse on my desktop at home AND at work with wifi instead of bluetooth.

source_doc: Simple plug and start using. Was getting tired of using my earpods for video calls on phone. The mic just wasn't clear for those on the other side.I was curious about these and well, decided to try them.  WOW... worked great right out of the box.  My iPhone quickly connected and I was able to start using.  I did a voice recording so I could hear the quality. It was sharp and crisp.Now I have no excuse to podcast off my phone other than I don't like hearing my own voice.I at times have a friend with me and we do video call and have to position phone to get both our voices or hand it back and forth.This came with TWO lapel clip mics so now we can each wear one and keep the phone propped for video call.Will need to get proper cable adapter to try and get this to connect to my laptop. It doesn't have iphone or usb-c ports so I will have to get back to y'all once I get proper cable.  I expect it to work.I'm wondering if I can get a small speaker to connect this to when I am working the company booth. I usually end up almost yelling and losing my voice at days end.  That is my next project for these.

source_doc: Not enough fragrance. I really wanted to like this product. When it came out of the package, the scent packets smelled amazing. I put it in its holder and stuck it to the side of my trash can, which has its own tall cabinetry drawer. I expected to come back and smell lemons the next time I opened the trash drawer. I just smelled trash. I took the trash out and put a new trash bag in and shut the door. When I came back, I still could not smell lemons. I finally leaned over towards the scent packet and had to practically press my nose against the plastic holder to smell the lemons. I revisited the trash several times over two days and it never improved. I won’t be ordering this product again. The convenience of the holder and the great scent doesn’t make a difference if you can only smell it when it is in your face.

source_doc: Surprisingly discouraged. I am disappointed. Ohora has the most incredible selection of colors… So I am bummed to discover such poor quality. I have tried many semi cured gel strip brands. I’ve been wearing them for a year consistently. I change my sets every two weeks, usually because I just want to change my manicure, very rarely do I have any shipping or peeling. With this brand I find they crack and ship far more quickly than any other. This set has already had two nails that chipped so I took them off & replaced. Now I have three more chipped nails.  I think I’m just going to give up and take them completely off.  I have other Ohora sets in my drawer that I won’t let go to waste but unless I’m pleasantly surprised by the others I try in the future, I would not recommend this brand again.  So sad bc the color options are for sure the best I’ve found.

source_doc: Great for making some 'fancy' coffee. I really like this brother.  It's easy to use, and quicker and easier to clean than the frother cups (although, I do love my frother cup when I want heated milk).The frother itself is very nice quality, and the digital display is nice and clear.  I've had it for a few months now, and I haven't had any issues with it.  I've only tried the wisk attachment, because I can't for the life of me find the other attachment. I don't know if I didn't get it, or if I misplaced it.  But, the wisk does a great job at making some fluffy milk foam for my lattes!  Operation is smooth, and it's easy to adjust the strength of the mixer by twisting the little ring with the ridges.I keep this on the coffee station, in front of my frother cup, because I use this one more because of its ease of use when I'm in a rush (which is always).The stand only works for me if I remove the wisk attachment, so that's what I do.Overall, I'm really happy I got this.  It's been saving me a lot of money that would have gone to Starbucks.  Now, I have my own coffee shop in my home.  The price is comparable, and in my opinion this one is a better deal over others because of the smooth operation of it, along with the digital screen.

source_doc: The plastic adheres when soaked. I bought these as liners for my reusable belly bands. First of all, I realize they do give measurements but you definitely need to go larger than a belly band sizing to get them to fit, so I should've gotten bigger ones. I think the length is inadequate to the width for the absorbance to wick away if you have an excessive urinator, which I do. But the worst part is when they're fully soaked, which happens quickly with my foster cairn that had bladder stones previously, then the plastic backing will sort of permanently stick to your fabric belly band. I had to soak in very hot water and pick away at it to get it all off. This had happened several times, so I won't be rebuying. I honestly should return them it's so bad. I much rather keep with the disposable Amazon brand wraps. My dog chews on those so I have to cover with a fabric one to keep him from eating them and as backup if they become soaked. I'm honestly surprised at the rating level on these, because that's why I tried them. It should be lower.

source_doc: So awesome probably for everyone. I just started to learn how to play. I bought this back in august and it has been amazing. I find it easier to learn to play a song if the guitar sounds like what I’m attempting to emulate. There is no sound this thing can not produce and with the preconfigured sets that users put out it’s an endless supply of sounds. From Hendrix to Freddy Fender. When I purchased it I thought it was the 100% cordless one. It was not so I just went ahead and bought that smaller one too. I hate cords, and with my wireless sender / receiver and the smaller spark it’s going to be so freeing to go anywhere. Now if you’re new like me you will love this I promise. I matter who you are. If you’re a pro I am not sure but I am sure you would probably enjoy this as well. Also for such a small amp it packs a hell of a sound. Must buy.

source_doc: Love the color and brightness, but they do not last. I purchased 2 boxes of these lights 2 years ago (march of 2021) to replace old can lighting in our basement and kitchen. Total waste of money as I am going to have to buy all new lights knowing that the ones I have left are going to die soon.

source_doc: Bring the water bottle! Due to a surgery I had, I'm extremely prone to dehydration, so I carry a water bottle with me everywhere I go. My favorite is my Owala Free Sip 32oz. I drive a 2020 Toyota Highlander, and the bottle doesn't fit in the cup holders. So, I've been driving with my bottle between my legs, which makes things awkward and less safe. When I found this cup holder, I was excited about finally having a solution for the car. Tip...be sure to check the size of your cup holder before ordering to be sure you get the right size. I got the large one, and it adjusted perfectly in my console without having to offset. It is big and makes the cup holder the focus of the center console. My husband hates it and told me I just need to use a smaller cup. But when you have to drink as often as I do, that's not a good option. I love this thing, and I love that it's made it safer for me to take care of myself while driving. It's easy to insert and doesn't scratch the existing cup holder or console. Great for me!

source_doc: Great item for the money fixed up my oil leak! I purchased this and was concerned about the low price.  I cleaned it out thoroughly looking for debri before proceeding with install and found none.From reading other "cheap" replacement oil filter housing reviews most folks advocated for replacing the oil and temp sending unit.  The last thing I want to do is strip the engine down as far as I did for one of those.  I went ahead and bought auto part store senders and replaced what was on here.  It may have worked fine I just didnt want to dig back in to the engine for them.You have to take off the upper and lower initakes to get to this.  I found over a quart of oil sitting on top of the engine that I had to clean out.  Once replaced and everything re-installed I am happy to report that I have used my inspecting camera and a simple "dip stick" to try to find oil under the intake and it has come back clean.  I put this in before Christmas so as of this review over a month and so far so good.Very happy that my oil leak is finally solved!

source_doc: Versatile cat shelter. I helped a young feral cat all fall. I bought this shelter for him.  I was impressed with it's sturdiness, and how rain rolled right off.  I stuffed it with straw and he used it regularly.  Recently I found a barn home for him. I have 2 other feral shelters in the back yard so I wondered if I should leave this one out too.  I cleaned out the straw and put a soft rug in it. I put it back in one closet.  I was not sure if my inside cats would take to it, but they did. Now there's a race to see who gets it first. No need to hang a no vacancy sign on it.  One cat is always in it.

source_doc: Easy to set up, a bit complicated to get full measurements. Since I am spending more time in my basement, I decided I wanted to know more about the radon level there. Several years ago, when the house was rented, a one month radon test was done that indicated above standards radon level, so a radon mitigation system was put in. Lately I have been spending more time in the basement, so I decided I wanted more info on the radon levels. There are less expensive radon monitors, but because of the reputation and history of this company, it is the one I chose. Setup is simple, though you don't get immediate readings for radon (though you do for temperature and humidity. You have to wait 3 days to get radon values. When they started showing up on the monitor, the levels increased over the next few days, but were in the safe range. Since I have a science background, I also wanted to see the detailed maeasurements. Airthings has both an app and a web site (called the Airthings Dashboard). Both are needed to get all the information from the meter. The app gives 1, 7 and 30 day average values, the Dashboard gives graphs over various periods. Since I don't have any other monitors to compare with I can't say how this compares in accuracy or ease of use to other systems, but this seems to be working well and indicates my radon mitigation system is working.

source_doc: Finally a mirror that works in my Honda! I was struggling greatly to find a rear facing baby mirror for my Honda Civic.  The reason? All of the backseat headrests are NOT movable! The headrest is part of the seat. Most mirrors with attached straps and gadgets direct you to strap the mirror under the headrest which does not work for my type of backseat. I was trying my best not to purchase a suction cup mirror to place on the window because I knew it would fall off depending on the weather, condensation and so forth. Luckily I came across this mirror, and even with reading reviews, I could not come across anyone who had my same type of backseat issue but gave it a try anyway. I was hesitant because just like the others, it came with straps to go across and under the headrest. Fortunately, I was able to strap the mirror around my attached headrest seat without using the strap used to go under the headrest. I pulled it tight and was able to maneuver the mirror to angle down on my baby perfectly! It works so well and doesn’t move! The mirror is very large so as I looked in my rear view mirror, I am able to see my child fully and clearly! She loves looking at herself too!I am very happy with this purchase- I just wished I bought it sooner!

source_doc: The flies sure seem to like it. Wow. I mixed up a small batch of this stuff and dumped in a maybe half a dozen fruit flies from a store bought culture. I've got loads of flies now. I'm going to need more spiders.I put maybe a quarter cup of powder in a clean quart size plastic container that previously contained soup from Costco. I added boiling water and stirred, adding more water a little at a time until I had a mixture that would generally keep it's shape but would flatten out if I banged the container on the counter. While it cooled, I cut a roughly 1.5 inch square in the lid of the container. When the mixture was cool, I added the flies and put a coffee filter on top of the container, followed by the lid. Then I just set it aside and waited. It took maybe a week and a half before I saw new signs of life. Now I have a very active colony (swarm?) of flightless fruit flies. I've added new members from another store bought culture to perhaps improve genetic diversity. I don't know if it'll do anything. All I know is I had a few flies and now I have a zillion.

source_doc: Simple Tool Makes for Easy Work! I love these. I have been buying them for a few years. Fret polishing is a task that never goes out of style and these fret erasers make easy work of a tedious task. This is the first time I got the 180 grit eraser so I am really excited to see how that will work on some of the more stubborn scratches and tool marks that I find on frets. They are pretty simple to use, I tape off the fret board and then use them just like an eraser. I go fret by fret with each eraser working my way up from the lower grits to the higher polishing grits. This kit has the 1000 grit which I have already but I would encourage buying the 2000 grit eraser or using a finger nail buffer stick to really nail the mirror shine. I not only recommend, but I use them myself and love them!

source_doc: Maybe mine is defective... When this bottle warmer arrived I was so excited to try it.  After unpacking I noticed that ours is missing the lid for the formula cup---we don't use formula so I thought that is not a big deal.  I cleaned all the pieces and charged it overnight for use the following day.  The next day, I took a bottle out of the fridge, found the correct adapter, screwed it on tightly, and set it to heat the bottle to 98 degrees Fahrenheit.  After about seven minutes, the milk was ready.  I turned the warmer so the bottle was upright with everything attached and it leaked milk all over my hand.  After removing the bottle from the warmer, I turned the warmer on its side which is supposed to stop the heating function, but I noticed that the little red light that indicates the device is heating came on.  For a bottle warmer that costs $79.99 USD, this should not leak, and the automatic turning off of the heating element should work as advertised, but the one I received did not.  It is possible that I simply received a dud, but for the price I am not impressed.

source_doc: Fit well and actually work! When buying these I was a bit skeptical because they were so much cheaper than pants from an actual motorcycle store. However, I got a jacket from a store and was trying to save money so I decided to purchase these pants. Unfortunately I got into a motorcycle accident a couple weeks ago; however, I found out the pants actually work!! There was rain on the road, I had to make a sudden stop, my bike lost traction, slid on its side, and threw me off once it hit a car. I must have slid 15ft on the asphalt, got up and was completely fine besides a few impact bruises. On top of me being fine, the pants are also fine, no rips or tears. I will continue to wear them once I fix my bike. After this experience I had to write a review because I did not see any that mentioned wearing them in a accident.A few reviews mentioned upgrading the padding inside, which I could definitely see and probably would have helped with the impact bruises. But overall these pants are WELL worth the price and I would highly recommend. Saved me from some really bad injuries!Will try to upload pictures when my phone is fixed.

source_doc: Worried that it's starting to fail already. I purchased this one after our long lasting heater finally gave out.  At first I was thrilled to have it.  We share it among out front desk staff depending on whose working.  But after just a short while I am wondering if it is starting to fail.  It seemed to be much more worm on the lower setting and it seemed to blow a bit harder than it does not.  I even tried the higher setting. which we don't use a lot, and it also seems to not blow as much or get as hot as it did.For a mild chill like today, it is working, but I am having to have it much closer to me than I did in the past.I am certain going to start looking up the warranty information.Would I recommend?  Considering how worried I am at this point... I don't think I would.  I just hope maybe I am wrong, but I don't think so.

source_doc: Amazing customer service. I bought this headset for my new remote job. The first headset I received, I had trouble with the microphone not working. I did all of the troubleshooting my computer told me. Then I contacted the seller directly. They also had me do some troubleshooting. Next, they asked me to send them pictures of the model number and serial number off of the box. Once sent, they asked me to try some more troubleshooting. Finally, they said they would send me a replacement and there was no need to send back the faulty headset. I was totally shocked. I had already packed the faulty headset to ship it back. They were very quick with their responses. There was no delay in responding. Then I received my replacement headset in two days after shipping. The new headset works wonderfully. They are so comfortable and I love the sound quality. Tonight I will be using them for the first time for class. So I will be able to find out the quality of the microphone. I highly recommend this product and this company.

source_doc: Painful, but maybe it's me. I don't have plantar fasciitis or any particular foot issues, but I could use indoor sandals and thought the massage aspect might be fun. I thought I got the wrong item at first because the (unsealed) box pictures a teapot and herbs, but I guess that's supposed to reference natural healing; the box is actually pictured in the listing. The slippers run about a size small. I would've ordered a size 5 if they had it, but 6 was the smallest and it turns out they are just right. I don't know why the smaller sizes have a rocker bottom while the larger sizes have a flat bottom or why stone is listed as a material. The spikes on the slippers hurt even with socks. It's very hard to endure walking in them. The listing does suggest wearing socks and gradually increasing wear time to ease the pain, so I guess it was to be expected? This kind of thing is new to me and maybe if I had foot issues, I would feel a different kind of relief. The seller did personally reach out and respectfully reiterate that the pain is said to subside by some. That's possible and since I'm not the target audience, I reconsidered that I should remain neutral in rating these. I'll continue trying to get used to these, but if you just need ordinary slippers, don't put yourself through this. They're priced okay at $29.99 plus $5 off.
