source_doc: Works so good but you'll never use this much. First of all my child had mild cradles cap, or so I thought. I used this in the bath and I thought I did it wrong cuz I saw no difference or I thought maybe it wasn't bad enough to work I have no idea. We continued the bath and when I took her out her head was covered in white softened cradles cap flakes! It did work, I just needed to wait I guess. We combed them out etc.  And we ended up doing this for 2 days in a row at bath time And she's never had it again. My only criticism is that I wish there was a smaller volume of this stuff that cost less. I'll never use it all even if I had 5 babies with cradles cap. Unless its like a chronic condition that keeps returning for some idk why someone would need this much. The product itself though it amazing and I highly suggest it.

source_doc: Definitely worth a play at a discounted price. Feels like a PS2 era game in regards to voice acting and hack and slash combat but, it’s actually pretty challenging to master the combat in this game. You can actually do some pretty neat things with the gum and katana strung together. You can also hit and then guard cancel into another attack to save animation frames, the game never explains this but once you get a hang of the combat it’s actually a lot of fun.The huge issue I have personally for the game is that it is somewhat too difficult. I have played the game about 7 hours and beaten a couple of bosses and I understand the gameplay loop and how to play, I just feel the checkpoint system makes the game too challenging. The game itself is difficult, but I genuinely enjoy the combat and the challenge to some extent, I just need more checkpoints after completing a challenging area. Often times I will play through a 5-10 min section of the game, just to die and have to replay it, over, and over again. I feel like I really do enjoy how tough the combat feels because overall it feels fair, but it’s hard to not make many mistakes through the long combat sections and overall I ended up losing interest in the game prior to finishing it. I don’t want the Combat to be easier, I just need more checkpoints.

source_doc: Great Upgrade from HF Cheap Spray Gun! I will start by saying that I am not a professional, really only a weekend woodworker so my experience with HVLP spraying is limited at best.  I bought a discount big box store HVLP sprayer to dip my feet in the waters, only to find that it did not come with a nozzle wrench. After using it a few times and using channel locks to remove the nozzle for cleaning, etc. I decided it was time to buy a wrench, however just finding one is a chore and they tend to cost as much as another HVLP sprayer, so when I found this set I thought "Why Not?" since it comes with a wrench and a couple of other tips.Upon receipt of this gun, I decided to give it a try because I struggled with my cheap gun to get a good finish when spraying polyurethane. All I can say is there is a night and day difference. This gun is easy to set up and the spray pattern is SO MUCH BETTER!!! Not only that, cleaning it seems to also not be as tedious, not sure why because it basically has the same parts. If I ever need to replace it, I will order another one and recommend it to anyone looking to jump into the world of HVLP spraying.

source_doc: Love it! I really like these “mood ease” gummies. I seem to worry about everything, and this supplement has definitely helped with my anxiety.  I imagine it’s because of the Chamomile and Ashwagandha, which seems to work for me. I love gummies so I was glad to see that this product is sugar free. The suggested use is two gummies a day, so one bottle will last a month. The bottle was sealed very tightly, and the product seemed fresh. I really enjoyed the flavor which had a slight cranberry flavor.  I would never have thought to try a product such as this, but I am really glad that I did. As long as this keeps working for me, I plan on continuing its use. I recommend it!

source_doc: These are perfect for me. I am a guitar hobbyist. I like to play for a couple hours at a time and know only a few songs. I love to experiment and just goof around. Since the 80s, the biggest irritation has been guitar cables.. Whether I am tripping over them, snagging them, or the connections get loose and the awful static sound ruins whatever I am trying to play. I hate cables.This is my first set of wireless connectors and I have to saw that I think they are Awesome! No more cables and I can walk around while I play. On top of that, when the wife wants some quiet time, I plug in my headphones straight in to the transmitter and can keep playing. The sound is pretty good and I like the distortion effect the most as it has a slight delay effect. The other effects are good too, but I really like the distortion. I do wish that the sound were a bit louder like my old headphone amps were, but for this price, I am happy with the connectors, just the way they are.

source_doc: Bulky. I have large chihuahua so I ordered the medium according to their size recommendations.  I was surprised at how bulky this collar is.  It was a bit larger in circumference than I expected but I was able to size it down fine to fit, some of the lights are now tucked under, but there is still plenty of brightness.  The battery box and the AirTag holder are big though.  I put it on my giant Chihuahua and he was like, "what the heck is on ma neck, lady?" He got used to it quick.  I do really like the light show.  You can choose your color and your blink pattern.  This collar is bright!  Very visible will be the dog you put this on.  You can see in my one of my pictures the width of the battery box controller, and airTag holder which is what I docked the star for.  This collar is holding up well with our rainy winter night walks, but this thing verges on apparatus rather than collar.  Maybe it's just me having a smaller- but still *relatively* giant- dog and not being used to what a big dog might wear.  It came with a seatbelt adapter but I use a dog seat so I gifted that to a friend who likes it. I don't know how safe it keeps the dog but it keeps her out of the front seat!

source_doc: You Get What You Pay For. EDIT!!! I increased my rating to 4 stars. I think one of the batteries I received is just weaker than the other. I used one of the batteries to screw down some decking today. I drove about 240 screws and the battery was still going. So maybe I got one great battery and one mediocre battery.Here's my original review:The battery life is terrible. I fully charged both of them before use. I put the first one into an 18 volt Dewalt circular saw and cut some pressure treated 2x4's and 2x6's. I made about 12 to 14 cuts before the battery was completely dead. And even at the beginning, when the battery was fully charged, I could tell that the saw was struggling to cut through the wood. With the factory Dewalt battery that's not an issue.I used the other battery in a drill to drive decking screws. It lasted about half as long as I would expect my factory battery to last.Having said that, a 2-pack of Dewalt batteries costs $200, so for $200 I could buy 2 Dewalts or 11 of these batteries. So I guess these are a bargain. But hopefully you have more than 1 charger, because you'll be constantly recharging these.

source_doc: Excellent to aid in learning. After many years away from the piano I am now retiring and attempting to teach myself how to play once again. I purchased a self-taught program which is very effective and came with an 8 1/2" x 11" picture of the keyboard showing the keys. As I am just starting out once again I found myself frequently referring to the "cheat sheet". I'm sure glad I found these keyboard notes which make it much easier to read music. I expected them to be thin but they are much thicker than I expected. I laid them across the keyboard and like the fact that they are slightly angled up as they rest on the keyboard but far enough to the top so as not to interfere with playing music. They cover the entire keyboard from left to right with letters that are large enough to see quite easily and a photo of the location of the note on a music sheet that is smaller and slightly less visible but that's ok the goal is to help me get started but I don't want to rely on them. These are quite durable, I expect them to last a long time and when not needed can easily be stored in the locking plastic box which they arrived in. I hightly recommend these for anyone learning how to play the piano

source_doc: Very Helpful. I first learned of these strips from my orthopedic surgeon. And back then I used them for carpal tunnel symptoms as well as tennis elbow symptoms. Being a former runner in my youth, I'm now dealing with a lot of pain around my patellar tendon area. I have been using compression sleeves for this without any luck. That also ended up hurting other areas on the back of my knees. And I got to thinking, KT tape. I did research on how to use this tape for my knees. I do not by any means recommend anyone to diagnose their own symptoms etc. But I can tell you, I am now in my 60's and this definitely did the trick for me. This is amazing tape for aches and pains that do not require surgery. I am now able to walk better and do more things that I haven't done in a while. Make sure to see your doctor for severe injuries. This tape did give me back my legs so I could walk without hurting after a 30 minute grocery store run etc. And if applied correctly, I can shower a day or two and it still sticks. Thank you for this tape. I can see why athletes use this.

source_doc: Tore My Skin - Also NOT Returnable. Sadly this “gentle” tape stuck too well. After changing my bandage only twice my skin tore as the tape was removed. I do not have thin skin. I’ve used a variety of tapes over the years, and yes skin can tear after multiple bandage changes, it happens, the skin just gets worn down. But I’ve never had it happen on the second change. The tape was really really stuck after just four hours on my skin. I slowly removed the first piece, when that gave me trouble I tried soaking the second piece. It didn’t work. I definitely don’t recommend using this product if you DO have thin skin. And I would think twice about getting this if you’re going to have to change the dressing multiple times.Worse, I had bought two different widths of this tape. When I went to return the unopened one I learned that it is not returnable. If you look at the return policy on the side bar it says it IS return or replaceable. But when you actually click on it the message pops up that says you can’t return it. No, I do not usually click on it when I see you can return it. source_doc: Seemed great until I realized how off it was. I thought this would be the best thermometer ever because it can quietly read a sleeping child’s temp or easily read another child’s temp without contact. We have had this thermometer for 6 months and I thought it was reading accurately the whole time (we have used it maybe 10-15 times) and battery is still great. But when I took my 6 month old’s temp it kept saying 98 or 99 and I just KNEW she felt hotter than that. So I got our the trusty rectal thermometer and sure enough it read 4° higher! I understand it being a decimal off but FOUR DEGREES? That’s unacceptable. I wish I would have done this test months ago so I could have returned it! I got this thermometer because it had thousands of great reviews!

source_doc: Well ... if it's all you've got, it's better than nothing i guess. I really wish I'd taken photos of this after i used it the second time. I hope you have a better experience with yours than i did mine if you do purchase one.

I held off on using to start with but then I had no other option as my son and I were in an accident that rendered his current car seat unusable. Thank goodness I just this one ready to go. I don’t think I’ll ever be able to use a “normal” car seat after the ease of this 360 seat. It’s also very plush and comfy and has all the safety of other evenflo seats!

source_doc: A great dissapointment. The characters are one demensional tropes that I couldn't care less about, the story is bland and predictable and the dialouge is pointless. I feel like I know as much about all of my companions 11 chapters in as I did when I first picked them up and I am A ranked with most of them.The world seems shallow and uninteresting. I have no drive to play the game because I have no feeling of imersion and connection (both important in a story driven RPG) to keep me invested and wanting to fight on.The combat system seems dumbed down and boring. And since, as I said above, the characters are just tropes that I don't care about I don't care when they die beyond losing a unit for battle.Even the character and world design seems lacking.I REALLY wanted to like this game. Three Houses is one of my favorite games of all time, but this just seems like a poorly done nostalgia cash grab.

source_doc: Black and Gold Luxurious Dining Setup. I got sold on this table cloth’s color combination.  A black table cloth with a separate gold sequin table runner is a clever idea.  I thought that the gold fabric was attached to the black cloth, but when I opened the package, I saw that they were two pieces.  Please see the photos I posted.This table cloth is a perfect size for my kitchen's island marble table.  I love that I can decorate my table with just black cloth or spice it up, and I can lay out in the middle of the gold sequin runner.  I could even use a different table-runner.  I think I will buy this company's rose-gold variant, so I can mix and match them.The fabric had no toxic odor.  The black cloth would be easy to clean, but the gold sequin I believe needs careful and gentle methods for removing food stains.  This table cloth plus the gold sequin runner appears luxurious, except for the gold runner edges.  The easiest, fastest, and cheapest way to prevent fabric from fraying is to use sergers and form a zigzag pattern across the edges that this table runner utilizes.  I wish that the manufacturer fold the edges of this table runner and create a seam that would make it perfectly nice.For the kitchen/dining aesthetic, it will bring for a reasonable price, and I would say this gets my thumbs up approval!  Highly recommended!

source_doc: JONATHAN Crystal/Metal LED Table Lamp. I have to say that I am extremely pleased with the Jonathan Crystal/Metal Table Lamp set. These lamps are very attractive, weigh a descent amount, and are made very well. I purchased four of these for the bedroom, and with the crystal stems and brass crystal base these really look elegant. I tend to read a majority of the reviews when I am purchasing a product, and based on those reviews I purchased two sets of these lamps, even though I read a few of the following concerns.  The lamps have an electrical cord that is covered with a lead woven covering, and the top part of the bulb socket has cardboard inserted inside it, in addition to the metal. This could have been a deal breaker for me, but you have many options for the wattage size of bulbs you may use. I also spent so much time looking for lamps on Amazon, and I was so pleased with the appearance of these lamps that I just did not want to send them back. I hope the Designer can eventually afford to use a electrical cord without the leaded woven covering,and a full metal socket without the cardboard insert.  All in all, I am pleased with these lamps.

source_doc: Great auto feeder for those that work long days! This is a great auto feeder for those that work long days! I just changed jobs recently, and I'm now working 12 hr shifts. I was worried about how I would keep my 2 small dogs on their feeding schedule, as I leave before their breakfast time and get home after their supper time. This has been a lifesaver knowing my little fur babies are being fed on a regular schedule. It is simple to set up and very simple to use. The portions that dispense are perfect for my dogs. Now I can control when and how much they eat when I'm away working. I also love the fact that I can watch them and speak to them. Although they get a little excited when they hear my voice, I see disappointment when I am really not there. So I keep the speaking very limited. But sometimes they want to fuss with each other when the food comes out, so I can tell them to stop, and they typically will at that point. All that said, this is a great auto feeder with many features and will provide peace of mind knowing your little fur babies are getting their food, and seeing how happy they are when they do. I highly recommend this feeder.

source_doc: So far, so good. I received this yesterday, so I cannot speak to its long-term reliability.  However, I would like to make a few points.  It is smaller than described. About 4 inches wide instead of the 6.3 inches in the description, which fits nicely on my dash.  I chose the "warm light" color.  Gold really, and this fits well with my other dash lights.  The more popular green would have looked much more like an added, non-factory accessory.  It started working right out of the box; however, I did charge it further before installing.  It took about two hours.  Yes, the instructions are poorly translated  from the Chinese.  As with many other consumers, I wish that the Chinese manufacturers would simply find a native English speaker to write their instruction manuals.  Too proud, I suspect.  In any event, If you have trouble with the directions find a 14 year-old to do it for you.  I'm 72 and I managed.  I set it so that only the time shows.  I would have included the temperature, but it will only show that in Celsius.  I don't need the date and year, so I passed on that, too.  My car does have a factory clock, but it is small and poorly placed.  This does the job.  I'll post a follow up in a year or so if I have any further comments or problems.  If you don't see a follow-up then so far, so good.

source_doc: This made me extremely nauseous. I read the benefits of taking 400mcg of folic acid & decided to entail this in my daily vitamin regime. This may work well for some. For me I had a very bad reaction to it upon taking it the first day. Within 4 hours I became very nauseous. I had to leave work. I knew it was due to putting this new vitamin in my body. I’ve researched folic acid since & wanted to share that there can be side effects from taking it. In some cases one may experience nausea, black stool, constipation, loss of appetite, bloating or gas. I spoke to my Doctor about it. There was no type of adverse reaction with the other vitamins I was taking. It was simply my body didn’t like it. He did ask if I took it with a full glass of water & food, which I did. He said this was important. So a heads up if you’re considering to purchase for the first time. This may not be for you.  I do respect this brand of vitamin. Unfortunately I can’t receive the nice benefits gained by taking it.

source_doc: Pretty Good. I haven’t been in a sleeping bag in a long time.  So I got this and tried it in the back yard.  Well, I picked a cold night with wind, below 30 on the mercury, and it did good.I had no tent which might have been ok if I had no wind.  It was cold.  But I did sleep, about as good as I could expect for the conditions.  I used my field coat to cover my face but the wind woke me up many times.I’m a little over 6 foot and medium build, I fit in the bag.  I feel like my head could have a little more room but it wasn’t a problem.Most importantly for me was having a very thin foam filled self inflating mattress.  it kept me off the cold ground.  And it was much better than being directly on the lumpy ground.  Again, a tent would helped a lot with the wind.Not that I needed it, but the bag has snaps that let it shut without being closed, or maybe there’s another purpose.  The zipper worked great.  The sleeping bag rolls back up easily to fit the carrying bag.I think with a blanket and a tent I would do just fine camping for a weekend.  Hope this helps you.

source_doc: A remake that feels more like two steps backward than a step forward. I grew up playing the original Diamond and Pearl, and besides the notoriously slow engine run, I had really enjoyed those games and looked forward to the remakes. I found BDSP faithful to a fault, while not introducing enough new spins to qualify as a breath of fresh air. The Grand Underground held my interest for only a brief amount of time. Everything else feels stale, rigid, and uninspired. I’m not a fan of the chibi aesthetic, which I’m especially disappointed about since I liked the direction the new games were going with more detailed and realistic models. I have played Pokemon since I was in preschool, over 20 years, and this is the only Pokemon game I have not finished. I stopped playing after getting the eighth badge and couldn’t feel bothered to continue any further. (I did, however, help my sister beat Cynthia on Brilliant Diamond, and I appreciate that they’ve made the notoriously difficult Champion even more difficult. From the remastered music to the competent AI, hands down the best battle in BDSP.) When Pokemon Legends Arceus came out, I dropped Shining Pearl like a hotcake and didn’t look back. Arceus was the breath of fresh air I was craving.

source_doc: Requires you to close your doors into it. I have an older car (Toyota Solara), and wanted this to protect it from the times I can't park in the garage. I've used another cover previously however it has gotten worn down from seasons so I wanted to give this one a try.The good news is that the clips are plastic, which I LOVE. The old cover I used had metal clips, and if one isn't fastened properly, that'll scratch up the car in the wind as it shakes around. I prefer plastic or rubberized clips any day.The bad news, is that they want me to close the doors into this in order to hold it in place. I did not realize that is how it is supposed to work, and I have a major problem with that- The Solara doors don't have a top frame, it is glass against the rubber gasket of the car's top. With material in between like this, you are asking for leaks into the interior of the car around the door seams. I don't like that at all. It fits fine on my other car (Honda Odyssey) but I'm disappointed I can't use it on the car I wanted to.

source_doc: You need this! Love this swaddle carrier! I had one similar to this one I got from Walmart a couple years ago (but I got rid of it thinking I wouldn’t have another kiddo) and I struggled to find one that you don’t have to wrap all yourself until I came across this one. Definitely a great buy for a solid price.

source_doc: Least irritating shave I've had in a while. I didn't think there could be too much difference between these and the other razors I've purchased and have been using. While shaving, these seemed as good but no better than a new blade of the other brands I have. What surprised me, was afterwards when I was applying alum and expecting the burn I typically get there was none. I looked these up and the only thing I could tell that is different (from the details in the listing) is that the grind angle is different than other blades might use. This really does seem to make a difference as the next time I used them I experienced the same thing, and I know for a fact that burning is from the micro cuts you are getting when shaving. Alum on shaved skin exacerbates that burn, but with these so far there has been no burn. Hopefully I keep having the same luck, but I highly recommend these as a result!

source_doc: Just What I Needed. I was looking for a bread cutting guide that cut all the bread the same size, easy to store in a small space and easy to clean.  I did not want the lovely bamboo guides because  they were spaced to accommodate 3 sizes of slices on a somewhat small grid so then I would have to move the bread after every so many cuts in order to have them be the same size.  The key word I was interested in is "easy".  With this guide if I want thicker slices all I need to do is skip a space -- easy! Used this bread cutting guide today and am quite happy with it and would purchase it again. It cleans up easily -- just a quick wipe with soap and water.  However it's crumb catching ability is not great. I just place it on a jelly roll pan and cut away.  If one is giving this item as a gift it, comes in a very nice box.  If you order a white bread guide do not be alarmed if the box shows the red guide on the outside.  I think the red guide just shows up better on the box.  This guide is so much better than the Presto one I had before. I would purchase this guide again.

source_doc: Too Much Fun! When I first ordered this drum I didn't know what to expect, I mean I saw people playing it and it looked cool but now I know.  I LOVE sitting on this box and just banging away! I think it's therapeutic.  You learn how to play it as you experiment with it. There are different ways that you that you can hit it the drum, or cup your hands differently that gives you different types of sounds.  To let you know how solid this box is, I weigh 250 pounds and this drum holds me up with no problems. I don't feel like it's going to break underneath me. I would say it's commercial grade, and the fit and finish is wonderful.  It really is fun to play, and even my adult kids want to play on Dad's drum.  When I'm not using it I use it as a small table for a one of my speakers. It is well worth the money and something that I could see lasting forever if not abused. I highly recommend!

source_doc: 2012 RAM 2500 ST 6.7L  Transfer case switch perfect  replacement. I was stuck and put my truck 4low, and a service 4wd light came on. Once I was no longer stuck, I shifted it back to 2wd hi, and the dash said I was in 4 hi. So I wanted to see if it was in 4wd. My truck is a manual floor shift for the transfer case if that helps anybody, which means no electronic actuator to replace for 529.00, just a sensor (Dorman 600-555 ) for 83.00 at Autozone or 60.00 at amazon. I would purchase it again and I suggest going to Harbor freight tools for a 1-1/2-inch spanner wrench or the spanner wrench set for 65.00. the Spanner wrench would fit in the space much better than huge combo wrench. it took only 25 minutes to remove and install please use dielectric grease in the switch plug to keep water out.

source_doc: On the Fence….Good Microphone With Flaws. My wheelhouse is electronics and security so I have used my share of microphones either in security equipment or setting up electronics for a band. The problem I had with this was volume. Maybe it was the App I tested it with, maybe it bugged me that there was no way to monitor the volume. I don’t do YouTube, so maybe this can be tweaked in editing but this did not give me enough volume for the App I was using even at max. I gave it a generous 4 stars because the sound I heard I guess sounded good but I would not use this anyway as it has to be unplugged to hear what you recorded. I don’t know why anyone would go through that pain. Points for quick set up and instant pairing. I guess I’ll leave the rest to the professional YouTubers but I see no use for this unless you are a pro blogger or something. I thought it would work on calls and I could clip it on and walk around but does not work for that. A niche product for video bloggers.

source_doc: Exactly what I needed in my closet. These are great! There are two different sizes you can order and I chose the smaller ( I think its like 7 inches)  since I wanted to use them in a sliding door closet with limited wall space. I put one on each end, at two different levels and now I can see my clothes so much better when I slide the doors open. My bedroom is dark and its impossible to tell black from navy and I was having to take them out into the next room for better lighting to see what I wanted to wear. Now, I slide the closet door open, the lights come right on and so much easier! And I can make it hand-held if I want an even closer look. They have a magnetic strip that attached them to the wall and it just pops off and on. The bigger size would probably give even more light, but for the space I had to use them, the smaller size work just great. I have mine set at the auto setting so they turn on activated by motion and shut off automatically once the door is closed again after like 20 seconds. But you can also just use the on/off switch if that’s better for you.

source_doc: Easy to install & just work! I had cages on my pedals, but I was primarily riding my bike on a trainer.  I used the cages because I figured my feet would slip, but I didn't want the clicky shoes since I wasn't convinced I was going to ride enough to spend the time finding something that fits...I unhooked my bike and now its going on the road for real.  The cages are just not going to work for me, so these are just right.  I wanted something durable and at least decent looking for my cyclocross bike.  Like I said, I'm not hardcore, so I just wanted something with regular pedals - these fit perfectly and work as I had hoped.  Look cool and have plenty of grip for when I'm casually riding around.  Very satisfied.

source_doc: Not very good quality. I doubt this is truly a therapeutic grade oil. I wasn’t expecting the best oil, at the price…but I was disappointed. It had an unusually greasy feel to it for an essential oil, the smell is basic, and if the sting of clove oil is any indicator of its purity, this is not pure. I’ve put clove oil in my armpits a few times and regretted it. I actually put this one on to test it, and eventually I did feel a little heat. But I wasn’t sure I would at all. I do like the dropper feature though. I bought it to use under my finger nails while fighting a pinworm infection with a toddler, so I didn’t care if it smelled great, I just wanted something I could use frequently after diaper changes. Hmmm, perhaps latex gloves would have been a better choice.

source_doc: Great, until it fell apart! I am in a nursing home, and I had it sitting on a table at the end of my bed. I reached for it with my grabber tool, to pull it towards me, and the side literally just popped off. There are two miniscule nails holding it together, which are as thick as office staples. As soon as that side came off, the rest of it started to come apart as well. I started to do a return, but it said it had to be returned in original packaging, which of course I didn't keep. Or I could get an exchange, but I what if that falls apart too? I noticed that beside the tiny, insignificant nails, there is a trail of wood glue that is about the width of a human hair. I think if they had used bigger nails or more wood glue, it would have stayed together. I'm just going to try and hot glue it back together. If that doesn't work, I have elbow joint brackets I can screw on to each corner. If not for it falling apart, I would have given it 5 stars. The concept is awesome to store your different sizes of zippy bags in. Just wish it had been put together better.

source_doc: It turns off, Glitchy, connection keeps cutting off... Bought it about a year and 6 months ago. I first started noticing that the headset would randomly lose connection and or it would turn off. Usually I would turn it back on and that would solve the problem. This usually happened when I would try to connect to my xbox. I also noticed that in the middle of a game it would drop connection even though it was on and I had not moved anywhere. This started to happen more and more frequently about 3 moths ago. Now as of yesterday it kept turning off over and over again and or dropping connection. At first i thought it was because it might be low on battery. I plugged it in for about 1-2 hours. That did not solve the issue. So i thought maybe the cable does not work right. I checked the cable it was good. but just in case i used another cable as well. It still did not work. When i plug the cables in it shows a green light meaning it is fully charged or close to fully charged. Well it is still turning off randomly at intervals of about 1-2 mins. Yes I even tried keeping the cable on (charging) while the headset was on. It would still turn off. I am no longer within warranty. I guess I will go back to my other headset from  2013 lol. Do not buy they are glitchy!!!

source_doc: As flimsy as paper. I was looking to replace a wonderful bass clef magnet I'd had on my car for many years. I liked the romantic look of this treble/bass clef design, and was excited to get it. It arrived in a regular envelope, and I had no idea what was in it. I almost didn't open it, because the return address was not familiar. When I did open it, the magnet slid out like a piece of card stock paper, and the 2 "dots" that rest on the outer edge of the bass clef were 2 loose little black circles --- not in any way what I expected, and I certainly can't put it on my car. The first rain would wash them off. The extension at the bottom of the treble clef is flimsy & weak. I don't really know what I can do with it. I put it on my refrigerator, because I can't use it for what it was intended, and it won't stick to anything else.

source_doc: Expensive. After watching a few videos I purchased this lacquer to refinish an old Gibson guitar.  I applied gloss black lacquer over automotive primer.  I bought two cans @ $35 for each can.  I followed the instructions and warmed the cans before use. The first can applied fairly evenly but the second can I had all kinds of problems with splatter.  I had to sand out some big globs of paint and put on another coat.  I tried shaking the can, heating warmer and lower but the splatter would not stop.  I had to spray for a couple of seconds then clean the nozzle with a rag to stop the splatter. The other problem was orange peel.  I have used other brands for 1/3 the price and gotten better results.  If I had to do this over again, I would use a less expensive lacquer.

source_doc: Not soft, smelt like burnt plastic, lots of fuzz after the first wash. Despite others reviews, my set came completely the opposite (in a bad way). I got the gray set, and was super excited to use some new, soft towels. That didn't happen.First off, after taking them from the box, removing the bag, they stunk. Like burnt plastic stink.. I HAD TO wash them, because no way was I about to use that on my clean body.Secondly, after washing (cold, light detergent, low spin), and I threw them in the dryer (low heat, light tumble, fabric sheet)... there was so much lint. I am not certain that is normal, but it shed worse than my husky in the middle of July. They aren't losing any stitching, tassels, but it must have been there - somewhere. I know the lint I saw in the catcher was from it because I clean it before each dryer use.Thirdly, they are thin. This might be a good thing in terms of drying times (after bath/shower and leaving on a rack).. but we're talking see-through thin.So overall I am not happy, and I would not recommend INK+IVY Nova 100% Cotton Terry Bath Towel Set. The other reviewers like it, so it is possible I just got a defect. Hopefully so.

source_doc: Beautiful flute, but… This is a very beautiful flute and I was so excited to get it. I hadn’t played in about 30 years and wasn’t sure if I could still play. I was pretty good way back when and really wanted to start playing again.When I started playing, I thought some notes seemed sharp. Well, as I said, it had been a while and I thought it was me. I continued to practice and did not see an improvement in the sharpness. In fact, the flute just got more out of tune as time went on. No amount of adjustment would correct this. Sadly, I was unable to continue to play this flute. It was too hard on my ears. I have returned it and will look at an intermediate flute to purchase. I am glad I tried it however because it sparked that part of me that always loved to play.

source_doc: Weak Sandalwood - Not For My Sensitive Skin. I shave my beard but leave my mustache alone.  I have never used beard oil before.  I just apply whatever facial cream is left on my hand to my mustache.  So decided to try this.The bottles are small and as per the label, each one contains 20ml of various oils.  I uncap each one and use my sensitive nose to check the fragrance.  I love sandalwood soap so the first one I checked was the one in the middle - Sandalwood.  The fragrance of this is disappointing.  I can smell a slight presence of sandalwood but there is also something added that turned my nose off.  The unscented is neutral.  I prefer the chemical composition of cedar wood, vanilla, and sweet orange.Each bottle has a built-in dropper.  The dropper design is not pipette tipped but with a small circular tip.  I guess this is their way of measuring a dab of oil.I dropped a small quantity of sandalwood on my skin to test.  I felt a warm sensation at the beginning.  After a minute I felt a need to scratch my skin.  Hmmm, something in this oil my skin is complaining for.  I will not use this for my mustache since the skin around my lips is more sensitive.I cut my hair short and sometimes I can see that it needs moisturizer.  I may repurpose this beard oil for that.

source_doc: I was unsure at first BUT... I was unsure when I first took this out of it's box. I needed a carrier because I realized I really can't carry my newborn and do other things around the house at the same time. I forgot how useful carriers were with my first son. It's intimidating at first to see all the straps, but once you get this adjusted for your body and baby it's a breeze to snap it right on you. My 6 week old currently loves being close to me and sleeping on my chest. In fact this is his favorite place to take naps in during the day. It gets him settled down real quick when he gets a little fussy. It's so durable and sturdy I don't worry about baby in here when doing anything around the house. I even take this with me at the office, fortunately I own my own business so I can take baby with me to work. For the price it's great, it's worth every penny and more. I plan to use this the whole time baby can stay in a carrier. I love this better Tham the bjorn, which I had with my first son. This is so much more versatile and transforms as the baby grows.

source_doc: Very easy install. I purchased this timer from a local store, just because I was afraid it wouldn't work and could take back. With that being said, this 62 year old female who is not an electrician had no trouble installing this switch. It helped that whoever did the original wiring had the box nice and neat. The only thing I had to figure out was which black wire was the load wire that you connect to the red on switch. Planned on using my tester, but it no longer worked. So I did the next thing I saw when googled. It was the wire that came in from top of box. Wasn't sure I was right, but figured if I was wrong all I had to do was change around. Turned power back on and it worked!!! The worse part was connecting the white to my whites, there were a lot wrapped up together, but I managed. Now for the operation of switch. The buttons are really tiny so not the easiest to push, but I use 40 minutes most of the time for after showering. Have it set so just push the big rocker switch and it starts on 40. You can easily override by pushing any other button. So didn't get 5 stars because of the button size, but I am otherwise very happy with this switch, better than leaving fan on all day cause forgot to shut off.

source_doc: great for walking, a bad back makes it harder to move. I use this daily while watching TV.  My other half uses it to keep moving on rainy or otherwise lazy days.  I love it.  The remote came with a cheap and possibly old battery - it died quick.  Replaced it with a new and expensive one and it is happy as a clam. Anyways, we threw them out because I don't want to take a chance because I thought we were going to have to run to the emergency vet that she might've swallowed one. But we able to figure out there were three and then we called the manufacture, and he confirmed it was three and when I suggested they note it they have those batteries in their toys as a warning but he said it’s on the outside of the packaging.  I could not debate the packing because I ordered it through amazon and I really couldn’t recall if there was special notation on the package it came in. So I thought I would just forewarned when your dog is chewing that there are those tiny little batteries there like hearing aid batteries and be careful!

source_doc: The Strings I Didn’t Know I Couldn’t Live Without. When I first tried these strings I was highly skeptical because they are a fairly heavier gauge than I’ve always used on my stringed instruments.  But when I started playing a friend’s guitar I noticed quickly how incredibly BEND-Y they are!!!  It’s honestly hard to describe how smooth these strings feel.  I ordered some and put them on my favorite Strat, and I loved them so much that they are now on almost every stringed instrument I own!  They last a really long time too because they are pure nickel.  I was ride or die for the vintage nickel fender strings for the longest, but these are BETTER.  I would recommend them to anyone for electric and acoustic stringed instruments.  I like to build and mod guitars for my friends sometimes and I always put these on and even include an extra set because as someone who’s been playing guitar for over 20 years, I want them to experience what I finally “discovered” a couple years ago.  As I mentioned, they last a really long time, but I still subscribe for a new set every month because I like to stock up and I have way too many instruments 🤣

source_doc: Worth the price. I hate chapped lips but I'm particular in what I want in my chapstick. Yes, it's cool that treat beauty offers cool flavor options and I really like the gummy bear flavor. However, there are other qualities in a chapstick that I find more important. 1) I hate when you apply chapstick and then it leaves a residual chemical/chapstick flavor on your lips. I am happy to report that this chapstick doesn't do that. It's slightly sweet, but not with a weird chemical taste. 2) I hate reapplying chapstick every 30 minutes or so. For me a good chapstick will linger on your lips until you eat. I drink water throughout the day and I don't want to reapply chapstick every time I take a sip of water. Yes, I know it will wear off, but a good chapstick wear off slower. This is a good chapstick by my standards.Added bonuses are the variety of flavors, cute packaging and huge size. I just ordered more from the treat beauty website because my daughter loves the gummy bear flavor and I told her she could have it.

source_doc: Excellent protection, no white cast, but sticky. I put Zinc Five-O Baby Mineral Sunscreen to the test against the mid-afternoon Arizona sun which is still super strong, even in winter. I can verify that it provides excellent sun protection with spf 50. Considering it is a zinc product I was surprised it didn't leave that tell-tale white cast that nobody likes but everybody puts up with to get that great protection. The product is thick, non-irritating, and has no real scent to speak of. After applying, it doesn't absorb into the skin (typical of zinc sunscreens), but it leaves a somewhat oily and sticky film that I found super annoying. Because it was a windy day, my long hair was blowing around and sticking to nearly every surface that I had applied sunscreen to. I also had some blowing sand and dirt stick to my arms. Despite this, the sunscreen provided excellent protection for the entire 60 minutes that I was outdoors. The second time I used it, I applied the product only to my face and neck and I followed up the application with a face powder to cut the stickiness, which seemed to do the trick. Because this is a sunscreen for babies, I imagine parents could apply corn starch afterwards if they find the stickiness to be problematic. I, however, will save this product for use poolside this summer because it provides excellent protection and that is really what is important.

source_doc: Nope. I've never used a product like this before, so for all I know they're all like this, but my overall experience was not a positive one.  I tried the Lavender first, which is a hot pink disk, and as soon as I turned the shower on what i got was hot pink coloring all over the shower floor, soaking into the tile grout.  (As instructed, I had placed it out of the way of the main shower flow.)  I was hoping it would all rinse away, but it didn't so I ended up having to scrub the floor.  Not exactly the relaxing spa-type experience I was hoping for.  On top of that, there was  virtually no aroma to the aromatherapy.  The scents of my shampoo, conditioner, and body wash were all stronger, though none of them are that strong themselves.  I was really surprised.  When I was all done--hair dried, etc.--I did notice a hint of lavender in the shower, but nothing while I was actually showering.  All in all it was definitely not worth the magenta mess.

source_doc: This product has changed my life. I care for my elderly father who is confined to a wheelchair but can get himself on the toilet. He is constantly bumping his feet and his toes are always bleeding. As a result when he goes to the bathroom there's always blood on the floor. I take a diuretic and when I have to go, I have to go. I use these pads to stick to the floor in front of the toilet so that if I go in the bathroom and he has been in there bleeding, all I have to do is rip the mat up off the floor, and I can go to the bathroom without stepping in the blood. This product has changed my life and probably saved my kidneys. I will be subscribing to regular deliveries of this product. There are probably so many other uses for these wonderful pads. If I could give 10 Stars I would. Also the price is reasonable for such a quality product.

source_doc: Saved my back and knees! Hurray! I am at that age where sometimes I have to put off chores because I've used up my back or knees or feet for the day.I probably should have gotten something like this a few years ago.  This really is super usefule.  We have a small shower stall, but it was still super hard to get down to clean the floor.  Last time, I sort of tipped over after crouching down to scrub, I was kinda like a turtle on it's back, my leg muscles spasming as I tried to get up.This is so much easier, so far, I have only used the more abrasive scrubby attachment, I pour a little soft scrub, then cleaned the floor while leaning against the wall.  It was probably the most lazy shower clean I have ever experienced.The scrubbie is good at flat surfaces, but if you really need to get at a corner, you have to press really hard to get in there.  I don't know what the solution to that is.  After I was done cleaning the shower, I cleaned and rinsed the attachment and set it  on the top of the washing machine to dry before I put them away.The soft shamm-y attachment is a real conundrum.  I guess it could be used to clean mirrors or windows.  I will give a whirl next time.

source_doc: Cleans well, no water splashes. This mop cleans well. I wasn't sure if water would be splashing all over with the spinning of the mop head but it doesn't, it is contained in the bucket. I like that this comes with so many microfiber mop heads so I can keep some in rotation until I wash the used ones. It is fairly simple to use once assembled, you just have to flip the lever one way when you are mopping and the opposite way when you are spinning the mop. There is no foot pedal like on the original spin mop, this one works by pushing on the metal pole after you flip the lever to rotate the head that you put in place in the metal basket. The basket, mop head and handle spin and the water splashes out of the holes in the basket into the pail. The only thing I don't like is that as I was mopping I kept scraping the floor with the mop as the microfiber yarns moved to the side, I think they need to be a little shorter and fuller because I don't like the feel or sound of that. It also comes with a scrubber brush that you can attach, instead of the microfiber head, which I have not tried yet.This mop cleans well and I like the color too.

source_doc: Amazing quality for a low price. I tested this lavalier microphone on a Zoom call where I wanted to stay connected with audio but leave the room completely. I was connected to the meeting through my cell phone, which I left in my office aimed at a chart when I roamed around my house. (Of course, I could have carried the phone with me during the Zoom meeting, but I was testing the audio at various distances.)  My Zoom meeting partner reported I sounded like I was sitting right in the room. Installing the receiver and microphone was a snap - the receiver plugs in to the charging port of the iPhone, and the light on that receiver blinks red until the microphone is turned on. When paired, the light on the receiver is a steady red (not blinking), and the microphone shines a steady green. The foam windscreens aren't necessary in the house but can be left on if that's the look you want. I am looking forward to using this lavalier when I record voice-over on my next PowerPoint lecture using my iPad.

source_doc: Awesome keyboard for those that loved the IBM Model M. I have been looking for a new keyboard for a while. I have been using a Logitech model that supported 3 computers. It was OK, but the keys were very mushy. I downsized to one computer so I thought why not switch to a new keyboard too. I knew I wanted something similar to my old beloved IBM Model M keyboard, but something without the large size and also had wireless capabilities. After MUCH searching for a decent mechanical keyboard, I focused on the Royal Kludge models. Mostly for the excellent price, as some mechanical keyboards can be costly. I got the 90% model, and I couldn't be happier. The feel is very similar to the Model M, but definitely quieter (although not exactly silent.) What I love most besides the feel is the magnetically attached wrist rest. That feature alone is pretty neat. There are plenty of other options I have yet to explore of fully utilize, such as the lighting of the keyboard. I have yet to play with many of the key mappings either. But I mostly just type, so these features aren't very important to me. Note: I am running Linux (Pop! OS to be specific), and the keyboard works great with Linux out of the box.

source_doc: Sounds Great in the Mix. First, please know that I'm not a great drummer- basic beats, keep it simple, minimal kit, that sort of thing. But I've been singing, guitaring, and songwriting in bands for 25 years, and I'm also a studio engineer, so I know what I like when it comes to how cymbals sound. I recently bought this Wuhan Crash Ride to round out my own small kit for jamming with my buddies, and I didn't really think it was going to be anything special for the money... to me it seemed like buying a Squire rather than a Fender. I do have to say, though, after hearing this thing in a pretty decent live recording of a show we played the other night, I really dig it. It sits in the mix just right, lots of dark wash but not so much sustain that it takes over past where it should fade out. I have a more traditional ride (Zildjian vintage blah blah) that I like, so the Wuhan functions as a crash... but I do find myself riding it a bit, especially on louder songs where I want it to really cut. I love it when the affordable option turns out to be really fun and sounds great.

source_doc: Genuinely Emotional. I can't even begin to describe the wonderful feeling I got when I first used this serum &... Zero Contact Dermatitis!!! None, not even a single red mark. I almost cried! I was SO nervous...I spent months in hell before I figured out I was allergic to synthetic ascorbic acid... I was exhausted, my life was a mess & I had no idea what was causing it or how many products I owned that contained it (topical AND consumable) or were cross contaminated with it (Curology, my Electrolyte Powder, my Vitamins... I was heartbroken)! Ever since discovering my allergy, I've felt like I was on the same exact skincare odyssey I went through in my mid 20's only worse. It's been stressful & filled with a lot of disappointment plus wasted money.But to find THIS product.... Who was the BEAUTIFUL human that thought of this? Bless you!!! There aren't ENOUGH hypoallergenic options in general, but let me tell you... There are almost NO hypoallergenic Vitamin C products!!! They are RARE... & This is one of them. If you're allergic to synthetic ascorbic acid like I am, buy this. Your skin will thank you & you'll feel the deep sense of gratitude that SOMEONE out there cared enough about us.

I have had throat cancer and cannot swallow the large-sized pills that I have taken for many years,  at my doctors’ recommendation. I would prefer chewables (I am NOT a fan of gummies) but I cannot find the option of chewables. However, the “safety cap” (which as an adult I don’t feel that I need) is IMPOSSIBLE to open. This situation NEEDS SERIOUS review. I doubt that I am the only person with arthritic hands who has experienced this difficulty. I DO HOPE someone of concern and decision making powers will see this review and address this situation. (P.S. I am NOT a child NOR am I a mentally incapacitated adult who needs “society’s protection”!)AMENDMENT to REVIEW: This product is UNRETURNABLE … THEREFORE, I AM STUCK WITH A BOTTLE OF GUMMIES THAT I CANNOT OPEN‼️‼️‼️

source_doc: Perfect for small pet food cans. The wet food that I feed my cats comes in small cans and these lids are perfect for saving any leftovers in the refrigerator. They fit perfectly and create a good seal which keeps my refrigerator from smelling like cat food. They’re very easy to wash with soap and hot water. I believe they can even go in the dishwasher but I’ve never tried it. I just wash them when I wash the cat food dishes every night. I’ve had these for nearly a year and they still look and work like they did when I first used them. I highly recommend them for any pet owner that needs to save leftovers.I should mention that I took one of these over to my Mom’s house after Thanksgiving because she wanted a top for leftover canned cranberry jelly (you know the type of gross wobbly cranberry stuff in a can that is somehow a staple of Thanksgiving every year) and she hasn’t returned it because she really likes it. I can’t fault her for that so I guess I really should buy another pack of two. Life is easier when you have more than one of these so I suppose what I’m trying to say is that you should buy more than you think you need. :)

source_doc: So convenient! My old pill organizer broke so I needed a new one. After comparing so many, this was my choice and I have been very happy with it. I don't actually take meds 3x daily, but in the morning I take vitamin C and biotin that are both chewables. So I put those in the center compartment. I love that the containers can be removed for travel when I might not need to pack the entire week's worth. I have had to come up with a way to easily fill these with my pills which is a little less convenient with the individual containers, but still worth it. I actually purchased 2 of these so that when I am filling them, I do both at the same time and don't have to deal with it as often.

source_doc: Good lock for the price. I like this lock so far.  I attached the mount to my bike via the water bottle bolts, but I decided to move it to my bike bag instead.  The mount worked fine, I just missed having my bottle there.  This lock is pretty heavy, which is to be expected.  It is large enough for any bike rack and most poles I would use to lock up my bike.  It is too short for locking down your frame and front wheel to a thick pole.My only complaint is that the coating might end up scratching or wearing the paint on my bike.  This has not happened yet since I don't lock my bike up often, but I really wish there was some rubber on the parts that contact the bike.  I am considering adding some foam tape or something similar to limit the wear.All in all, this is a great folding lock for the money.  I like to budget about 20% of the bike's value for its lock so this falls well within that range for most of my bikes.  I will still use higher-security locks for any very expensive bikes, but that is just due to the higher risk involved.  This lock is far more secure than most cable locks I have seen and is much easier to carry than a U-lock, so this gets my recommendation.

source_doc: Super soft exactly what I was looking for. I bought this bc I have a hole in one of the cushions of my couch and I just don't have the money to buy a new couch. Anyway. This cover is really nice. It feels super soft like a brand new couch and super stretchy. I got a large for my couch and I think I could've used an extra large since my cushions are very big. I'm 8 months pregnant and i got it on by myself in maybe 10 minutes after I figured out how it was supposed to go. It's mostly walking circles around your couch pulling on it until it doesn't look weird. I also obviously didn't care too much about that, it covered a hole. I got black because it was the cheapest, if you don't like obvious pet hair or dirt marks, obviously black is a bad choice for you, be aware of that. Overall it's super nice and I'll probably buy more to keep rotating until I can buy a new one but I'm super happy with this. I haven't tried the water resistant factor but even if it's not, I'm not mad about it.

source_doc: Advantage 2 For some reason my indoor cats keep getting plagued with fleas (my BFF thinks it's from the vet). I ordered Advantage 2 for my socialized cats and for my ferals I ordered an oral medication. Once I put the Advantage 2 on my adults, shortly afterwards I started noticing that one of my cats started scratching alot less. He seemed to be the one most plagued anyway. I read from another reviewer that it will take a while to break the cycle. In the meanwhile make sure all laundry is done, floors are cleaned, etc. I don't have rugs, so that's a plus. I use blue Dawn to mop my floors (it kills the fleas on contact). I just recently bought RAID for fleas too. Seems that it kills fleas on contact according to another reviewer (I agree. No sooner I sprayed the RAID I noticed that the fleas stopped biting.) Will be spraying all surfaces that I can't wash. It surely pays to read other reviews!! You learn alot from it. I don't buy anything unless it's a 4.5 stars review or better.UPDATE: 2 weeks later and I see my cats scratching again. I'm disappointed 😞.

source_doc: Haven't even had it 3 months... This mattress was great at first, but I got it for my son on November 14th for his Graco Solano crib. I loved that I didn't have to purchase a protective cover for it, as the material covering the foam allowed me to wipe it clean easily. But this is a terrible mattress for toddlers - for infants, it should be fine. My son is 16 months old and is walking around and loves to jump like a maniac in his crib. He grabs the side and goes to town like it's a trampoline. This mattress was not made with that thought in mind, as you can clearly see in the pictures that it busted open. I was getting my son ready for a bath and put him in the crib stark naked for only a moment, and he proceeded to immediately pee on the mattress. I figured, no big deal, I could just wipe it clean after his bath and change the sheets while he played in his playpen. When I removed the sheet, I saw the damage, and he happened to have peed over the hole and the urine had been absorbed by the foam. Now I have a peed on mattress whose inside I cannot clean, and I'm not about to let my son sleep on a mattress that is damaged and unsanitary. I will just have to purchase a different mattress that possibly requires a mattress protector.

source_doc: Awful Taste, no noticeable positive results.... I bought these, despite the reviews on how bad they taste.  I thought I could hold my breath and chew it.  I was wrong.  These are the worst thing I have ever tasted (vanilla probably makes it worse) and they do clump up in your teeth.  I barely got one down and would not try a second.  I blended two more to a smoothy and drank it (in the evening).  I have to admit, I slept quite well that night, but no help after that.I then ended up crushing the rest with a meat tenderizer and put them into capsules myself.  I had to take quite a few at once, but I could swallow them.  I did not notice any improvement with sleep, anxiety or energy after taking it this way.  I will not buy again, as I am not convinced they help with any of the things I needed them for.I would like to add that my not liking this particular product would not prevent me from purchasing from Dr. Berg's shop in the future.  I trust his advise completely and get a lot of valuable information out of his videos.

source_doc: Great for smaller mums but. So after almost a month trying this product, I have a love hate relationship with this item. After trial and error 6 bras, ace bandage and even trying a corset I couldn't accommodate the product to stay on my chest. I feel this product is more accommodating to small/med chested women. I even tried to micky mouse and place a different suction funnel to it to accommodate my large chest but to no avail.So I had a friend use it for her new baby and it helps her. She's a 36B and it works perfectly for her which is why I'm fine and love the product because it's helping a another mum. To avoid milk spillage we had to get a big bowl and then funneled the bottles which was just too much.Overall I give the product a 3/5

source_doc: Make the clay bar process much easier. So when I picked up my car from an overnight stay at the service center, I was beyond livid.  Some ‘genus’ left my pristine black car parked by their sprinklers and it left horrible water spots.  After the tried to wash them off with no success, I took it home expecting a long tedious day of detailing to try to get my paint back to normal.  While I know that using a clay bar does not usually remove water spots, I decided to try these clay mitts anyway because nothing else was really working.  I made sure to keep the area of the paint and the clay mitt well lubricated with the aerocosmetics wash/wax spray I use.  I used no pressure because Tesla black paint scratches extremely easily.  After two times, the spots were almost gone - even the deep ones.  I then used a polish to make sure I had not swirl marks and now my car looks even better than it did before.  The process took a fraction of the time I expected to spend.  The quality of the Ragnify Clay Mitts are really good and saved my paint.

source_doc: Everyone should have one of these. I went out Christmas Eve (Subzero temps outside) to go to my bother's house and my car didn't start. Fortunately I was home and my neighbor was able to help me. I realized that I didn't want to depend on someone else to keep my car running  so I ordered this. The day after I got this I went out again (now much warmer) and my car wouldn't start again.  I hooked this up, turned it on and my car started right up. It was easy to use and its great peace of mind to know I'm safe if this happens when I am out and about. This is something everyone needs in their car but especially women.  My only "complaint"  is I wish the cables were just a few inches longer. This would make the hook up a little easier.  I have tried several other brands that had good ratings and they didn't work.  This one is great!

source_doc: Initial thoughts are good. I went from a hard folding cover to this one due to the weight of taking the cover on and off. I just always kept the hard cover on but I bought an ATV that will be riding in the bed of the truck. I like having something over the bed when driving around. I've never had a soft cover before, but that was the only option to get away from the weight. I went with this one as I needed the bed rails free for a removable rack I use with the tonneau. This one sits nice and flush. The only reason I took a star is the cover is completely flat, it has some ripples in it that run the length of the bed. I'm thinking this will probably settle, but for now I'm taking a star. The only other slight issue is the front clips are harder to snap in place than I expected. Again, I think this will probably resolve once it's been installed a while.Update: Had to return it. Maybe it's the tailgate mat I have installed or the way it fits on the rails, but the tailgate hits on the rail and makes it really hard to close. I have the rail all the way forward and it's still hitting on the drivers side. I can close it, but it's much harder.

source_doc: One glaring issue for my instance. I really like this. My only issue that I ran into was corrosion on the battery whip side. They do not have any sort of protective heat shrinking where the wire is crimped to the metal connector. I mounted my quick connect to the front diver side of the bumper of my truck this past June and it corroded this winter. I live in Western NY where road salt was certainly a factor. I bought loom to encase the wires and taped it but, never looked at the original wires at the connection point. Luckily, I had enough extra wire that I was able to cut off the corroded wire and I soldered new connections, put dielectric grease on the area where the wires were reconnected and then used heat shrink over the section where the new connection was made. I hope this review helps anyone who buys this. I would buy this again, I would just make sure I used the grease and the heat shrink before I installed it.

source_doc: Okay cheap grinder. I've been getting into whole bean coffee here recently and I wanted something that I could fine-tune better than an electric grinder so I got this.  It came packaged just fine and I didn't see any defects or dings on the grinder.  It is basically 3 main pieces the handle which has a plastic knob, the grinder which has all the guts, and the collection bin which catches your grounds.  I got a whole bean that I hadn't tried before and loaded it up and got to grinding.  The grinding while okay didn't feel that great and I had to put a bit more muscle behind it than I had to for my other grinder.  Cleaning it was a breeze, it says not to get it wet so I took it most way apart (I left the grinder guts in) and took my electronic duster, and just blew it out.  For how cheap this is it does its job well I'll probably take this one with me when I go on trips because if it gets lost or broken eh no big deal, but if you want one for home I would spend a couple of bucks more.

IF u can find some strongman with way more strength than I have who can actually get the parts screwed together into their proper place, I would think it would provide u with a useful and durable stand/storage for your TP. source_doc: Nice to have on the road. I ordered this because I stay on the road and thought that it would be a good addition to my vehicle. Not only was a well packaged, but I love the fact that it is rechargeable and it really does seem like it’s of decent quality.

source_doc: Looks can be deceiving.... I really hate this clock.I'll start with what I like about it (which isn't much).It looks beautiful, very elegant and classy. Nice and large, easy to see from a distance.It keeps the perfect time. Doesn't make a sound.That's it. That's all I like.Now what I hate about this thing...It's super flimsy! I thought it might shatter just by putting two AA batteries in it.It's made of acrylic which is no big deal, it just makes it really lightweight. I doubt anyone who sees it on your wall would know that it wasn't real wood, but still feels like cheap plastic to me.The pendulum.... ohemgeeeee I really HATE that thing! It doesn't move AT ALL! I have tried everything under the sun to get that thing moving and nope, it just sits there staring at me like it's claimed it's victory by not budging. It honestly makes no sense, it only goes on there one way. And the pendulum is the only metal component in this clock. Everything else is plastic.Overall, it makes me mad just looking at it. I'm glad I got it on the vine because I definitely wouldn't have paid $50 for it. That would have been an instant return! It's all plastic, super flimsy, but looks really nice and does keep time. That's the only reason I gave it two stars. You can definitely find something much nicer for the same price elsewhere.

source_doc: Batteries. So far I do like this wet vac. I've discovered that if I don't run a dust mop over the floors first, the "suction pipe needs cleaning" command is given. If I dust mop first, I totally avoid needing to stop, dump dirty water, flush out dirty water tank, and then resume. If I don't dust mop first, I need to rinse the "suction pipe" maybe 4-5 times. After self-cleaning, I do take a rag and hand dry the rollers, they're pretty wet! Also, I find every time that there's material that needs to be wiped out of the roller compartments, and where outlet where the dirty water is conduited into the suction pipe of the dirty water chamber. I have a question in to the seller as to how to change out the rechargeable batteries. I looked everywhere, called Amazon, and they gave me a link to do this. All that being said...it's STILL steps above my old mop and pail! I am not regretting the purchase, which was made a couple of months ago...

source_doc: Condominium life assurance. I live in a condo and one thing I learned FAST was that pug + beagle + separation anxiety = howling and barking all day.  I've tried the citronella collars, thunder shirts, and standard bark collars but keep on the lookout for something that's user friendly and effective.This was priced right where I look for and seemed to have a nice interface.  I don't use it often but when I do, I know whether or not it's working thanks to doggy cams.  I like that I can disable shock mode - usually the vibration are enough to correct the barking and even the beeping is a good warning that a vibration is next.  I also like that unlike other collars I know when I should charge it before it dies on me.  It's good looking and effective and has a bunch of little features like longer prongs and prong covers.It worked for my dog without hurting him so yes it's been a game changer for me.

source_doc: Pretty good just watch out for the fleshy parts of your feet they can get caught. I have intermittent dry soles on my feet where I can just peel strips off (woo boy this review started well)  so I got this to help me get all that gunk off my feet.  It comes with the machine, 3 heads, and a charger (a double barrel charger I wish it was USB c but oh well).  The first charge took about 2 hours so that wasn't too bad.  Before I fired this up I looked at it and it has a small flashlight on the bottom so I guess that's good if you are working on your feet in the dark.  It has 3 speeds 0 (does not move), 1 (goes at a decent clip, and 2 (really gets going.  I decided since it was my first rodeo to use 1.  IT works pretty well and stripped the dead skin off but I did notice if I got to a fleshier part of my foot it could catch and that didn't feel the greatest.  I chalk that up to my not being careful.  All in all, if you are looking for a way to pamper your feet or just take off dead skin this works pretty well.

source_doc: I put this thing through the ringer. Reviewing "Wahl Color Pro Cordless Rechargeable Hair Clipper & Trimmer – Easy Color-Coded Guide"I'm a gym rat / exercise buff with bodybuilding background that puts this thing to full-body use.  I've now bought four of these things over the past 3-5 years (same exact one I'm reviewing here), and it's fantastic.  I keep the blade cleaned and oiled, and I *always* keep a blade guard on it when not in use so as not to scratch or full the metal blades.  My main point is that if you take care of it, it will last pretty decently.  The reason I've bought four or five of these is because I use them like crazy (yes, full body shaving, including haircuts).  Compared to older products that I bought in my youth, I like the wide blade for greater surface area (faster job done), and the variety of guard sizes (as I also cut the kids' hair).  Oh, as to why I've bought several of these it's because they don't sell just replacement blades--at least not that I can find.  Therefore, for the cheap price, I just go ahead and buy a new one.  Anyway, I like them and recommend them.  If you're a professional barber, you probably would use something else, but I wanted battery powered so no cord.  I also try not to get water into the mechanism.

source_doc: Do not use two days in a row when starting out. I have fairly sensitive skin, and was careful when reading the directions about applying daily. I tend to get milia under my eyes, my cheeks and chin so I was hoping this would keep it from developing. I used the first day and had no issues so I thought I was safe to use it again the second. Again, I was ok. Third day, I was working out and sweating quite a bit when I felt my face start to burn. It was annoying but nothing alarming. I immediately thought of the retinoid. I took a shower and washed my face. Afterward it was burning so so bad. Even applying my regular moisturizer stung. The next day I realized it had completely destroyed my t zone. The corners of my mouth, under my eyes and nose were so raw and peeling. Even applying light make up hurt so bad. It’s been three days and I am still trying to put as much moisturizer on my face as possible just to get it back to normal. I hate to completely bash a product that may be a god send to someone else. It’s just not for me and I highly advise not using it daily in the beginning even it feels fine.

source_doc: My dog started using this as a chew toy. I purchased this because slip leads seem to be recommended and my dog was pulling a lot. My adopted dog was like a completely different dog once out of the shelter. When I first saw her at the shelter, she was calm, no pulling whatsoever. I sign the papers and she immediately started pulling and running up to each thing.I noticed that the leash they use for the shelter dogs was a slip lead and the leash they give you upon adoption is a standard. I thought it must have something to do with the leash and ordered this one.While she walked better on this leash, she would also rile herself up and decide to start attacking it and playing tug of war. I saw a video on how to turn your slip lead into a harness - it worked better, but wasn't perfect. I ultimately switched to a short leash and harness because I can almost hold the leash loosely without problems with that combination. Even if I hadn't gone that way I wouldn't still be using this leash - someone else walked her for a few days with it and I didn't notice till later it has been chewed through - if she did decide to run I could not trust the leash in its current state to restrain her.

source_doc: Versatile and the perfect size, I wish the keycaps were transparent. I really like this size in a portable keyboard. It's small enough that it'll fit easily in a backpack but big enough to have cursor and function keys. All it's missing is the number pad and I can always get a standalone one of those for the occasions that I need it.This keyboard connected very easily with the included cable, dongle and also over Bluetooth. I noticed no typing lag in any mode, but I wasn't using it to play games. The dongle slips into a little pocket underneath the keyboard to reduce the chance that it gets lost. The included instructions are brief but comprehensive.The keys feel great to type on. You can definitely tell you hit the key but it's not super loud like some other mechanical keyboards. The spacebar makes a different and louder sound, but I like that too.There are plenty of backlighting options, and the keyboard remembers the last one you set. My biggest complaint is that the keycaps are not transparent, so it's harder to identify the keys in the dark. A minor quibble is that I don't like the side-by-side notation for shifted keys, I prefer when the shifted key shows up over top of the non-shifted key.Overall, I think this is a great portable keyboard with a lot of versatility in connections. I only wish the keycaps were transparent.

Эта клавиатура очень легко подключилась с помощью кабеля из комплекта, ресивера, а также по Bluetooth. Я не заметил/а никаких задержек при вводе текста ни в одном из режимов, но я и не использовал/а ее для игр. Нажатие клавиши отчетливо чувствуется, но клавиатура не слишком громкая, как некоторые другие механические клавиатуры. Пробел издает другой, более громкий звук, но мне это тоже нравится. Есть множество вариантов подсветки, и клавиатура запоминает последний выбранный режим. Моя главная претензия заключается в том, что кейкапы непрозрачные, поэтому клавиши труднее различить в темноте. Небольшая придирка: мне не нравится боковое обозначение дополнительных символов на клавишах, я предпочитаю, когда символ, вводимый с Shift, расположен над основным. В целом, я считаю, что это отличная портативная клавиатура с широкими возможностями подключения. Жаль только, что кейкапы непрозрачные.

source_doc: Stay away unless you are short. I loved the way the windshield looked on my 2020 rebel 500 but, when I went above 50 mph the wind hitting my helmet made it vibrate so bad that it blurred my vision and gave me a headache. I tried different riding positions but nothing worked unless I stayed ducked down. I am only 5’8” so I’m not that tall to begin with. I tried to return the windshield and they declined the return stating that since I used the windshield they wouldn’t accept it back. I only had the windshield attached for one week So buyer Beware. If I was only riding in town and never over 50 mph then I would recommend it but since I am more of a daily driver going 40 miles one way and the average speed is 60 mph there is no way I would recommend this windshield to anyone. Plus I would not recommend this seller for any purchase since it looks like they will find any excuse to not refund. This is my two cents on this product so take it or leave it.
