source_doc: Works as well as the name brand. This product is very similar to the name brand purple shampoo and conditioner that I had been using. The shampoo seems like it is a clarifying shampoo and leaves my hair feeling a little rough, after I use the conditioner it is soft and moisturized. The directions are to leave the shampoo and condition on 3-5 minutes each. When I was using this I felt there was no scent to this product, no perfumes or unpleasant scent. It smelled like nothing at all. After I read reviews stating that it smelled of peppermint I went back and smelled it while in the bottle and I guess it does small vaguely of peppermint.The results are the same as the others, soft hair, but can't tell if either is doing anything. For reference, I had natural red hair, and the front is quite white, while the back still has red (dye) coloring at the ends, the new hair growth is dark, not red like when I was young. The white part of my hair is not brassy at all, nor is the new growth, and I have been using purple shampoo about once or twice a week. So I can't say if it's the shampoo or not, but my hair does feel moisturized with this shampoo.Very purple coloring, does not stain the shower or shower curtain.

source_doc: Love it! Very sturdy little stool. I hate to say it but I am 420lbs and getting one of these I was worried I would break it when I sat on it but this little handy dandy stool is pretty darn sturdy. source_doc: I bought a bunch of these and so far, so good. I bought an air purifier for each bedroom in my house and I have a big Winix downstairs to help combat our outrageous fur and dust issue. I like these little ones because they are really really quiet on low. The high setting is a little much sound-wise so I have to agree with other reviewers that there should be a medium setting to move more air but still be quiet. But I do keep them on low and they seem to collect plenty of stuff so I can't complain too much. The color is a little odd, but pleasant if you like blue. I can't comment on the sleep mode because I never use it. I just leave them on low at all times instead. I don't use the light up function either because I like my bedroom dark when I'm sleeping. Overall, I think that for the price, they are a good deal and every little bit helps in my house full of cats and dogs. I also like that you can get filters easily and it's made by a big name brand instead of a small company overseas that could stop offering filters at any time. I think this a good buy and I like them.

source_doc: I can finally play the high notes. I am an adult casual learner of recorder. I started playing on a $12 yamaha plastic recorder and upgraded to a $30ish dollar wood recorder because I couldn't manage to play high notes. I like the tone of the wooden recorder for the most part but I have the same trouble with notes higher than "G" and couldn't really hit high "B" or "C" at all. With this recorder I am able to hit all of those notes. It's still not super easy but I'm getting better all the time, much less squeaking - the dogs are very thankful. I have read that the arched airway gives more "control" over pitch. As a beginner I can tell that this will be difficult for me as I can vary the pitch a lot unintentionally, would probably make an experienced player cringe. I downloaded a tuning app so I can work on being consistent with my pitch.I also really love the feel of this recorder. It feels more lightweight, refined and well built. I also like the snap on thumb rest. I am pleased with this purchase.

source_doc: Received Broken Twice, could be great if not broken. I think this product could be great - AMAZING - even. I was so excited to get it. May the odds be ever in your favor that it doesn't arrive broken.

source_doc: There are 2 white wires. This is going to take some playing to determine which is the hot and which is the neutral. I have never seen any light fixtures with all wires being the same color.The light is pretty enough to look at. It's  a light for an RV, how pretty does it need to be? I bought it to provide light in a space with no windows.Having to wire one way and hope it works, then possibly have to switch the wires to make it work is stupid. A little tape or marker on the hot or neutral can not cost that much.Further, there are no instructions,  nada, zip, zilch. It's a good thing I just replaced 5 other lights in the RV or this would be going back. I'll have to mark a wire so I know which way I had it if it doesn't work the first way I try it.Also, there are 8 holes in the light for screws, but only 4 screws provided. They should be enough, but why put in 8 holes if you only need 4 screws?The light is led, so energy efficiency should be good. I don't pay for electric where I currently am, so I don't know how much savings there will be. I may update after I get this thing up.

source_doc: The seam is so close to the curved edges at the bottom that it could eventually rip. I have a 30 oz. insulated water bottle that I strive to fill 3X with water to drink throughout the day.  I take it with me when I drive, positioning it in the cup holder.  However, there are times when I walk that I wish I could take my water bottle with me.  I ordered this 2 pack of Tainehs Water Bottle Holders because I figured my bottle would fit inside it based upon the product page's measurements: 7.4" X 3.5", and my boyfriend could use the other bottle holder when we go hiking.  I like the rectangular shape to fit keys, a Chapstick, a protein bar, etc.  I could slide a credit card, money, ID, etc. in the front zipper pocket, in case we stop somewhere to walk and shop.I think these water bottle carriers are handy. The nylon material feels durable. The inch-wide strap is adjustable.  My only concern is the stitching.  The seam is so close to the curved edges at the bottom of the black one that it could eventually rip and come apart at some point.  The pink one isn't as bad.  (See photos.) The current price of $16 might be a bit high, IMO, but you do get 2 of them.

I also love to use it to do my makeup as one of the settings resembles daylight. This versatile lamp is very worth it for the price point. I am glad I took a chance on it!

The brightness is adjustable. There is a switch to turn it on, off, or automatic. The little metal discs that the light magnetizes to are simple to adhere to a myriad of surfaces. I applied them to a melamine shelf so I’m not worried about removal should I want to move them. I would be cautious of applying to painted surfaces unless you plan on it being permanent.These have been perfect in my closet for low light for nighttime or early morning when I don’t want the brightness of over head lighting. I love them so much that I am getting more under cabinet lighting in the kitchen. They would also be perfect for a dark cupboard or linen closet that doesn’t have its own light. Honestly, I need them all over my house!The battery life seems to be long lasting and charging them are quick and simple. You can’t go wrong with these lights!!

source_doc: My dog loves them. I have a dog with heart disease that usually does not mind taking his pills but at times one may be too bitter so I got him these. As far as flavor, I have not tasted them but I can say that the hickory ones are the most liked by all my dogs. When I give my sick dog the pills, the others want the soft chew too, so I give them one  as a treat when they see me. Before I used to buy the chicken flavored ones and only my sick dog took them. The rest were not interested. They didnt smell. The hickory ones smell strong and like real human food. I almost want one from the smell. I like that they are soft and moist and do not crumble. For bigger pills, I cut them and put them in there and I can remold the little ball. Have not tried the peanut butter ones but I will stick to the Hickory as all my dogs love them.

source_doc: Works well for me. I have bought quite a few Camilla  hair barrettes.  I like the rubber on the clasp and I like the way they look.  Nicely made and hold up well.  I think they're worth the extra cost as you get what you pay for.  I do not have a lot of hair, very fine, medium length.  This clip holds my hair in a ponytail and because it's wider than a hair tie, I think it might make it look like I have more hair.  I think it would be too small or people with thicker hair.  They have plenty of 4" clips that would be better for really thick hair in a ponytail.  Of all the Camilla barrettes I have, none have ever come out of my hair, even with my hair being so fine and thin.  I even have some of the bigger ones and they work fine for me, but this size is ideal for my type of hair in a ponytail.  I would really like to see some models wearing their hair accessories so I could get a better idea of what they look like.

source_doc: Looks Nice, Quality Is Good, But... ...it didn't fit the dog I ordered it for. Did I measure wrong? I don't know, but I usually order a small or medium for my Chiweenie, this time I ordered a medium and it just doesn't fit. It's too small. The velcro straps barely touch when I put it on him, and it's too big to fit my next smaller dog.However, the quality is very good. It appears very sturdy and well made. I like that the velcro area on the strips is pretty big, so it really offers a secure closure, plus the 2nd closure option, the buckle, also feels sturdy.It's not adjustable in the sense that you can't shorten or lengthen any straps, but it is adjustable in the sense that you can adjust the velcro closure to fit.It's mesh and breathable and looks quite nice. The only thing I would see as a con, (instead of a "pro"), at least for me, is that it doesn't have a any stretch like other similar harnesses do. I feel like with a little bit of stretch, there's a little bi of give, so it doesn't hurt him if I happen to pull on the harness. Some owners may not want any stretch, so I guess this just depends on preference.All in all, I do recommend it based on quality, but unfortunately, it just didn't fit. Make sure to measure correctly!

Не знаю, но обычно я заказываю размер S или M для своей чивини, а в этот раз заказал/а M, и оно просто не подошло. Слишком мало. Лямки на липучках едва соприкасаются, когда я надеваю его на пса, но при этом оно слишком велико для моей другой собаки, которая поменьше. Тем не менее, качество очень хорошее. Оно выглядит очень прочным и добротно сделанным. Мне нравится, что область липучки на ремешках довольно большая, так что она действительно обеспечивает надежную фиксацию, плюс второй вариант застежки — пряжка — тоже кажется надежным. Оно не регулируется в том смысле, что нельзя укоротить или удлинить ремни, но регулируется в том смысле, что можно подогнать застежку-липучку по размеру. Оно сетчатое, дышащее и выглядит очень симпатично. Единственное, что я счел/ла бы минусом (а не «плюсом»), по крайней мере для меня, это то, что оно вообще не тянется, в отличие от других подобных шлеек. Мне кажется, что если бы материал немного тянулся, был бы небольшой запас хода, и собаке не было бы больно, если я случайно потяну за шлейку. source_doc: My 50 lb. doodle loved the velvety-soft bed immediately! I have wanted to get a better dog bed for our 50 lb. labradoodle.  I added an extra pillow in the bottom of his old bed, but it still sank and wasn't very supportive.  I ordered this  Bnonya Store Orthopedic Dog Bed and hoped the size was big enough for him.  Before I even received the dog bed, I got an informative email from the Seller explaining how to open the packages and air them out for a few days.  We decided to use a pair of scissors, instead of a knife, to make a small cut and then slowly tore open each package.  I let the velvety-soft sofa bed rest, unzipped, while hanging over the top of a Lazy boy chair. I then noticed the nonslip coating on the bottom, which will prevent future slips into and out of the bed.  I positioned the foam pad on our sofa.  Both covers are thankfully machine washable.  This is necessary because our doodle does get stinky.  I waited about four days until I put them together.  My 50 lb. doodle loved the velvety-soft bed immediately!  The thick, supportive foam felt good, and it was the perfect size, after all.  I'm glad I ordered one.

source_doc: I couldn't consistently keep the remotes charging. I was really excited to find this product! I have the old Wii system and I have several remotes and I thought this was a great solution to be able to use that system again. However, the product was cheaply made and it seemed to be a wobbly docking station. Once everything was plugged in and remotes were set on the charger the slightest movement stopped the charging process on some remotes. I would mess with the remote on the station and it would start charging again. But, whenever I went back to check it always seemed like a few of them were not charging again. So, I would readjust it to get it charging again only to come back and find that some were charging and some were not. After 15 to 20 minutes of this I decided to return it. I have no idea what triggered it to stop charging. But, the slightest movement seemed to disrupt the whole base. And if you left it alone it still had issues with the position of the docking station and where the charger sat. it was too much of a headache. So I returned it.

source_doc: Looks and feels great. I thought I'd try these in my old, 2010 Prius after having replaced the original leather with  cheap vinyl seating elements. The vinyl was cheap but professionally installed. It looked ok, but did not wear well. So, I thought I'd give these a try.  Now, I wish I'd known about Karcle before I replaced the original leather.  I'm more than pleased with this product; I actually learned something from the experience.Because my Prius has heated seats, installation was a little more difficult. I went through contortions securing the elastic ties that go beneath the seat and hold the bottom element in place. But if your seats aren't heated and there aren't a lot of electronics under them, you won't have this problem. In any case, after a brief struggle, I got both pieces on. They look great and feel very comfortable.  The material--nappa leather--appears very durable. It's supposed to be washable. Time will tell, but right now, I'm in love with these.  I didn't need to replace the rear seating because nobody every sits there.Update:  after a few weeks driving, I've come to love these seat covers. They look great and feel better than the third rate vinyl that was professionally installed. No, they're not as tightly fit as they vinyl, but they look and feel a lot better.Update: After a few weeks of driving I like these seat covers even more than I did when I first put them on.

source_doc: Works for me and helps improve my sleep. I was a little unsure about this because I've tried a wide variety of supplements for sleep and not a lot has been effective.I bought these during a bout of stress induced insomnia causing me to wake up around 4-6 am, unable to fall back asleep. Or I would try to sleep early and would struggle for hours to fall asleep. I was exhausted and desperate.These tablets have seemingly helped to stabilize my sleep enough to where even if it's interrupted, I can get back to sleep quickly. I don't wake up feeling groggy like I do if I were to take something like zzzquil.I'm so happy to have these and will definitely always keep them stocked for those stretches of time where my sleep just won't cooperate.Edit: one caveat is these contain lactose. I do not recommend if you are severely intolerant. I have a sensitivity to lactose myself and sometimes I do get a little extra gassy/bloated from taking these, but not enough to where it disrupts my sleep. These are not effective for all situations but months later I still find them helpful most of the time.

source_doc: Great value for a cheap starter kit! This is the first time I've tried to pull dents out of anything but I have seen it done several times. So that being said, I think this is a very cheaply made kit, it's not meant for professionals at all. It is a good beginner-starter kit though. I used it on my clothes dryer where "someone" stepped on the lid and left a large dent. I used up an entire stick of black glue. I had better luck applying glue to the dryer lid first. When I applied it to the puller tab first it would stay stuck on the dryer which made the whole process much harder.  There's no replacement for experience though. The puller contraption itself is easy to use but made of very cheap metal so I'm not sure how long it will last. The glue gun works, but it heats up pretty slow. Cleaning up the glue that didn't come off the metal was a huge pain. Like I said before that can be prevented some by applying the glue to the metal surface first instead of the pull tabs. I did not get the dent completely pulled out but it does look a lot better. I just wanted to try it out on something besides a car first. I didn't need the little pry tools for anything yet, but I do a lot of car projects so I'm sure they will come in handy eventually.

source_doc: This is going to take some practice for all three of us! After getting a second puppy in our life, I wanted the ability to take them both out for walks together and have at least one hand free  When I saw this I thought how fabulous this would be!  It arrived and I hooked the three of us up.  My older puppy is fairly good at leading alone.  The puppy, is even better!  She is a natural heeler!  I thought it would be a breeze!  Yeah, didn't go as I expected.  I quickly felt like I was the monkey in the middle with dogs going every direction and pulling me in the middle!  Then the fun, I stopped to get them under control and they each wrapped around me like some kind of insane doggie butterfly cocoon!  I managed to get control of the beasts, unwind myself and grabbed those broncs by the short handles of those leads!  I proceeded to walk ourselves home to get the regular leashes and I will use the regular leashes on this fanny pack until they get the hang of it better.  I think it was the extra bungie stretch they had that allowed them to go insane!Positive note:  The pack, the leads and all components held up great to the insane dance these dogs put me through!  I like being able to carry their treats with me and the other pouch for potty bags, keys, etc!

source_doc: In The Stars. Sometimes it is hard to know what the reviews are referring to if there are multiple items to purchase. I bought In The Stars which has quickly become a huge favorite of mine. I bought it without smelling it first based on the description. This is not something I normally do but I’m so glad I did. The scent is clean but also sexy. It is light and not overpowering like some can be. I have the lotion so before bed I slather that on and follow with this spray. I feel wonderful and pretty wearing this and I also recommend the lotion that makes my skin feel like velvet. I took one star off because when I spay it on I can smell alcohol but I’m not  really mad about it. After a moment it smells sweet and wonderful. This scent would be good for anyone. It doesn’t smell like old lady or children at all. It blends with my body chemistry and smells natural on me like it was designed just for me! It is a unique and complex fragrance. I’m used to spending 10 times as much for products and honestly I’m throwing a bunch of them out. This is in my top 3 BBW scents and I highly recommend it!

source_doc: Buy a concert instead. I bought an Enya Nova plus concert uke and liked it so much I decided to get the tenor also because of the metal frets. I sent it back the day after I got it. I did like the looks of it and the fret board with those rounded frets really looked nice but the action was so high I felt like I was having to chase the strings around. I think the price is high and I didn't want to have to pay to get it set up by someone else. It's also really heavy and the neck is thinner than most of my other ukes ( I have 14). And it feels kind of slippery. It just didn't feel comfortable to play. Maybe the non electric would be better, but I didn't care for the titanium strings either so all in all I think the concert is a better deal.

source_doc: They've screwed up! They changed the design and have ruined the cups! I have ordered MULTIPLE sets of these cups over the last 4 years for my grandbabies. I LOVED them!! They were well made,came in fun colors, and are made from recycled material here in the USA. What's not to love?! I recommended them to a dozen people. They loved them too. Well, fast forward to a month ago when my niece bought some from Target. She took them home and tried them out. She told my sister I was crazy for thinking they were so great. Hers leaked. Well, she had bought me 3 the same day...and they leaked too!! Some from the spout, some from the edge of the lid. I took an older one from the cabinet and compared them. Well, the continuous thread has been replaced with these weird tabs which apparently keep the cup from sealing properly. I am so sad such a great product has been ruined. I even tried ordering another set from Amazon in hopes it would be the old style. No such luck. Every single one of them leaked as well. I guess I will just have to guard my old ones with my life and never allow them to leave the house. I once would have told you to buy buy buy...now I say skip them. So disappointing.

source_doc: Fashionable Diaper bag. Before I got this diaper bag, I got my self one of those other diaper bags that is abviosly look like a diaper bag. I tried a couple of those and none of them I was not a fan of.First, I didn't realize how heavy they are even with nothing inside. It's even more heavy when I put everything that my baby needs. I also find that they are very bulky and NOT fashionable.So, I got this diaper bag and what I like about this is that is SUPER SUPER LIGHT.Very roomy inside Not a lot of compartment though not like those Bulky diaper bag but I didn't mind that.I don't really need a lot of separate compartment for every single thing.Inside, it has 2 compartment for bottles one for laptop or for changing pad. The changing pad I got on my own as this bag did not come with one.It didn't come with one because the bag it self can be a changing pad but I didn't like that idea due to, I have to take everything out in order to use it as one.Any I really really love this diaper bag it's super light and FASHIONABLE at the same time.

source_doc: Cute. Ok, I don’t think I completely “get” ice rollers. Why not just use an ice cube or a cold stone? Why put fruit and things in your ice if the rest of the ice cube is just plain water? I don’t get it.None of this confusion was helped by the lack of instructions. The two molds came nested and I was trying to figure out - do you fill the inside one or the outside one? Do you fill the outside so the inside is like an ice-covered hollow mold?  I had to find the listing to figure out what to do.I like them, as far as I understand them. I still don’t get why this is different from just grabbing an ice cube. But whatever. They’re easy to fill and use. The chick one is really cute and I don’t know why I enjoy that as much as I do. The bigger one seems like overkill and I stilll haven’t figured out if I’m supposed to scrub my face with the ice inside, or use the cover as a scrubbie and then use the ice. Idk. In any case, they seem to do exactly as advertised.

source_doc: I bought this months ago and I still use it every week. After I bought one of these egg cookers, I saw one show up at work. That was kind of funny. I use mine at least twice a week because I want to watch what I eat and cooked eggs are very convenient. I've never really liked meat all that much, but it was quite a bother to wait for a pot of water to boil and time it out and drain the water. With this, I pour water in, place the eggs, and turn it on. It tells me when it is done. It is so much easier this way. I've bought things and never used them. I've bought other things and only used them a couple of times. When I still use something regularly after having it for months, I know I found something good.

source_doc: Great versatile lamp that gives off plenty of light. I mostly got this lamp because I wanted something we could use when the power goes out. We have high winds where I live and usually a few times a year they end up making the power lines where I live go down. Amazingly enough two days after this light arrived our power went out for about 3 hours. I was so happy I had charged this little lamp and had it to use. It gave off all the light we needed. I even put it at lower light to make it last longer since we had no idea how long the power would be out. The only thing the least bit negative is that it takes a long time for it to fully charge. I set it to charge as soon as I opened it and probably 4 hours later it was still glowing with the red light so I ended up leaving it on for the night. It was fully charged when I got up the next morning but I really don't know just how long it took. So far we have used it for maybe 5 hours all together and it's still going strong. I'm really happy with this light and I'm even thinking of getting another one to keep on hand for the next time we lose power. Definitely recommend this light.

source_doc: Does not fit well - too short. The quality is very nice, but it's not long enough to fit the key fob.  Because it's too short, I had a heck of a time putting the post on the end to keep the cover closed. It's a shame because it's a really nice cover.  I have a second one on order that I will end up returning because I suspect that the fit will be off as it is on the first one I received.UPDATE:  I ordered two of these, one of each color.  The review above is for the first one.  The second one was shipped from overseas.  After I received the second one, it turns out that the pin I mentioned above is much longer on the second one and it fits great.  If they had provided the correct pin on the first one, I wouldn't have had to alter it to get it to fit and I would have given them 5 stars.  Because I am stuck with one that has a short pin, I leave my original one star rating for all the time I put into it to make it work.  Apparently, you roll the dice when ordering these.

source_doc: I keep coming back to this foundation. I’ve tried other foundations over the years but seem to always come back to this one. I have fair skin and use the L1 ivory color. No obvious borders from skin color to make up, so I know it’s a good color match for me.I like the pump feature for ease of putting on my sponge (I never apply foundation with my fingers), but I do hate leaving product in the bottle when it gets low. I typically save a “low” bottle and then when my next bottle gets low, I stand one on top of the other to hopefully drip down into the bottom bottle. There is still some waste, but at least I’m getting the use of more product. I highly recommend.

source_doc: Best deal ever !! I have been playing guitar since the early 1970's.  I ordered this guitar package  for my grand daughter for Christmas but it didn't get here in time so I gave her one of mine, she was very happy with that.  So when this came I carefully unpacked it with the idea that I was going to send it  back.  So I tuned it up and installed an old DeArmond pickup and plugged it in.  It blew my mind,  the sound was great and the action was super fast and easy to play.  I normally play my old 1972 Guild,  I can honestly say this guitar played as easy and sounded as good as the Guild (that was not easy for me to say)  and for this price which included a hard case tuner and strings , it is just an unbelievable deal.  If anything changes I will do an update,  for now I am very happy with this guitar and strongly recommend it.  I would like to know what strings came on the guitar, they appear to be very light but I do not know what brand they are.  (who ever set this guitar up knew what they were doing, the action was perfect)

source_doc: I like it. I’ve used myrrh essential oil in the past, when I made homemade natural skincare. But I’ve never before used it as something to ingest. I tried one of these capsules for the first time about a week ago. I’ve been in rather poor health, and I guess I hoped to discover a natural remedy. The first day I tried these, I took one and stayed attuned to my body to see if I felt different. After a bit, I did feel a subtle sense of relaxation and also some pain relief. A few hours later, I felt, ever so slightly, a sort of blood sugar type of jitteriness and irritation. I waited a day and tried it again, same way: one capsule. This time, I didn’t get any kind of jitteriness or irritation, as if I drank too much coffee. But I did feel mild, gentle pain relief….or, I should say, I felt as though “something” took the edge off of the pain I’ve been experiencing. Since then, I have been taking 1-2 capsules per day. Obviously, I feel that it may be helping me with my health issues or side effects. ..but I don’t know for sure if it’s these capsules of myrrh, psychological, or something else,…yet. I can say that I’ve been taking less aspirin and ibuprofen since using these myrrh capsules.

source_doc: Great personal electrical guitar amp. First off, I knew that it was on the small side and I know how small audio amplifier circuits can be made because of my degrees, but I still was not expecting this amp to be this tiny.  If it was not for the battery pack adding on some size, I bet this amp could fit in my guitar case.  But I love how small this is, and yet how loud it can get if needed.  The only reason for 4 stars is I heard a hum on some of the strings as well as some of them are fuzzy, so I am not sure if this is the amp or guitar yet.  I did not hear this with no amp attached obviously.  I found out that electric guitars need to be setup and I don't think this guitar has been setup yet before being used as I was not told about it.  So once that is done, if the sound improves I will increase my rating, if not, well you know what happens then, but I will do my best to find the cause of the hum and fuzz that have been found now.

source_doc: Handy multi-device car charger with useful voltmeter. I don't currently have any auto devices that need their own power port so the best thing about this charger for me currently is the voltmeter so I can always know the condition of my battery. I am hoping to get a dash cam soon though so perhaps that will need the extra power port. I like this charger a lot but it fits a bit too snugly in my van's power port, when putting it in and removing it I worry I could damage my van's power port. My first generation Toyota Sienna may have a slightly smaller power port than usual because I had that problem with another charger, I also read about another Toyota RAV4 owner with the same problem. If it weren't for the tight fit I would probably use this as my main charger so I could always know the condition of my battery. Another odd thing, but not a big issue is that since my port is low, when I insert the charger so that I read the port labels right side up, I am forced to see the fine print on what I consider the bottom of the charger, maybe that's a good thing in some situations. I like the soft touch on off switch.

source_doc: Check the comb for metal shards! One safety issue that I found concerning was that I found metal shards in-between the combs.  I found 3, removed them, and rinsed and soaked the removable comb piece in soapy hot water before even using it to be safe.This is an extremely cheap alternative to the popular FURminator descending comb, so I wanted to try it out.First thing difference I noticed was that this comb doesn't have the button to push out the hair like the FURminator.  That button you see on top is only to remove the metal de-shedding comb.For $3, this de-shedding comb is a fantastic deal, and does the job of de-shedding your pup like it's supposed to.  I do find it annoying that I have to grab the hair out after a few brushes instead of being able to use a single button to do it, but again for $3 bucks, I can deal.  I follow up with a brush down with my regular brush to catch all of the loose hairs that this tool doesn't pick up.It's a cheap tool, and I'm happy I have it.  I probably will purchase the FURminator again down the line, because I really do miss that button.

source_doc: Pretty good vs regular melatonin. I use melatonin sometimes when I'm having issues sleeping so when I saw this was 20 mg I decided I would have to try them.  When I was setting down for the night I popped one of these pills and waited for the magic.  It took about 15 minutes and I was out out for the night.  I did notice the next morning I wasn't as groggy as I had been with just plain melatonin (guess that's the magnesium)  so I like these more that the usual melatonin I get.  The taste and smell are n/a to me as I just open it and pop it in with a drink of water.  The pills are a bit big so I would use water with them.  All in all, I like these for sleepless nights and they will be my go-to from now on.

source_doc: Choking hazard for some dogs. My Boston terrier loves, loves, loves them. I noticed that many reviewers mentioned that these don't last more than a few seconds when they give them to their dog’s so, I tried to time Phoebe eating them. The first one I gave her, she took about 4 minutes to finish; which I thought was really good but then, the next few she ate quicker at around 2 minutes and it got shorter and shorter from then on. I will say that Phoebe also has those yak hard sticks to chew but now, she really only seems to chew those at night but, anyway, back to this product... One day I gave her one of these sticks as kind of a snack, they are high in calories for a snack but whatever; she must have been really hungry because, I noticed that she was acting like she was having trouble swallowing so, I stuck my fingers down her throat and dislodged almost half of the stick. Phoebe still gets them but now I hold them and she has to take bite size pieces. Phoebe really loves them and I actually do think that they calm an upset stomach so it is worth the grossness of the saliva getting all over my hand; I just wash my hand thoroughly afterwards. :)

source_doc: Amazing mouse! I bought second hand and after a reset it works great! I own 4 mice, 2 cheapos a Corsair harpoon and this dark core. Only going to compare the corsair mice. The harpoon is light and easy to use. The the scroll wheel is very easy to use. I would rate this mouse excellent if I had never used the dark core RGB. The dark core is heavier which I actually like. And it FEELS so smooth I’m guessing that’s due to the 18,000 dpi optical sensor. The RGB IMO is awesome. I have it set to match my monitor or whatever is on display. The scroll wheel on the other hand is stiff. I find my finger sliding on it constantly. I have to adjust the pressure at what I use to move the scroll wheel. On the harpoon it’s effortless.I am using both wings on the dark core and I enjoy resting my fingers on them. It’s a nice feel/grip.Overall I love this mouse and it’s working great for me. Unfortunately I made the mistake and got them on qi charging version but I like it so much I don’t want to return

source_doc: Bought 3. 1 worked. 1 won't turn on. 1 wouldn't even charge my phone and won't recharge. Seriously. I was pretty excited to find something my wife and kids could just carry in their car that would jump start it in an emergency. So I bought 3 of them. When I got them I pulled them all out of their boxes and checked the charge. The first one was 3 of 5 bars so I plugged it into a usb charger overnight. Next day I tested it out on my RV with a V10 Ford engine that had a very weak battery and it cranked like the battery was new and started right up. Still at 5 of 5 bars.I checked the second one and it was at 5 of 5 bars. I plugged my phone into it and it took my phone to 65% over about 3 hours, and then it was at 1 of 5 bars. I plugged it into the same USB charger I had the other one in and came back a few hours later and it was still at 1 bar. I let it charge overnight and it's still at 1 bar. Flashlight won't turn on and won't start anything.I checked the third one and nothing. No bars of 5. Flashlight won't come on. I plugged it into the charger for a few hours and nothing. No bars, no flashlight.

source_doc: Not a fan of the built in XLR cable. The boom stand itself works great. It is a good value for the money. The only thing I wasn't a fan of was the built in XLR cable it comes with. I am an Electrical Engineer and I tested this cable myself and can see that using a 150 ohm XLR preamp test on my desktop setup, I can see that my whole setup puts out a noise floor of about -100dB, which is extremely good. But it wasn't until I plugged in the XLR cable that my noise floor went up about 20dB. That is a lot for a cable and when I turned my gain up all the way to see if my hypothesis was correct, it was picking up radio interference from a local radio station, but barely could hear it. This means that the shielding on the wire itself has a fault somewhere or the wires themselves aren't balanced and not twisted pair. After I plugged in my own XLR cable that I had from a good source, I immediately saw my noise floor jump back up to -99dB and could hear no interference anymore. Just letting people know, that if you do expect to use this boom stand, make sure you also buy an XLR cable that is good quality. Now, I don't know if maybe I got a faulty cable, but it is something I wanted to warn people about.

source_doc: Giving it a try. I just started using this. It arrived unsealed and the box damaged in transit, but I was confident by the look and feel of the pump that it hadn't been used. I'm using this as a toothpaste, but I may share it with others who have appliances. I think it is meant to replace toothpaste. It doesn't include fluoride though. One pump generously covers the toothbrush. Although it's mostly air, it does feel like enough product to do the job. The foam has an unpleasant alcohol-menthol taste. I didn't find it that intolerable though, and it dies down over the two minutes. I also think it helps give that clean feeling afterwards. Instructions are to use this 1-2x daily, expecting results in 1-2 weeks. I'm surprised that I think I feel slight achiness after one use, so I'm going to see if I can do once a day for a few days. I'll report if I see whitening. To be fair though, I've been using a lot of whitening products lately and am not sure if I can expect more progress from products. This claims to be up to a 4 month supply which seems improbable, but then again, it does dispense a lot of air. If it lasts nearly that long and works, it's certainly worth $12.99.

source_doc: Surprisingly comfy for a good night's sleep! This turned out to be a life saver on a recent camping trip. I was planning on tent camping but during the night the weather turned and I was pummeled by rain & hail. My tent is great in the rain, but I was set up in a low area and the space under the tent quickly turned into a lake and my tent turned into a giant waterbed. Since I had this in the car, I decided to inflate it and see how it worked. It was pretty easy to set up/inflate quickly and it was SO comfortable! I was honestly surprised at how comfortable it was. I'm 5'0 and had to sleep a little curled up, so if you're taller, consider how you like to sleep.The only downside is in my Mazda 3 I had to move the front seats all the way up to fit it, so I can't drive around with it installed. I could probably pull the pieces out of the footwells and angle the mattress a bit to push the seats back to drive, but haven't tried it yet. I do love the versatility this provides! Now I have another option for camping when I don't want to go through the hassle of setting up a tent for just one night.

source_doc: Gear for Motorcycle front sprocket. I used this sprocket JT1264.17 17-tooth to swap out the front sprocket gearing of my Lifan Xpect 200cc motorcycle.  There are videos on how to do it on youtube. It's a very well-made sprocket and heavy-duty. After removing the sprocket cover and loosening the back wheel and chain I was able to take the stock 15-tooth sprocket (JT1264.15) out and install this 17-tooth with little issue.  The sprocket cover needed a little wiggling to get back on over the larger sprocket, but it worked. The result: This was a test I conducted as my own gear ratio experiment. Please consult for advice, from a mechanic professional, the manual, and the service dealer before doing this experiment. What did I gain? I was able to extend lower gears out longer and gained a comfortable (less RPM) 5th-gear speed riding the paved highway.  What did I lose by doing this swap?  I lost lower gear torque to the rear wheel.  I don't want to lose lower-gear torque. I am going to ride the bike on dirt roads and ATV trails where I need lower-gear torque for many purposes.  I won't keep the 17-tooth front sprocket in the motorcycle.  The 17-tooth sprocket looks very well made.  No manufacturing imperfections.  If you have a purpose for this front sprocket this looks like a good one to buy.  I am a DIYer.  Please consult your dealer service department for professional advice.

source_doc: perfect for daily powder supplements on vacation. These helped me bring 15 days' worth of powder supplements to make my morning smoothies while on vacation; I poured the powder from these directly into my wide-mouth "ShakeSphere" bottle and added drinking water to shake it up. My powders filled each container right to the brim (approximately 70cc I think, if I did my math correctly from all the various scoop sizes). I didn't like being forced to use the funnel top as the lid on the topmost container; I don't have a baby and I didn't need to use a funnel, so it was wasted space in my already tight luggage - I would have preferred a flat top lid. When closing be sure the pieces are securely tightened with each other, and strangely, when you use too much force, the pieces don't twist apart nicely; after I loosened my grip, then the pieces came apart smoothly. I used these for a 1 week trip to San Diego and now I'm packing them up for a 2-wk trip to Hawaii. I use these weekly at home too, because I love the time savings in the mornings of not needing to measure all the powders out each day (now I do that only once per week).

source_doc: Nice to be able to order the buttons without the entire assembly... I use Straploks on all my basses. I have three straps, and each one has the male portion of the Straplok system. On my main strap, I have four Straplok male connections so that I can achieve the correct playing position for different basses. Each time I purchase a bass, the first thing I do is to change the existing buttons to the Straplok buttons. Until recently, I thought it was necessary to buy the entire assembly, even though all I needed was the buttons. Now it is nice to be able to order just the buttons, but I believe they are priced too high. The entire assembly can be purchased for just $5 more than the buttons alone, which makes no sense, since the male portion of the assembly is much more complex to manufacture compared with the button portion. Still, I would rather pay $5 less and not have too many useless male portions just lying around. I think $5 or so would be a more fair price, not that Dunlop is listening to my advice. lol.

source_doc: It’s okay. It’s a starter kit, so it will give you what you need for a quick start up. I purchased Quick Start and Stress Coat+ instead of using the conditioner provided with the tank and they worked very well. Within a few hours of adding those in and running the filter, my water was ready.I’m not a fan of the filter at all, it’s loud, creates a strong current, and it doesn’t do the best job of cleaning the water (the sole thing a filter is supposed to do). Based on previous reviews it’s not reliable so within a week of having it I decided to replace it with an inexpensive, but much more reliable, sponge filter that doesn’t create a current. Happy water, happy fish.The lights are decent, though I wish they were dimmable. There are cheap options for dimmable lights with a timer that can be submerged, and I will be using those instead.The instructions for this tank mention a provided heater. There isn’t one provided, which I think is better as I found a heater that reads the water temperature and it’s keeping my betta very happy.Overall, the tank is decent and a huge upgrade from the 2.5 gallon I had before. With the money I spent, I could’ve purchased a bigger tank since I replaced everything else but now I know for the future.

source_doc: Maybe I don't love these, but I really really like them. I take that back - maybe I actually do love these. I have about 300 miles now with these and have yet to find a deal-breaker with them.  I hike all types of terrain and haven't had any problems with them.  I never used poles before, but after tripping and falling last year when hiking some really difficult terrain, I thought it prudent to try something for added stability.  These Foxelli's have been great for me.  They remain locked in position for me and I haven't had problems with them sliding out of position, even in very cold and changing temperatures.  I can see how one might break them if they aren't paying attention - especially if using on really rocky trails where the tip can get caught between rocks and jam.  But that’s not the pole’s fault - it’s “operator error".  What I really like is the lower handhold which is sooo useful when going uphill in changing terrain.

source_doc: Learning How To Play at 66! I have loved Gospel Music since I was 18 years old!  I vowed that I would learn to play it at some point in my life. Well that point is here and after looking for the standard organ in Black churches, I decided that I didn’t need a Hammond and Leslie in our house.  After researching dozens of keyboards and reading hundreds of reviews, boom!  Here I am with this keyboard in my house and me practicing scales with proper finger placement!  This is an amazing keyboard. It is amazing how accurate the instruments are and it has organ voices that emulate the Hammond and Leslie, which is the main reason I bought it!  I am so excited about the feel of the keys and the ability for it to run off of AA batteries!!Now that I have no excuse, it is on to the included DVD and booklet and YouTube instructional videos for playing Black Gospel music and finally my next purchase of full size base pedals that plug into it. Yes, I have a headset so that my wife doesn’t need to endure what we endured when our kids were learning instruments. I highly recommend this amazing instrument. Top quality and design and a definite value for the money.

source_doc: Strange angle of mouthpiece. I think I've played just about everything that has keys or strings - even a theatre pipe organ - and I was looking for something different that was fun to play.  I did play the recorder a number of years ago, but again, I wanted something unique.  And that, is when I came across the ocarina.  I didn't want to invest a lot of money, but wanted something that had a good tone.  A little research on line brought me to the Night by Noble.  And I love it -- but my right wrist Does Not.  The mouthpiece just seems to be at an odd angle.  I did a little comparison to other brands and sure enough the angle and length is a bit odd.  Again, I really like this particular instrument, but might consider another brand with a longer and,more importantly, more angled mouthpiece, in the near future.Update - I purchased an STL Aria ocarina yesterday.  What a huge difference!  The mouthpiece angle is perfect and definitely longer.  And it gives me a great finger wrap for the balance needed in high notes. source_doc: I have owned 7 house bunnies in a row!!! In about thirty years I have owned 7 bunnies, all who have lived inside and been treated very special.  Sometimes I have owned two at once, but in those thirty years never gone without at least one.  Obviously I am doing something right since several of mine have lived to be about 12-13 years old.  So in say that, I highly recommend this grass mat that I use inside their huge open door cage where I also have pet fur mats on the floor along with one of these mats where I sit there bowl of TIMOTHY pellets.  I notice that the bunny I have now will ignore it for awhile and then one day just start shredding it to pieces, so I make sure to keep buying them for her since she really doesn't play with any rabbit toys I buy her.  Except for loving empty toilet paper rolls this is her fav fun project!  I always make sure anything I give my bunnies is safe and healthy (note, always use timothy pellets, give them just the tiniest bit of fruit, no other carbs and tons of green vegies daily).  Rabbits love to eat but anything sugar or sweet will mess up their stomachs real easily...but back to this product, it is a big yes and I will continue buying them when needed.

source_doc: Hard to open—at first… I do a lot of traveling—and I mean a lot. I ordered this eight compartment pill organizer box in hopes that it would be helpful on my travels. I still think I’ll use this, but probably when I’m traveling not as far.

source_doc: Great lighting, excellent key feel. I had a Nighthawk X8 MAX keyboard I loved. It worked for years. Then the coffee happened. I tried many keyboards and eventually settled on this one. The lighting is bright, the keycaps have large letters and numbers, and most importantly, the keys feel "right". I am also pleased that is is a tenkeyless keyboard that still has print screen, etc. I would like for the caps lock indicator to be brighter, but that is the only complaint I have. I actually have two of these so I am ready when the Nighthawk I have at my office finally dies, or when I inadvertently kill the one I am typing on.

source_doc: My very first VR set! So worth the money! I finally decided to plunge into the world of virtual reality — and I’m so glad I chose this item as my first “attempt” at VR! I really liked that any adjustment (minus the strap) could easily be done even while wearing the device without interrupting gameplay! As for the strap, just a simple fix of placing the joycons down, fix it, and bam, you’re immediately back to gameplay. I saw other reviews say it was heavy… honestly I found it to be light!My only downsides to it (which neither have nothing to do with the product itself), are…- The games offered. I wish Nintendo would offer a VR mode for more games- Because I have thick hair, if I moved a certain way, the straps would slide up to the top of my head (due to gripping) and I would have to pause the game and reset it on my head before continuing. But I’ll try wearing a ponytail next time!All in all, I really enjoyed my time with this, and I can definitely see it as a more long-term option than what Nintendo offers!

source_doc: These are great! I got this set so that I could have the white and purple one because I got myself a white controller and some cute purple buttons and so now everything matches 💜 And the other headset I had just kept in the top of my closet as an extra for when my son's ended up breaking because we all know that headphones usually only last a few years. And yeah so I pulled out the black and red ones within a few months. And I've had my headphones for I think 2 years now and they're still holding up. My son already went through his, but he actually uses his everyday and I only really get a few hours here and there every month. But idk overall I love them, they fit great and the sound is awesome and I actually love that they are wired because I don't have to worry about them dying on me lol. But anyways I hope this helps. Oh and back when I got these I think it was like maybe $50 for the set, so idk how much they are now but if it's too much more than maybe just get one if you don't actually need both of them.

source_doc: Won't connect to Razer Synapse. I bought this to upgrade from my old Diamondback.I have never had any issue connecting peripherals from any other company other than Razer and this mouse is no different. I went through the processes outlined on their website to have Synapse recognize this mouse but it didn't find it. Take note, I also have an old Diamondback and Firefly already installed. During the 'repair' process, it prompted me to search for the synapse.msi file but couldn't find it saying the file doesn't exist. The folder it was pointing to exists but that msi file is no where on my system so even though I updated my synapse application a week or two ago, I tried it again but no updates were available.This isn't rocket science. This shouldn't be that difficult. I have 'gaming' peripherals from numerous other companies and never, not once did I ever have an issue connecting one of their devices. They are recognized immediately upon connection but not with Razer. Razer forces me to jump through all these hoops and it still doesn't work. So, I no longer spend hours upon hours trying to get their products to work. If they don't within five or ten minutes of troubleshooting it's being sent back. I should have remembered when I tried to connect one of their headphones and had the same issue. I remember even uninstalling the application back then and reinstalling it and it still didn't connect.

source_doc: Best Bassinet!! This bassinet is absolutely perfect. I am so happy with it! I bought 2 because my daughter had twins. Best baby buy EVER. I wanted a bassinet that had the side to side glide but I wanted it to be sturdy and it not be able to shift a baby into the side panels (we have 5 and 3 yr old siblings.) I wasn't crazy about the all white but it works so beautifully it could be puke green and worth every penny.If I were on the design team I would change that the glide motion have an "always on" feature for the exhausted new mom in addition to the 60 min timer.  I would improve the sound quality. Its harsh. The white noise and nature sounds are great but not so much the music. I would not have the flashing light. We havent figured out exactly what the flashing light is all about. I'm sure it's just that we haven't set up the wifi yet. Which we will get to and update if it changes our perception of the bassinet.I have 4 children and I have 6 grandchildren. I wish this product was around for the past 40 years!!!

source_doc: Lasted longer than I thought. I teach a sport that requires me to pack food for 14 hour days on the weekend. I try to pack as lightly as possible because everything has to be transported with my on a bus and then into schools, it's a whole thing. Since I'm on a special diet I bring all my food for the day but I try to fit it all in one lunch bag. That was not really possible with those hard plastic ice packs that I would typically use. However, with these, they don't take up as much space and they still lasted me at least 8-10 hours and still felt cold.Do I think these will work well for more than 8-10 hrs? I don't think so. But if you are using these for school lunches I think they would do the trick. Because of their size they don't take up a lot of room so I was able to use both of them to make sure I could be near more than one item in the bag.I'll keep trying these each weekend and see if I can narrow down exactly how long they last but if they're well frozen and in a decent lunch bag you should be good to go.Also, I love the color of these. :-)

source_doc: Super impressed, I love this bra! I love this bra way more than I originally thought I would. Unfortunately I don’t have a portable breast pump so I’m stuck to a machine every 3 hours and was extremely uncomfortable balancing the cups and not being able to do anything else. The flanges fit perfectly into the bra and stay put while I pump so I can be on my phone and do other things while I pump. As per other reviews I ordered a size smaller (usually a large I’m a 34DDD) and I got a medium and it fits perfectly snug where I feel like I have a great amount of support. Bra is also really soft compared to another nursing bra I have. All in all I would definitely repurchase!

source_doc: Find your studs before ordering. I assumed I would not have trouble laying out the footprint I hade in mind. But the studs in my garage walls appear to be irregularly spaced. Two different stud finder tools failed to help. So I had to probe around. I attempted to pop the wall plates off of a light switch and an outlet, identify the corresponding wall stud, and measure in 16 inch increments and higher, and couldn’t figure a consistent interval. So I ended up just using my smallest drill bit with some guesswork until I found enough spots that would work.Wish I had spent some time getting lines down on every possible stud before I opened boxes and stuff everywhere. I made it work by combining some 4’ and 3’ spans (from the 6’ model).Now that I got them up, I’m satisfied with how they look and getting my crap off the floor.

source_doc: Fantastic bag. So I wish MR made a 'toned down' tacticool version of this due to the nature of my work. I use this as my primary laptop/work bag. I appreciate how "close" everything feels in the pouches. All of the compartments are very accessible and have the appropriate attachment points so I can carabiner/zip tie the zippers if I am in a pickpocket area. I would recommend this bag to anyone who is on the go for work. It flies through TSA security stuff and has ample room for all of the stuff I need on the go. I leverage packing cubes for all of my stuff and carry a Dell 15" laptop and a USBC Dell secondary monitor, as well as an anker 737 battery and all appropriate cables. I typically keep my glasses case/sunglasses in the outside pouch and in the other, I keep gum and keys I don't put in my pocket. The inside zipper keeps pens (in ink proof cube), passport, immunization card, and some cash. This is a very nice system for the price and very durable construction compared to most of the bags in this class.

I truly wish I would have known, because I would have helped and at least tipped him, but I had no cash on me. :(

source_doc: I wish I bought this years ago - worth every penny! I suck at soldering. My hands are really shaky and I don't do it often enough to get the practice. I can't believe how much of a difference this made over the cheap stuff (which have thousands of 5 star reviews!) I'd been using. It flows where I want it to go, very easy to use, low temp..For years I've been thinking about trying this, but the price compared to others is significant. I had tried a little tube of it awhile back and didn't like it at all. I didn't know I had brought the wrong type  (the naming of various solders is a bit confusing)  I finally broke down a few months ago and bought this. I was getting so frustrated soldering I started buying in stead of making.  It is absolutely worth the price.It's not a miracle tho - I still suck at soldering, I just suck less now.

source_doc: Good for the Price..But. I have some nice heavy duty solar lights that I want to hang in my yard along the back fence line which overlooks a wooded area.  When I saw these 9ft light poles, I knew it would be the perfect solution!  I was so excited when the box arrived but then quickly disappointed because apparently I did not read the description well enough - I saw the beginning of the title ‘Patio String Lights Poles” and assumed I would be getting two poles.  It does say ‘Pole’ singular further in the description.  So if you order these, you may want to order two.  I cannot hang lights from one pole lol so I will have to order a second one.  Having said that, the price doubled is about what other sets of two cost.  The pole comes in sections that you just screw together so assembly is simple.  I wish it was a little bit heavier duty because I’m not sure how well it will support my lights but it may be fine.  The pole doesn’t wobble much once in the ground with the five spikes.  Overall they are decent quality.

source_doc: Refused to connect. I had a lamp I wanted to use Alexa with and I have other older Kasa smart plugs that work fine.  My other bulbs were Lumiman and I thought I would try to make everything just Kasa.  So I ordered a Kasa smart bulb but it refused to connect.  I thought that maybe it was because the lamp was one of those metal swing-arm things, so I thought, well, I'll just get another Kasa plug instead and ordered a used set of 2.  They both refused to connect.  Thinking it was because they were used, I ordered 2 more new ones.  And, guess what, they refused to connect, too.  I tried everything with all of them.  Multiple tries and resets, moving the lamp all over the house and even right next to the router.  None of them would connect.  So I ordered another Lumiman bulb and, lo and behold, it connected right away with absolutely no issues.  2 stars is for the old plugs that actually worked.

source_doc: Honestly, I love this bag. I got this bag specifically for one day of a three day music festival I went to out of town. I flew in the morning of, attended the show, stayed in a hotel, flew home. I had to take everything I needed to the show with me because I wouldn’t be able to check in before the show. Granted I packed light, but this bag held everything I needed for a day in the sun and an overnight.Ive since taken the bag on a handful of travels where we’d venture out all day without returning to the hotel and it was perfect. Everything I need for the day AND room for some crap I’d buy along the way, one time it was three books and a T-shirt! It was stuffed, but it held it all.I’ve been looking for something a little better quality because I’ve grown to love this style and I can’t find anything that I like as much as this bag. I’m not having issues, but there are a lot little strings from unraveling fabric that’ll eventually cause problems.I carry it almost every day now. It’s gonna wear out, but I figure I’ll carry it gladly until it does.I took the patches off and put a couple of my own on, looks much better now.All in all, great bag. Probably 8L or so. Plenty big and decently constructed with lots of pockets.

source_doc: Not gold and not absorbant. These are really soft and fluffy microfiber towels!  I've never seen microfiber towels like these.  I got them because I have a new color theme in my bathroom that includes a bright egg yolk yellow.  I was trying to liven it up from the grey, beige, black and white in there.  I bought a new rug, new bath towels and a couple pictures to hang on the wall.  I wanted these to wipe off the faucet handle and tub spout after I take showers.  We have a new home and I want to keep it looking new as long as possible. These microfiber towels are labeled as gold and look more yellow in the description than what I recieved.  Mine are bright orange, not gold at all.  But what I don't understand is why they are considered absorbant...?  They smear around the water on the faucet.  I thought maybe I didn't get all the stuff out they use when they are manufactured so I hand washed them again in fragrance free detergent, and baking soda.  Tried again and they still don't wipe off water like my old cotton towels.  I tried them several times.  I think they might be good at dusting.  They probably pick up dust well.  They probably also work great at washing things, but I specifically ordered them for their color and their absorbancy and neither work for that purpose.  I will find another use for them, but I am disappointed.

source_doc: AMAZING OIL - Smells much stronger when used then in the bottle. This essential oil has thoroughly impressed me. When I got it and smelled it out of the bottle I didn't think it had much of a scent at all and was disappointed but I read the insert saying it would be stronger once used and then I gave it a try. WOW!!!! I used the included nozzle and sprayed it about 6 times in my room hours ago and now my entire unit (700 sq ft) is filled with this wonderful fragrance. I cannot believe how long it has lasted and even that it traveled through each room so that when I came back from walking my dog and opened the door I immediately smelled the clean fresh scent of Gardenia Lily. I am a home fragrance fanatic and have tried many many products but this one has surpassed them all. I usually use a room spray and within half an hour the scent is completely gone so for this to last hours is amazing. Now that I know what this can do, I know I will only need a spray or two so this bottle is going to last a very very long time. I was wondering why this bottle of essential oil was at this price point but now I know. It's also 100% pure essential oil with no water. I can't wait to try it in a diffuser.

source_doc: I love this brand. So i actually bought the white one last year and i loved it but the keys where so loud but overall i loved it. I am a gamer, and the mouse did start to miss a few clicks so i decided it was time for a new keyboard and mouse. I decided to go with the pink one this time because white is hard to keep clean and i just didnt want to do the black since my mouse pad and mic are black. Anyways i actually love the pink one a lot more and the keys are a lot quitter, and the lights are more fun and easier to control and there are so many more options with this one then the one i had before. The only issue that i have is the space bar is a little harder to hit. And while that isn't a big deal for just typing it can be when you miss a jump in a game. Other than that, yeah i would buy this keyboard and mouse again. the mouse is perfect so far and I haven't missed a click.

source_doc: Really hoped to love it. Install slightly difficult. I have a 2014 Nissan Sentra SR and this is not my first time replacing a cabin air filter. I was really hoping to love this product due to the longer life and activated carbon, but I'm hesitant to purchase another one.I may have received a defective filter, but the filter I received was not easy to install. I had to really force and maneuver it in the filter compartment. I struggled with it so much that I accidentally ripped the little tag that is supposed to help pull the filter back out later. Hopefully I won't have too much trouble taking it out when it's time to replace it again. I haven't decided if I plan to purchase this again when it is time for another replacement. If I do I will update my review on whether or not the 2nd one was just as difficult. For time comparison.... It took me half the time, if not less, to replace my engine air filter and air intake hose than the cabin air filter.

source_doc: Well-made, sturdy, elegant case. Just received this yesterday. The first impression is, as the title says, that it is a well-made, sturdy and elegant case. I read reviews that said the handle was uncomfortable. I don’t think it is. also read reviews that the straps were uncomfortable, that if you just hold by one strap the bass Flips upside down. That’s not true. The shoulder straps are fine. I wonder if people know how to adjust them? I opened them up all the way. That works for me.To put the bass in the case, you really do have to open it up almost all the way. And the extra pads at the bottom or a little bit in the way sort of. I didn’t want to remove them because I like the extra padding there. I don’t want to take the strap off my bass when I put it in the case, but that would probably make things a lot easier.  Anyway, it fits in there the case itself as I mentioned is very good looking in an understated sort of way  - you could show up at symphony hall with this thing and fit right in. It feels very sturdy and solid and stiff. The best of both worlds between a case and a gig bag. In my opinion I bought it because I fly sometimes in like to gate check the bass. this I think is as good as it gets for that option.

source_doc: Not accurate, irritated my wrist. I really wanted to like this watch, as my friend has 1 and we could join eachother and share our progress with one another, etc. I was amazed at how many steps I was doing each day- until I realized that it was adding steps when I wasn't even walking! I bought another less expensive watch and wore both of them on my wrist for several days. sure enough, the Fitbit showed many more steps then the other- which showed to be more accurate when I was watching.My second complaint is that though it is less bulky than some watches, it irritated my wrist. I don't know if it is the materials it is made out of or what, but it wore a rash into it.Lastly, the App. They want $80 a year for their "premium" edition, which my other watch app gives me for FREE! Plus, my other watch monitors my blood pressure, which the fitbit does not, unless I enter it manually. All in all, I can say I tried it but I am not impressed. The seller, however was great. I had the watch in less than 2 days.

source_doc: I buy for convenience. I buy this strictly for the convenience factor. I do a lot of cooking from scratch and many recipes call for bell peppers. I have a smaller refrigerator and I’m tight on space. This can is huge, so I poured it into a 2.7 Quart Lock n Lock container. As you can see, there’s plenty of room leftover. I could probably fit it into an even smaller container. So while the can is huge, there is significantly less product than I expected. I realize it’s sold by weight, not volume.After the initial shock of a half empty can, I can say I am still happy with this purchase. I’ve always got peppers available now; no last minute shopping trips to the grocery store to finish making a meal. The smell is that of fresh peppers and the taste has been very good in every dish I’ve made with them. I’ve used in meatloaf, soup, poultry dishes, and even omelets. For omelets, I let them sit in the egg mixture for 5 minutes or so with an additional tablespoon of water before adding to a hot pan. Peppers are pretty expensive these days, so I think this is a good value and I’ll definitely buy them again, especially when they’re on sale.

source_doc: Good moisturizer, fragrance free. I have been using oil vs lotion on my body for years. Usually almond or grape, but thought I would give this a try. I have heard good things about jojoba. It has no fragrance, which I prefer. It is a little thicker, but absorbs nicely on wet skin. I like oil better as I have dry skin & lotion tends to coat skin on me, instead of feeling like it’s actually getting into my skin. I can keep my dry skin in check, if I use it daily. The Jojoba oil seems to leave a bit of a layer, but only cause it  takes a little longer to absorb completely. My skin definitely feels moisturized & looks healthier. I like it. Other than the thicker texture of the oil, it isn’t much different than what I have used before. No negatives that I notice. Competitively price for the large size. Worth a try.

source_doc: More feel and stability. I took the JumboMax challenge, ordering a full set of grips, re-gripping one club and going to play.  I changed out my 8 iron because I use it a lot, plenty of opportunities for bump and run where I play.Came home, had lunch and re-gripped the whole set.  I find that I was too tight, tense, whatever you call it with the old skinny grips.  With these I was able to swing without clamping down on the club and without having to think about it much.  This lead to much increased feel and more clubhead speed.Around the greens my wedge play  is much improved.  I let one of my regular partners try out a wedge and he showed up the next week with HIS set changed out to these grips too.  So he still scores better than me, not that I mind.I love these grips.  Picking up a regular grip club now feels very strange.  I now understand why I never really had the degree of control I wanted before, even though I used oversize grips.  Oversize does not come even close to the feel of the JumboMax.

source_doc: Good for GI issues. I decided to try this food for my APT, who was having intermittent diarrhea.  I initially thought it was related to NSAIDs, as she needs them daily for arthritis.  At wits end, I tried stopping the NSAIDS as a last resort, as I also tried MANY supplements and changed her food, with still no signs of her loose stools resolving.  Chicken and rice helped the most, but I knew she couldn't stay on it forever.  My dog's only symptom was diarrhea.  Her appetite and energy were normal (both over the top) and she would have formed stools as often as diarrhea.  Her weight remained unchanged.At the time I switched to Dave's dry food, I was feeding our dog Blue Buffalo Basics Salmon dry food and white fish wet food.  I didn't realize these were grain free, as I was focused on the "basic" part of the food.  In chatting with a vet, I learned that sometimes grain free diets in dogs can lead to intermittent diarrhea.  After  much research of good quality and affordable dog food for sensitive systems, I came across Dave's Pet Food and decided to try it.  Within a month our dog was back to having consistent formed stools, even while taking her NSAIDS.  I would highly recommend this food for dogs with sensitive systems and GI issues.

source_doc: You guys…buy this ASAP! This thing is magical! Seriously. Where has this been all my life??? Why have I been sleeping on this!? Why have I been using a blower dryer AND a round brush all my hair drying life when I could’ve been using this all along? Well maybe this didn’t exist, but it does now and that’s all that matters.With a blow dryer, it would normally take me 45-60 min to blow dry my hair. I have THICK hair, that’s somewhat coarse and curly/wavy, but even more textured towards my scalp/hairline. It’s impossible to straighten with a blow dryer and I heavily rely on a flat iron. AND I can’t blow dry my hair as soon as I get out of the shower. I typically have to wait 30-45 min for it to air dry some or else I’m standing there sweating for eternity while 20 hairs dry. It’s torture.I don’t know what kinda witchery this is, but I literally blow dried my hair in 30-40 min today. Straight out the shower! What?! And flat ironing was minimal! I can’t believe it. I’m beyond happy!The dryer seemed kind of loud, but it’s powerful. The heat felt kind of too hot at times, but I had it on the highest setting. I just had to make sure I didn’t let it blow on my skin/scalp for too long or it would get uncomfortable. Aside from that, it’s perfection. Believe the hype. Seriously.

source_doc: Be aware of hot glue dripping down! I've purchased several of these at the same time (1 for travel trailer, 1 for vending at craft shows and one as a gift) and I like it much better (for the most part) than my previous one from another company that I got several years ago.  I really like how easily this one closes - huge improvement over my other one, which I really struggled with.  I use a piece of parchment paper inside which helps with cleanup.  It heats up hotter and faster than my old one, so I'm still learning that aspect of it.  However what I'm not happy about is how hot glue (or so it appears) has dripped down on to the power cord inside where it attaches.  Over time it got harder and harder to remove it (a/c cord) and finally I had to have my husband remove it with a pair of vise grips and even then it was hard to remove.  We found hot glue on it.  I did put it back in and won't be removing it, which could be a problem when I want to use the 12v attachment for when I want to use it in the vehicle.  I like the carrying case.  But yeah, not too impressed with the hot glue.  I keep meaning to write to the seller about it.

source_doc: Great option for small spaces! I got this because I don't have enough under counter space to install those typical paper towel holders, and I didn't want a tabletop one.  I was worried that it wouldn't fit in the space that I was intending for it, but it fits!The quality of the holder is great, nice and sturdy.  And the most important part: the magnet is strong!  It slapped down onto the side of my fridge and it doesn't budge without putting a good amount of force into it. It's absolutely worth it's value, I honestly feel like it's a steal because of the quality and versatility in placement compared to the typical paper towel holders that you have to screw down.I would like to note that I prefer this one over another magnetic holder I have because the rod that holds the paper towel roll isn't screw-on, it's one whole piece.  The other one I have had a tendency to unscrew itself over time, so I had to gorilla glue it, because I found it annoying.  Get this one!

source_doc: These made for a great relaxing evening! I like to give my wife massages. She has lots of back pain and tension. I have a set of stones I bought prior, but no heating source. I would put them in a pot of water and heat them, then bring them into to room. This was kind of a pain. This lets me keep them right on my nightstand. Takes about  20-25 minutes I guess to heat them. Wasn't timing it. For me by the time I was ready to put the stones on, they were ready to go. Not too hot! They were very soothing. I actually put some of my other stones in to heat them as well but honestly, I didn't end up using them. The stones that come with it are enough to put them on the spots that needed them. I watched many YT videos on how to do massage, and where to place the stones. Getting pretty good at it now! :-) I have used products from SereneLife in the past and have been happy with them, so I chose these. Nice case/heater combo. Well thought out. Easy controls.

Tried it on a buddies s10 and it came on but wouldnt connect.Updated 03/19/23 I went back to the 2002 GMC sierra and started checking fuses. Found 2 blown fuses (cigarrete & DRL) and replaced. Reconnected scanner tool. It comes on but wont connect. Retried multiple times... same results. Next I guess is the drag test... where you use a paper clip to test each pin hole on the vehicles scanner port under the dash.After reading some other peoples reviews of this unit, I thought I should add my review to the list. No pins are broken, none are bent, and plug was pushed all the way in.If I could return it I would its really been no help so far, and a waste of money...

source_doc: Best hair product I’ve used to date. I’m 39 So this picture shows only a few of the hair products I’ve tried over the years. Anything from slick back, to spiked etc.. I like something that I can manipulate a bunch of different ways. It took me a little to figure out the best way to use it but it’s by far my favorite now. I’ve switched back through all my products thinking I can go through them so I don’t waste, but I like Reuzel so much that it drives me nuts and I go back. It keeps my hair in place, it doesn’t feel too greasy or anything bad.  When I’m washing it out it doesn’t feel like it gets stuck in my hair or burn my eyes😆. To style my spiked hair, I have it damp to start(I’ll usually rinse my hair in the morning real quick in the sink because I’m a night showerer), then with my handle slightly wet I use about a pea size or smaller and add to my hair and style. I’ll do another run if I feel like I need it, or to get me fohawk a little more hawk lol. This is one of those I wish I had the last twenty years
