source_doc: I didn't think I would love it. I honestly wasn't expecting to love this game.  I was waiting for Frosthaven to arrive from the kickstarter and was jonesing for a card game fix that was easy to set up.  Then I saw the reviews for this and figured I'd give it a try since I had a gift card to burn.  Well glad I did, I put 70 hours into it before the credits rolled and I'm waiting for all the DLC to get released before playing it again on new game plus. I'll be honest I haven't had a game tickle me like that since DBZ: Kakarot a few years back.The game loop is nice; get cards, get powers, and make friends.  The combo of it all worked perfect for me, and I was telling my wife dumb stories from the game about blade and captain marvel cute romance or the book club which I found hilarious.  Also one of the first times I've liked captain America.  Or I should say I got him in a way the movies/comics never worked for me.  I still don't like Tony, but that's not a surprise he's a terrible human being.I'm excited for the DLC and what they add since I figure I'll be putting in another 40-60 hours easily to platinum the game on my NG+ run.

source_doc: This comes in real handy even if you think it won't. These oil 'suckers' have been around for a while but I never thought I would use one. Let me tell you I was wrong. I wanted to do something simple as a test so I changed the oil in one of my mowers. I removed the dipstick and inserted the larger tube and pumped a few times (maybe 5-6) and the oil began flowing out.  I pumped a few more times and within 3-5 minutes I had removed all the oil from the crankcase. There was no mess. The spherical accumulator showed the exact amount I removed and I replaced that amount into my mower. Very easy deal.I will note that many new zero turn mowers are sold with 'lifetime' filled transaxles and I had been putting off purchasing one because of this. Now that I have this extractor pump I know I can change the fluid and prolong the life of the transmission. Fluid changes can be very cumbersome for a unit that was never meant to have the fluid changed but this extractor will make it easy.I wish there was storage for the tubes and the extra caps that come with the unit. Also, you need to be careful to keep the rubber isolator straight (unbent) between the tube and the tank or you may lose vacuum while pumping.Overall, this is a good deal on a very useful tool.

source_doc: Awesome Poor Man's Peloton. I purchased this about a year ago to use as a cheap alternative to a Peloton. Assembly was super easy. I added a bluetooth Wahoo cadence tracker, my Apple Watch for heart rate, and my iPad fit perfectly on top to stream the Peloton app. The only thing I cannot replicate is the resistance and I just go by how hard they say it should be, it works for me. I love it. I have a quiet room it is tucked away in that I can work out in and have had absolutely zero problems other than the infamous seat squeak which only happens if I fidget. I am just at the point that cages are getting annoying and I am going to put clipless pedals on but the cages worked fine. For reference, I am 5'1", 200lbs, and have never broken a pedal standing to ride or had any clunking noises. I do feel like I could use one more tiny click lower on the seat to perfect the alignment, or farther forward but not to the point it is uncomfortable.

source_doc: Fun. I bought this in November, tomorrow it will be January and I have yet to finish the game as I’m having so much fun exploring and dinking around as I play. The graphics are great when they’re not glitching but glitches are momentary and I’ve only become stuck in game once and the game did self correct after a minute so it does have safety features that I’m grateful for. I wasn’t sure how I’d like the tera evolution deal but it’s not bad but I don’t really use the feature although I do enjoy the battles against the tera Pokémon too. I do wish I could customize more of what my character is wearing as the school uniform kinda sucks and I love customizations so much but I am glad I can change between seasonal wear. The new Pokémon are interesting and I’m enjoying learning about them too.

source_doc: Very useful, built in metronome is nice. As a person who has been playing bass for almost 16 years now, I tend to try to get whatever equipment I can. For years I had been looking for a metronome, but never really found one at a price point I wanted. After seeing that this tuner has a built in metronome, I decided to give it a try. I charged it with the included cable and first tested it as a tuner. I used the included (piezo?) sensor on the headstock of my acoustic and it seems to be just as accurate as any other tuner I've used in the past. Afterwards, I played with the metronome for a bit, adjusted the tempo, changed up the rhythms, and was quite surprised with the variety of beats I could get out of it. If I didn't already have a designated tuner pedal, I'd probably use this at my local church where I play bass. Display is pretty good, and easy to read, too, so there's that.Overall, I'm satisfied with it. I give it a thumbs up.

source_doc: Just what I needed. With a young kid and a baby on the way I wanted something that could accommodate both kids.  I really like that there is space for the baby but also a seat for when my older one wants to ride instead of walk.  She is usually really good about walking but I worry she will get jealous of the baby in the stroller and this is a nice way to avoid that.  I really like the cup holders for my drinks as I can put a drink for me and a drink for my older kid in it and keep my hands more free.  I admit I don't leave my phone in the tray.  The under storage is big enough for the things I think I need to bring but I tend to store stuff there I don't need as often.  I like that the baby seat can recline or go more upright as my little one grows.  The canopy is small but easy to position.  I like how easy it is to fold up, this works best when the basket is empty.  I do not have the matching car seat so I can not comment on that.

source_doc: Just what I needed. incremental degrees of lighting is helpful. I needed a lamp for my desk, so I was pleased to try this gooseneck lamp. It clamps onto the desk securely via a spinning C-clamp (as opposed to one you pinch to open). Since it can be tightened and loosened it is quite stable. I tried this lamp in different positions so I clamped it and reclamped it with no issues until I found exactly where I wanted it.I REALLY like that I can increase the light output incrementally (10 levels) from quite dim to nice and bright. There are also 3 different light modes: warm light (2700K), warm white light (4500K), and cool light (6500K). Each of these modes also can be increased/decreased incrementally. Really nice for helping prevent eye fatigue.The neck/arm is 24" and the light strip is 11". I really didn't notice the power supply before I got it, and assumed that it was a normal plug, but it has a USB plug at the end instead. It seems that I'm finding this to be the case more and more. Not an issue except I have to grab some more USB adapter blocks.Made in China.

source_doc: Great for traveling. I have 7 kids so I've had a lot of baby gear. This is one thing I wish I bought sooner. It's very compact and easy to set up. I used it for my toddler at Thanksgiving when we visited family out of state. He's currently 20 months and I anticipate it wouldn't work well once he's two because it's a little small. His little brother will use it later. I just set it up on the floor and still need to install the straps to used on a chair so I can't say if it's easy or not. The main things I love about the booster is the look and the removable tray insert. The only thing I think is dumb is the little spot on the tray that has like a cut out for tiny utensils. It's pointless because only doll utensils are that small. Other than that I love it. It's sturdy and easy to use. Oh and the best part is the way the tray can be removed or swing open on either side. It's a good design. Also the cover is easier removable to be washed which is a must! That makes it better than other brands I looked at.

source_doc: Its a gd enuf substitute. Glad i found this, i really hate to throw away a working Fairywell E11 just bec they do not sell replacement heads anymore. Mighty irresponsible of this company and i am not going to buy another Fairywell product bec i am forced to be so eco unfriendly. I must thank the customer who replied to the question if these heads can fit FW-E11, and he said he managed to use them for his E11. I went ahead trusting his ans. It does not click fit, but it works fine. I dare not take chance on those heads from other sellers that clearly state not meant for FW-E11, although i suspect it probably also can work.Anyway, this heads are smaller than the original FW heads, but i am ok with it bec i like small heads brushes that can reach further in anyway. They are not as lasting as the originals as well, but its not by too much, and at this reasonable pricing, i am happy to change them out to be more hygienic.

source_doc: Build Quality Could be Better. I purchased the ES110 based on exhaustive research and reading reviews. I also own an upright Kawai piano. What convinced me to purchase it was the key action and sound quality. I primarily wanted a piano and didn't need a lot of other features.When I set up the ES110 I noticed a fair amount of noise from some keys clacking when released (plastic on plastic). Most keys seemed adequately sound dampened but some were not. I contacted the vendor and Kawai support. The vendor told me to contact Kawai support as well. I never heard back from them.The clacking key noise was driving me crazy so I returned the ES110 and asked a few different music stores what they would recommend. I Purchased the Roland FP30X. I didn't purchase the Roland initially because a reviewer said the keys were a little too heavy and it might not be the best for high speed fingering used in classical music. I've also been very satisfied with my Kawai upright.The Roland keys feel much more solid with no clacking noise. The build quality on the Roland seems better than the ES110. Maybe the key feel is a little heavier but you can adjust the Key Touch to make it feel lighter.I really wanted to love the ES110 and was very disappointed. Maybe I got a lemon. The Roland FP30EX has been great so far.

source_doc: pretty good at getting a close shave wherever you choose to shave. I use a popular subscription service, but I keep forgetting to order a new handle. I like to keep 2 handles, 1 in each bathroom. I use it to shave all over, including my face (no, tis a total myth that hair grows back more course). It helps keep my skin ultra smooth, and unless going to a professional, it is the exact same thing as other so called DIY dermaplaning gadgets. I swear, the pink tax on some stuff, some of which is our fault for buying into it all. So until I actually remember to buy another handle, I decided to just grab one of these. I like it enough that I may or may not bother with an additional handle (though I have dozens of razor heads so I may not want to have to add in another purchase). but for $15 or so bucks, I think it is reasonable. Has a good close shave, skin feels soft and smooth, if I take care of the razor head it should stay sharp for awhile. So far so good.

source_doc: Thick, plush & WARM as advertised!! Sir Thomas is a stray ( in pic), roaming the neighborhood; came up missing for a few days; when he did return, he had been in a fight. I brought out the new (still in box) thermal cat mat-pad, folded a blanket throw underneath the Morapet, so he’d be elevated a bit. This fellow didn’t hesitate; it’s as if his name was on it, got right in, laid down and was out like a light. Slept several hours. Outside temp was 47°. I called our Vet, no openings for another 4 days. I’m trying to get him to trust me more, so I can get him fixed, but this injury took front-runner, I can work on trust later. Originally, I had browsed all the other brands of self-warming mat-pads for one of our senior indoor cats, as I needed another self-warming mat-pad for Geno… I settled on this one for it’s plush fabric &  thickness, but when I saw Sir Thomas’ eye injury,  the 3 deep gashes on his paw and small bit of missing fur on his hind area, I felt this warming mat-pad really needs to go to him. Before his injury, he’d just sleep wherever he could.I was so impressed with the quality of workmanship, the thickness, plush & warmth of this product. I will be buying another 1 or 2 to replace Geno’s.  YES I would recommend this product !!

source_doc: Use force and don’t touch with skin when applying adhesive pads. I applied mine to wood paneling and some kind of dropped ceiling material as well as drywall. These were all freshly pained with an eggshell finish.The part that may help you- Given other reviews I was aware of adhesion problems so I made sure not to touch them with my skin AT ALL. I removed the pad from the sheet with tweezers (leaving the backing on the one side) and placed it on the fattest part of the butterfly body where the magnet is. I then pressed it on hard using my fingers, thumb on the pad and the rest on the other side of the body. And I do mean hard. After doing them all my fingers really hurt. After this I then removed the paper backing and applied them to the surface and pressed HARD repeatedly. A few of them I heard a crack because I pressed so hard but not sure where I cracked as it wasn’t visible.I have had 3 fall. One after 2 days, another after a week, and then another 3 weeks later. I put each of these back up using superglue.Other than that, haven’t had any problems. I believe that using force and avoiding getting skin oils on them was helpful.

source_doc: Perfect fit for SRX 2012 13582688...Why I remember this number? Because this was the BCM number in my SRX, and I had a hard time finding it new. That was also before I learned EEPROM...anyways. I saw this one, and it was reasonable, I tried to google to see if it will work, no clear answer. I finally contacted Cadillac and they told me yes it fits, then I purchased it. I did have hard time to get the car start even after programming the part, then I copied the EEPROM from my old BCM, wrote that in the chip, it showed "EEPROM PROGRAM INCORRECT". So what to do? I just ran SPS2 and reprogrammed the BCM again, then everything worked. Car started fine, most of the error message is gone on the dash. That was great! Then I purchased ALLDATA subscription, and under the BCM replacement, it showed this one as the only one fit for my car. So happy!

source_doc: Excellent quality and lovely zippered case. I think another reviewer said these weren’t made of real memory foam, but when I compared it to my other memory foam pillows, it was definitely the same quality.I also like the fact that they were no offgassing smells when I resuscitated the pillow from being compressed in a small box.The thing with these pillows, and I have been using them for years from different  companies, is you have to try them for yourself. There are subtle differences in the dimensions of each one, and our bodies are differently designed, so you just have to experiment.I tried it with, and without the inner insert, without the insert it was just a little too floppy, even though it felt comfortable to lie on.The only other thing I want to mention is the case, while it is really beautiful quality and aesthetically designed, is a little too long for the actual pillow I received. When I see a little, I mean about an inch.This doesn’t really affect anything, so I didn’t take any stars away for it, it’s just some thing you might wanna know when events. I think it’s very good quality and looked as if it would last a long time. That said, you can find less expensive models that might do the trick for you, but I doubt they will be queen-size, they will probably be standard size.

source_doc: Blender, frother or shaker bottle works best with this. In adding 3 scoops to my 12 oz coffee, I found it didn't mix thoroughly. Next try, I added 1 scoop to my coffee and it mixed up a little better using just one scoop. I then added an another scoop to a 1/3 cup half & half (yes, I like a little coffee with my creamer lol). I used my cordless frother and it mixed up fine. I am not sure 2 scoops in the creamer would have worked as well. I'm ok with only using 2 scoops a day; it's better than nothing.  The flavor was nice, but I also add flavored syrup to my coffees as well.  Next day, I put 3 scoops in a blender bottle (with wire wisk ball) along with 12 oz of milk and half a packet of chocolate breakfast drink mix. Then, shook and shook and shook. It mixed up great and tasted awesome.  I removed a star only because I didn't feel this worked as well as I thought it should in hot coffee. It's better than some, but still not awesome.

source_doc: Great Product For Automobiles Or Any Filling Need! I used this product to repair a hole in the front bumper of my wife's car after an accident! I had a hole about 3 inches by 4 inches that was in need of repair. What I liked about this product was that I did not have to put a bunch of materials together or make a big batch for such a small job.I packed the hole with some newspaper; then I left about a half inch depth from the front of the bumper to fill. I took out about a cup of putty from the can with a plastic putty knife and then  added about a half inch line of hardener from the package.I then stirred the material until the colors blended well and applied it to the bumper. I did read where other users added too much hardener and it hardened on them rapidly; but I did not experience that problem with my batch. As a matter of fact, it took around an hour to dry completely which led me to believe I was a little too lenient on the hardener. It worked well though and I sanded it down within three hours and painted it the next day.You really can't tell that the hole was there at all; with the exception of paint difference. I strongly recommend this product for any of your patching needs!

source_doc: Not sure if it worked, but my tank was cycled quickly. I watched a bunch of youtube videos and was expecting to get some giant algae bloom or a huge spike in nitrites and then nitrates.  I never experienced any of this. I was so unsure if my tank was cycled. I tested my water consistently, for 2 weeks no change. Then i bought a small rock covered in algae from petco and put it in there. I shined a flashlight that night and saw it had some good hitchhikers in it. Tiny Stomatella snails, and alot of amphipods. I watched them for a week and they were thriving so i knew it was obviously cycled now. Then i bought one fish, a diamond goby. That guy is the best purchase ive made. He is a workhorse and keeps my entire sandbed clean of all extra food. Anyways... he was happy in there. So then i knew it was safe to add more.  My tank is 75 gallons with live sand and dry live rock carib sea. The only wet live rock i added was that tiny one from petco.  I think it works. Still not sure really if it was this stuff or the extra time i gave it.

source_doc: These really work! I took these for the first time and had great results. I chose a night when I was pretty sure I would have trouble sleeping (Sunday night for teachers is the worst and I napped too much on Sunday afternoon). I took one gummy a hour and a half before bed because I wanted to make sure it wore off by morning. I was sleepy within 30 minutes! I made myself wait until bedtime and then slept peacefully. My cat woke me up once and I woke up another time naturally to go to the bathroom. Normally I wake up several times a night, so this was a huge improvement. I also have an issue with eating snacks at night, but I did not eat a single thing that night. I’m not sure if it keeps you too tired to be hungry or if it creates an appetite suppressant effect, but whatever it is, I am pleasantly surprised. I will be reordering when I run out. I will also be taking the gummy closer to bedtime!

source_doc: Amazing red light handheld. I got this because around the winter I tend to get cold sores and I currently have one on the side of my lips and I want it gone.  It came packaged well and I didn't notice any defects on it.  In the package, you get the light, two batteries, a charger for the batteries, glasses, a microfiber cloth, and a case for it all.  I really like that this comes with removable batteries instead of being charged in the device as when one battery dies I can have the other ready to go. The light really is really bright and you can feel your skin heating up when you have it on. There are three different lights red, blue and red, and blue though I primarily use blue and red. I used this on my cold sore and I guess it has made it speed up healing kinda hard to tell without going to the dr.  Out of all the handheld red light devices I have tried this one is definitely the best I've tried.

source_doc: In The Stars. I LOVE this scent and have it in the body lotion and spray. When I saw the fragrance plug in I had to try it. I have never used a wallflower plug in before so I had no idea how it would work or how I would like it. The product came on time, packaged well with no damage. I put one in my small guest bathroom and WOW. It smells just like the body products! If you love In the Stars, you will love this. The room is small but the throw is just perfect. The smell is noticeable but not obnoxious. It makes me happy when I walk in there. I just added one to my bedroom so I’ll see how it works in a larger space. This scent is clean while being sexy, girly and like nothing else. It is not overpowering and not too feminine that my husband won’t like it. It just plain smells amazing! I will probably put at least one downstairs too. I think I’ll buy more because it is not gettable on the BBW site. Did I say I love this?

source_doc: I'm obsessed. I bought this because I was of course influenced by Tik Tok... and I'm so happy I was. I don't like going to the gym & my yoga studio closed in my neighborhood, so I really needed a way to get some exercise in. Keep in mind I also live with 2 roommates so I needed something I can do in my 10 ft by 10ft room. This is AMAZING. It's a great workout-- I definitely feel the burn! It comes with the resistance bands, great to strengthen arms, I even use weights too. It was so easy to set up, didn't even have to do much. It even comes with a screen to keep track of time, calories and steps. This took a couple tries to figure out how to manage the screen, but easy once I got the hang of it. I couldn't recommend this enough!!

source_doc: Works great for me! As I have gotten older and I suppose less active, I seem to have more trouble going and staying asleep. I did not want to take a prescription sleep aid, so I tried the Sleep Foundation formula with melatonin. supplement, and I am glad that I did. I have tried other melatonin supplements but really did not have good results. This product not only helped me get to sleep faster, but I stayed asleep most of the night with the exception of having to get up to go to the bathroom as usual. I did not feel groggy in the morning and according to my sleep tracker, I was sleeping better. I believe that the price is a little high as similar products sell for quite a bit less, but if it keeps working for me it is worth it.

source_doc: Wish the Structural Part was Better Designed. I so want to love this bag for cloth diapers. It does very well with keeping the smell contained, looks nice, and I love the zipper bottom and how it fits with a hanger. However, the plastic pieces that provide the structure push themselves through the fabric during the washing process. I have mended it multiple times and they keep finding ways to push through...and the main one is difficult to put back in. The last time it happened, I decided I was done fixing it and got a different bag. The fabric near the ends of these plastic pieces needs to be reinforced. My other issue is that after washing once I left it in the washer a little too long and after going through the dryer on highest heat there were little spots that I guess I assumed were mold spots. I immediately washed again and made sure to move to dryer right away and they seemed to be gone. But they have come back over and over. I'm not sure how to dry hanging and keep these spots from developing, and the dryer makes the plastic pieces push through the fabric worse. If this bag was redesigned with reinforcements, I would consider purchasing again because I do like it apart from the two issues I talked about.

I will admit that I am quite often unhappy with these products because of their odor; I simply cannot stand anything that smells like BenGay or Mentholatum. These odors are so pervasive and make my pajamas, my sheets and my pillowcase reek—one use and the odors refuse to dissipate until I shower and wash all my bedding! The other thing is that I dislike anything that causes sensations to my skin—burning, cooling or otherwise.Now let me tell you about my experience with Theraworx: NO odor whatsoever; NO burning, cooling, prickling sensations; and NO sticky, unpleasant residue on my hands. I can use it at my bedside without having to get up and wash my hands before going to sleep. But, of course, that is not the best part. The best part is that IT ACTUALLY WORKS—every time, at least for me! I highly recommend that you give this product a try. I am so glad I did!

source_doc: Always Have Loved Maple Necks/Fingerboards. I dont "get" alot of these reviews.  I've been playing forty years and have had at least five dozen guitars running the gamut of pricing.  You never know with a guitar, they all are different.  Personally, i have always liked maple necks and fretboards.  It has a soft, easy to play feel.  If it doesn't feel right, NOTHING else matters.  This guitar feels good and makes it easy and fun again, the same can't be said of plenty of guitars I've owned over the years.  I've had cheaper guitars feel great and really expensive guitars feel like crap.  As long as it feels good, i can get a good sound by using pedals.  I was very pleasantly surprised.  The tuning is a slight issue but stretch them good and/or put a new set on it.  The finish I think is great, too.  I like it so much i am going to get another.  That'll be a fun comparison.  Like i said, you never know.  I think it's a crapshoot.  I don't trust so-called luthiers, either.  I've had plenty of guitars come back less-playable.  These were well-respected people.  It's either playable or not.  I like this little thing.

source_doc: Easy to swallow capsules. I purchased a bottle of Surebounty Magnesium Malate 90 count. When reading all the pro’s & con’s about this product, I knew I wanted to try it. The one thing I liked was the fact their capsules are so easy to swallow. That means a lot to me. As I get older I am not able to swallow big capsules anymore. I am happy to see they do not use any fillers or binders. The capsules are non GMO/dairy/gluten free. So far I am very pleased with this product. I would definitely recommend.

source_doc: Awesome with a Catch... I really hate breaking the wood hotrods and then buying them again, only to break them again. The Kuppmen carbon fiber rods seem to be the answer to this issue. I love the way they feel, and they sound just great on my hi hats when I need less attack but still want to play pretty hard. Rebound from the snare is awesome, and all around they're just a pleasure to play with.BUT... the center rod will eventually fly out! This usually happens mid song, and I usually realize it when I go to hit the snare and I get the crash (12 inches behind the snare) instead. Then I have to use a drumstick to smash the rod back into place and hope it doesn't come out again. I've considered pulling the center rod and putting a dab of superglue on the very bottom of it, but I kind of wish I didn't have to do that, considering how expensive these rods are. I don't mind paying the price, but I expect durability, you know?Otherwise, I love them!

source_doc: Exactly what I wanted. I am not a big fan of water. I can’t explain it, I just never really like it unless I’m severely dehydrated. Since I don’t drink sodas or sugary drinks, that means I usually just drink coffee or tea all day. Not exactly the best choice as that’s a lot of caffeine. So I determined that I’m going to drink more water. I swear the water tastes funky to me if it comes out of stainless steel containers. I can only tolerate drinking water from glass or ceramic vessels. Plastic is out of the question to touch my food or drinks.  I know- I’m picky. I couldn’t find any large volume glass water bottles locally, so I turned to Amazon. I completely love this water bottle. I’ve been throwing some frozen fruit & chopped cucumber in there & filling it with filtered water to infuse. It has been a game changer. It’s also easy to use, easy to clean, no leaks, and you can use the straw or not depending on your preference. Yeah, you have to be careful not to throw it around since it’s glass, but the carry handle is very sturdy. I love everything about it!

source_doc: What I expected for the price. I had to send the first order of these baskets back due to damage to the large & medium basket. They are woven around a wire frame and I am sure they will hold up once filled, Another complaint was the inside metal pieces that hold the straps in place. The baskets I purchased are safe. The pointy ends are tucked under the weave. I figured if there was any danger I would simply cover the metal with some sturdy tape, All in all I am pleased with my purchase and I would recommend these baskets.

source_doc: WOW. I am no longer a Sacrete guy. I set a 4x4, 8 foot post using this product.  I made a hole 2 feet deep, 7 to 8 inch diameter.  One package of this stuff nearly filled the entire hole with the post centered in it.  Mixed it exactly as the instructions dictate. I was initially disappointed because the liquid I poured in only filled up a couple of inches.  I was using a 2-foot level to confirm the pole was remaining vertical and then I looked in the hole and it was more than half-way full up with foam and I could see it rising. In perhaps 5 minutes more, it was nearly completely full up on all four sides.  After 15 minutes I removed the straps I was using to hold the post in place, and light pressure on the sides of the post showed no give in the foam, it was solid enough to leave standing alone.  Incredibly easy compared to how I used to have to mix a bag of sacrete by hand and carry the 30 or 40 pounds around.  Wish I had another project needing another bag of this stuff so I could do it all again, it was well, "fun".

source_doc: Best value for the price. I like the Old Mother Hubbard minis.  They're the perfect size for rewarding my dogs (I have large dogs).  I appreciate that the ingredients are better than many of the comparable treats, such as Milk Bones, and yet the price is more reasonable than brands like Blue.  My dogs are eager to be treated with them, so they must taste good.  As I stated, I have large dogs, so we do go through them somewhat quickly.  For this reason, I buy the 6lb boxes.  I get more for the cost.  I do feel like these could be better packaged.  The box isn't tightly sealed, just taped along the middle.  The biscuits are in a large plastic bag inside the box which isn't sealed either.  I do worry that these could easily be contaminated by their surrounding environment.  It would not be difficult for a mouse to crawl under the flap of the box and get inside the bag of biscuits.  Definitely something I think the manufacturer should consider.  When I get mine, I fill the treat jar and then store the remaining in the deep freezer until I need them.  (My German Shepherd is allergic to storage mites, so this helps me negate that issue.)

I was able to lift the corner up a little bit with a metal finger nail file and then I just sanded it off with the tool.🥰. I even filed all my toenails down.

source_doc: Stains skin, medium brown is black. I have been using henna on my hair for over a decade and never though of dying my eyebrows with it since usually the package says not to. source_doc: Great idea. Does not work well. I love the idea of this device. I'm always looking for ways to do nordic curls and Spanish squats. I don't like using a strap for sit ups as I think it's too much of a crutch. However, I was excited about using this strap for nordic curls and Spanish squats. This does not execute at all. First off I am a small woman with size 6 feet and I feel like for nordic curls you need to have bigger (longer) feet to even remotely make this work on the shortest length. This did not work for me at all. It worked only slightly better for my very tall husband with huge feet but not even very well for him. As for the Spanish squat this is where the device works the best. I tried it for sit ups and it was impossible again due to my small stature. Didn't work great for my large husband either. I really wanted to like this but the design is not right. I followed the directions and I am a personal trainer so I thought I might be able to figure out an alternate way to make it work but I did not. On the plus side, the device does seem fairly well built. The foam of the pads is a little soft and dented on first use. The buckle and straps appear quality and secure.

source_doc: Great Dry Bag! I like this bag because it has a clear window so I can kinda tell where things are at. I purchase towards the end of the season so I only have used it a few times I can not really comment on the durability. It appears to be constructed well  however there are seams throughout the bag its not 1 peace nor do I think it would be possible to make it that way. Like anything with seams its more apt to leak in wet conditions although the few time I had it out kayaking on the water and exposed it to water everything i packed in it stayed dry. I can fit a beach size towel some sweats and sweat shirt a t-shirt socks etc. my DSLR with a lens an additional lens snacks etc its pretty roomy and it all stayed dry rolling around in the bottom of the boat. I may have had a few drops of water on the top layer where it was folded twice and not 3 times but it was stuffed and I was experimenting how much i could actually carry with me. I say its a good quality for the price and would recommend to anyone looking for this size however I can not comment on durability as I've only used a few times at the end of the season.

source_doc: Great for Dog Training Gloves. I have learned that my dogs and I both do better when I wear gloves while training them. I have a better grip on toys and tugs, and when my pups see me don a pair of gloves they get excited because it is time to WORK. I have been using leather gloves, and they get gross very quickly.These Manusage work gloves are exactly what I need for training. Obviously, they'd work well for gardening and other things around the house too, but dog training is what I'm most excited about. Slobber doesn't soak through these gloves to make my hands cold or stinky. The gloves themselves dry out quickly so they don't get stinky (leather gloves...ewwwww). The gloves grip things very well so I am no longer dropping slippery slobbery toys and balls. They do actually work on a touchscreen - I tried them out just to see - but I highly doubt I will be using a screen with slobber covered gloves.After multiple sessions of training dogs with the same pair of gloves, I may never need to buy any again...or at least, it will be a couple of years since I have 12 pairs now. The medium size fit as I expected as I typically wear a medium in work gloves.

I wish they would make something for people who have bad water pressure but not quite as forceful as this. I’m gonna fiddle with it and figure something out for rinsing my hair. I literally was going to sell my co op because of horrible water pressure in the shower even though I have tried EVERY hand held shower head. This thing is the reason I have decided to stay. I can actually get clean in the shower now. The shower spray side is useless. The end that is supposedly for cleaning the shower is GREAT if you have non existent water pressure.

source_doc: White Light=Bright White. I have used several different Chemical Guys detailing products. Some I like better than others and this is one of them. I have a white metallic vehicle and I wanted to see if I could find a product that really makes the white “pop.” I tried a few different things and even though they looked good, I never got the “pop” I was seeking. Also, many of these other products are magnets for dust and even though I don’t drive anywhere near dirt roads or live in a particularly dusty area, my car would would coated with dust just days after I detailed it. I did not find that issue with White Light. In fact, it hasn’t rained in a week since I detailed my vehicle and it doesn’t have much dust sitting on it at all. The white is bright and crisp and has a deep shine. I will definitely continue to use Chemical Guys White Light for my white vehicle.

source_doc: Good seat for floor play. I bought this seat for my 5 month old to help her sit up even though I was hesitant. We are doing as much of the Montessori method as possible, so I do my best to minimize her time spent in ‘containers’. There are still times where I want/need her to sit by herself for independent play while I complete a task and this fits the bill.The seat is lightweight, which makes it easy to move from room to room or travel with. The tray is very easy to install. Right now I put her in it and place on or two of the toys in our current rotation for her to play with on it. She seems to focus on them more in this upright position than she does in tummy time. I only use the seat after she has had some tummy time and I don’t keep her in it for more than 15-20 minutes.For what it is, I think the price is high. I don’t really need it as a booster seat, as we have a tripp trapp high chair and a Montessori table we’ll use when she starts solids next month. I can see how it would be helpful to people who don’t have or don’t want to buy those things.

source_doc: Bright is a Under Statement. I have been wanting to switch over to LED's for awhile now, but I have held off because the colors of LED's were more pastel and didn't look good to me. So I can honestly say these do look great and remind me of my classic C9's. I still have over 20 strands of C9 Christmas Lights from the 70's that are still going strong with GE light blubs. More than half are still original and look great, but as you can guess my light bill for Nov. - Jan. shoots up a lot when using.So when I saw these lights I decided to try one box. When they came and I first tried out I was blown away how good they looked.  They look so good. I will be definitely getting more.  Well let me redo that last statement. If these hold up this season, and make it through the cold weather, rain, snow, ice. Then I will be getting more. I will update later if they don't, but for now all is good.

source_doc: It’s all about THAT Bass. I recently purchased a Fender Aerodyne Jazz bass.  This particular bass has no fret markers on the fingerboard, which makes for a nice, clean look.  I normally don’t pay any attention to the markers on the fingerboard, so no problem.  Here’s the problem.  I’m visually impaired and I DO rely on the markers that are in the neck of the bass.  The Aerodyne came with tiny , white dots that I couldn’t see while playing.I tried 1/8” inch dots, but they were too small.  I then ordered these 1/4” dots and they are perfect.  They were easy to apply, and seem to stay adheres pretty well to the neck.  Even if I have to replace them regularly, it’s worth it.  I was about ready to return the bass, not because I didn’t like it, but because it was too difficult to play well.  These simple dots saved the day for me as I love this bass!  See picture for details.  No jokes about them not being straight cuz I already told you I can’t see lol.

source_doc: Absolutely Beautiful!! As an avid, long time bass fisherman, I am quite used to paying, what my wife considers to be, big money for a good reel.  I use only bait casters for my bass fishing and relegate spin casters for light stuff like crappie and brim.I really didn't expect too much considering the price of the reel.When I took it out of the box and unwrapped it, my chin dropped to my chest.  This reel is beautiful.Once I got past my initial surprise, I started to inspect it closely for the features that I would pay big bucks for.  I found all the features of my more expensive reels and more.  I would normally change out the crank handles for the ones with soft, grippable rubber handles.  This reel already had those.  I got the owners manual and read it from cover to cover and found it to be the most comprehensive and instructive manual I have ever seen.  It explained every single thing about the reel in very understandable English.I have yet to fish this reel, but if it works as good as it looks, I won't be dissatisfied in the least.I highly recommend this reel to serious fishermen everywhere.  I am considering buying another for my flipping rod.

source_doc: What a relief! I didn’t know that such a device existed, however, I will now share my new discovery with friends! My hunch is that I need to develop a new habit of consciously tucking the belt beside the seat as I’m leaving the car so I don’t shut the door on the belt.My biggest regret is that I didn’t discover this device years ago when I was doing more cross-country road trips!

source_doc: I used these to protect my chicken runs. These are great!  I actually bought several after the first one impressed us.  Last year, my first year with chickens, I got expensive, opaque, heavy plastic and put around the runs (I have 4).  It did the trick, no issues there, but I had to staple it on.  Taking it off was tedious since I wanted to save it, given the price.  I saw these and ordered one to see how we liked it.  The rivets meant we could screw it into the wood (or use cable ties on the wire runs), making removal and reuse next year much easier.  The little "block" design allows more light inside the runs, which is great because the chickens do need light to stay healthy.  It's a toss up - light vs. keeping wind and elements down so they don't freeze.  I feel like this does a good job at both.  The tricky part came when I had to use them side by side because, while the screws were fine, the cable ties left a gap. I fixed that by using Gorilla tape, which sticks well in inclement weather.  Overall, very happy to have found these and I got them at a good price, which is awesome since my pet chickens cost more than any other animal I've ever had in my life!  They're spoiled, but I wouldn't have it any other way.

source_doc: Great for any wide mouth water storage jug. Since we had my daughter and the ridiculous amount of distilled water we used for her I bought a home water distiller so I didn't have to go to the store all the time to get distilled water.  The only problem was I was only able to do a gallon every three hours and when I was just using it for the kid that was fine but since we have hard water I've started using it for my humidifiers, coffee, tea, basically anything that water quality matters on so I needed to find a way to store it.  I got a couple of empty jugs and an electric pump to get the water out with, the only problem is sometimes I need to charge the pump and I don't want to leave the water open to our air which is why I got these.  They fit on both of my 5-gallon and 3-gallon just fine and keep the air out while I do whatever I need to do.  I don't have any gripes about these and they work as expected.

source_doc: Solid basic arm. Honest review! Bought this because i wanted a basic simple arm for my mic. Easy to install and works as advertised. It is a little clunky and the motion is very meh. But for what i paid for it… Come on. I don’t get any metal ringing through recordings if i hit the stand slightly like in some others i’ve had. The medium sized one was perfect for what i needed. The large would have probably been returned. If i had to pick out one thing i love and hate? I LOVE the base that goes to the desk. Very solid and makes me feel confident in it. The thing i HATE? This arm would be 10/10 if they made a simple design change on the mic holder. I want it to be able to turn full radius. Up, down, left, right, ect. It’s a little limited. Up and down only. Now I KNOW i can buy a separate piece to make that happen and it is probably designed for that. But it would be a game changer if it just DID THIS TO BEGIN WITH. 4/5 stars good

source_doc: Cable works great, Operator is clueless. A few decades ago I was a techie and computer programmer.  However management and 20 years in retirement have taken a toll on my knowledge as this stuff keeps getting more complicated.  Before the Quest 2 I had an Oculus Go since it came out.  I finally decided it was time to upgrade with the 2.  I'm struggling comprehending this new adventure.  I probably should have just stayed with the Go.Anyway, I thought tying the 2 to my laptop would do something for me so I ordered this cable as the cableless method reportedly has disconnects.  I found information on line on how to connect and started the process.  I found the required software, App in today's vocabulary, and loaded  it on my laptop.  I had one hiccup attaching the cable since my laptop only has USB C connections and I needed an A.  I tried one adapter and it wouldn't connect.  However, on a second one, it hooked right up.The cable works great as far as linking your PC to the Quest 2.  What you do afterward, I don't have a clue.  I think I need to find a seven year old to teach me or find the Youtube that I haven't found yet.

source_doc: Headache relief!! Sometimes I need 2-3 ice packs for my head when I have a bad headache. I forgot about it and expected a block of ice, but wow. This head wrap was still soft and pliable, not frozen at all. It was cold like it was frozen though! I slipped the wrap over my head and immediately realized this product is way better than everything I used before. I can get relief in all areas of my head and eyes, unlike all of my other packs. The material is soft and silky like a fancy eye mask. I will be ordering more to switch out since I usually need more than one pack. I'm really relieved to have found a great product to help me deal with my tension headaches.

source_doc: Almost perfect. Better as a light feature. I tried a few sound machines but this one was the best I found for my needs. I tried the portable frida, VTech soother with the app (similar to hatch), Google mini speaker, or just a fan running. I wanted a sound machine that worked with Google Home, had a reliable app, good sound quality and sound options, and dynamic lighting that I could change colors or dim. The govee sound machine fit most of these. My only issue was the sound options and the speaker sound could be improved. The app had mostly 'natural' sounds like wind, rain, river, fire, and some lullaby options. I just wanted a basic flat white, pink, or brown noise. The closest I found to the white noise is the wind and for some reason the speaker quality didn't block a lot of background noise. I noticed some of the other ones I tried did really well blocking noise because it had better sound frequency range. Other than that this would be perfect. My baby woke up more often using this for sound. The lighting options are really unique so I'll give it that. I like the gaming mode and different lighting combos. I now just use this as a light so I'll keep it.

source_doc: Very disappointed, and had to return. As someone with MCS - multiple chemical sensitivity- any fragrance can make me extremely ill. Someone can walk past me wearing perfume or fabric softener or lotion, and I can become so ill. I will have to be in bed for two or three days. People don’t realize how toxic things are, or are to others around them. Therefore I use products that are natural and clean and pure as far as fragrance goes and have always had good luck with Mrs. Myers products. So I purchased these bottles of hand soap. However, I had a reaction to this fragrance. This does not smell natural. It smells more chemical I used it for about three days in a row to be sure that it truly was this product. I was reacting to, and without a doubt, even after using it, and with the fragrance lingering in the air, I could not enter the room.  Therefore I will no longer use Mrs. Myers products as I cannot trust the source of their fragrance. I do not react to natural essential oils so if the source is truly a natural fragrance, I’m usually good, but not with anything that is chemical. This fragrance does not smell at all natural and smells more chemically derived. I absolutely cannot recommend this product .

source_doc: Hard to press keys. I bought the newer black widow on Dec 23rd 2021 and had it until I bought this one in October of 2022, due to the black widow having a sticky spacebar situation and whenever I hit keys around a and a itself, it would constantly add an a next to the other one to look like leaaving, laake, the like... you probably get the drift.Now only having had this one since October and the other one only lasting 10ish months before I went crazy enough to replace it, the keys on my Ornata are really hard to press down on at times. I can't just do a normal soft typing, I have to force it down with effort when trying to type and that's like half my keys on this keyboard... I didn't spill anything on this keyboard either. I don't know why it is like that. It is driving me crazy though.I am pretty disappointed in razor. I used to recommend them, but two keyboards in a row that aren't making it a whole year? One not even barely half a year? I can't recommend their keyboards anymore. For that I am sad.

source_doc: Better than the Toyota factory links. My elderly Toyota had a rattle that I had a lot of trouble pinning down.  It would happen as I went over some bumps but not others.  It would act up so intermittently that I couldn't figure it out.  After a lot of driving around and head-scratching I finally narrowed it down to a worn out front sway bar link on the passenger side.The factory Toyota links are non-greasable.  Mine lasted almost 200k miles which is certainly a good track record, but when it came time to replace them one of the reasons I chose the Moog parts is because I can grease them.Yeah, I know suspension grease nipples have gone the way of vent windows and manual door locks.  Modern suspension components are Lubed For Life (yeah right) and last a long time.  Except when they don't.  Besides, I don't mind hitting a dozen fittings with the grease gun once every few months.So I bought the Moog links, installed them, and pumped them full of grease.  It's been a few years and almost 100k miles and the Moogs are still going strong.  I think I've lubed them twice in all that time (so much for those grease fittings) but they're as quiet and slop-free as they ever were.If I ever manage to wear out the links again, I'll buy another set of Moogs.

source_doc: I thought it had an on off button. I have a few Snarks  and the pivoting features  have broken..  I had tried to duct tape them, but  ultimately they were finished... Since I have several guitars, my theory is to have a tuner with each guitar... everything in it's place. to replace the Snarks, I ordered 2 FENDER  tuners, wanting to try something different.I  was pleasantly pleased! Fender's oval hinge feature makes me believe that I will not have any breakage issues. The tuner's panel is very easy to read and shuts off in 5 minutes. I've had these tuners  for 2 days now, and so far they are pretty nice. Of course i will come back and update later on in the year, but for now i give it 4 stars until I witness the Fender's durability.One thing I didn't count on, was the lack of an on/off switch. I almost sent the tuners back, but tried it out for the hell of it. The on/off is automatic and shuts itself off in 5 minutes, which is more than enough time to tune up.  If you are jamming and want to tune later in your session, all you have to do is unclip from guitar re-clip to the head stock. I'm guessing the on/off switch is paired up with the tuner's clip on screw. It's not that bad of a feature.Good Job, Fender!

source_doc: Fender Mexico Surprised Me. I have another Mexican Starr I bought many years ago but this is a huge step up in quality. It seems many higher end manufacturers are moving some of their production to Mexico which I think is driving competition. I bought this as used but in very good condition. Very pleased. I had bought the same guitar from Musicians Friend which they sold as a New instrument which was returned. That one was abused so I returned it and was happily surprised when Amazon had one left. The finish is great and I find no faults in quality so far. I also have several American made Strats which surprised me that Fender had an anniversary model made in Mexico but don’t let that fool you. The only big difference I find is this doesn’t have the nitrocellulose finish. I wish they had shipped it in a hard case but I’ll get one for it anyway. The gig bag is their better one but I prefer to protect my favored guitars. Overall I’d say this was a great purchase!

source_doc: It IS lower tracking and lower dust than the other bags, but I'm not sure I'll continue buying it. The litter is made into much larger granules; this is why it tracks less and has less dust. At first, I was not impressed. I was not expecting this kind of dramatic change, so it threw me off guard. However, I gave it a chance, and I like it okay. My cats are fine with it, and it does do what it says it will do. I like that it tracks less; however, I still need to sweep every day because I like my floors litter-free. And I like that it has less dust, but it still has some dust.The only problems with this litter are:- I can imagine it might hurt my cats feet a little more, kind of like walking on gravel instead of sand, but maybe that's not the case (I haven't asked my cats how it feels).- The litter scoops I have don't sift it very well because the slots are a little too small for these large particles.- The clumping ability is still pretty great, but I think it clumps just a little bit less well than the other bags.This is still a 5-star cat litter, but, for me, I think I'm going to switch back to the other bags. It's worth trying, for sure, and it may be better for you depending on your situation.

I looked on the garage door opener for the dangling wire, took the light cover off and saw a red button. This is my learn button. I long pressed II & III until the LED came on and then blinked a bit and went off. Since my learn button was red I clicked the I button 3 times. then pressed one of the different buttons (II or III). Then I pressed the red learn button on the garage door opener and immediately clicked the I button on the new remote. I heard 2 clicks. My light bulb is out or else it probably would have blinked 2 times as well. Afterwards I hit the I button on the remoter and the door opened. Then I hit it again and the door closed. Very easy for me. If what I said isn't clear refer to the directions that are in the box. Plus your learn button may be different. Inexpensive way to get extra remotes or replace broken ones.

source_doc: Great pillow for neck pain. I wasn't sure about buying this pillow mostly because I am not a back sleeper. And while I don't think it has made any difference with my snoring, I do love this pillow. I always thought I loved feather pillows, but after getting this I realized it was because I could bunch them up to be high or low where I wanted. But they don't stay that way... I like this pillow because it is firm but not overly firm and there are various heights. So while I'm on my side, I sleep on one section but if I roll more to my stomach, I can move my head to a different section. And, surprisingly, I do actually enjoy relaxing on my back with my head cradled before I go to sleep. I still don't sleep that way but it's very comfortable to initially wind down

source_doc: Wow just wow. I bought a Grote 335 style guitar a few years ago and am extremely happy with its quality and performance. Because of its price, I thought it might be a fluke. Last week I decided to buy the LP Grote. This guitar arrived in less than a week. I picked the purple tone. I don’t care that it’s a printed front. It’s stunningly beautiful. I am a guitar tech and luthier but I haven’t done a set up to either Grote’s I own and they sound decent right out of the box. That being said, if you are hitting the road or doing studio work I would recommend doing a pro set up on these guitars. I love the amplified sound of the 335 style Grote I own so I expected the same when I tested the new one. when I plugged in the LP I was blown away at the warmest sound I’ve heard in years. No pedals or effects, just amp. This 199.99 guitar was boasting a 1000.00 sound. I would recommend any guitarist who doesn’t have a large budget to look at Grote. If you have a large budget, still look at Grote and spend the rest of a great amp.

I’ve been to Home Depot five times (house project) since then and have forgotten every single time.  The two times remembered and planned on buying, by the time i was done shopping, i had been there so long I’d forgotten again.  I know i can order adhesive but i kind of wanted to see what my options were as first time buying such a product.Although I’d normally wait to write a review until I actually used the product, i thought I’d share my status with these for the guys out there that are forgetful like me, or procrastinators or whoever;  it might better to spend the money and get the self sticking kind just so you can get them hung and be done.  I’m hoping to get there, Hung and Done, soon.  Good luck

source_doc: After a year of trying, I'm over it. I was gifted the Gaming Mouse during the December 2021/ January 2022 holiday season. This item was purchased via Amazon.The mouse started randomly dying and coming back. By that I mean my PC would say it had disconnected, the mouse LEDs would turn off and it the mouse would not respond. Upon research and inspection, it appears that the power cord connection is faulty.There is no stress to the cord, there are no pets or children around to have damaged it. I emailed the seller on Friday, Apr 8, 2022 to inform them of the issue. At that time, I had not had the mouse long enough to consider this routine wear and tear. I love the size and shape of the mouse so I would much rather get a replacement than simply returning it. I received not response. I rigged the mouse together and just focused on controller gaming. It is now January 2023. I loved how big the mouse was so I really tried to like it but its stupid to try and make this work. Please do not buy it. "Lizsword" has a way better mouse. Equally affordable and lasts way longer. My husband has had that brand for years so I should have started with that one.

source_doc: Really happy with these pump dispensers. I wanted some nice soap dispensers for my sinks because I got tired of the expense of buying the much more expensive individual soaps I have gotten for several years. I saw these and I really liked the simple look of them. I like that they are actually glass and not plastic. They came with a silicone funnel which I really didn't need since they have a large enough opening to easily fill with the large soap refill I got. The pump works really well and I am completely happy with this set of two. The labels that come with them are really pretty but I chose not to use them so I appreciate that you can use them or not. I wouldn't want ones that came with labels already attached. I can easily recommend these.

source_doc: Not a clear wipe. I guess I am old, but I remember replacing wiper blades quickly and easily. I have a 2014 Pathfinder and somehow the driver wiper (26") cracked. Still worked fine, but I noticed a slight scratch in the glass. I had a 17" replacement for the passenger side a few weeks ago. I thought I bought the same. Duh. That one is great(Rain-X 5079283-2 Latitude 2-IN-1 Water Repellency Wiper Blade, 17") put on by mech at last oil change. This one hat two other adapters, and I finally removed the one on it as I had the old hook style. Slid on easily, but the cover at the end would not snap shut. I redid it three times. Anywho. at the center of the blade under the connection there is water that is not cleared, and when it hits the water on the right ( next to the rear view mirror) pushed by the passenger blade it hardly wipes it. I am about ready to reorder another like the 17" and keep this for emergencies.

source_doc: Great Faucet - everything else?  Meh. I wanted a Heavy Duty utility sink for the basement.  I liked the look of this. The only positive I can come up with is - the faucet is great - I hope it lasts.  The tub comes with clear and urgent directions on how to assemble it without breaking the tub.  I followed those instructions to the T and the tub broke in three of the four leg attachment locations.  Clearly a bad design.  It's ok though - the faucet seems great so I went ahead and continued the install with the broken - yet still functional - tub.  The p-trap and drain plumbing supplied is hard and brittle.  I needed to cut the drain pipe down about two inches to fit the existing drain - drain pipe shattered not once but twice while cutting it.  Thankfully I was replacing a utility sink so I could use the old plumbing pieces.  There is almost no backsplash on this unit  - so I'm still trying to figure out how I will secure it to the wall - as securing the legs won't help because of the broken tub.  I'm wishing I kept my old tub and just replaced the faucet.  Still looking for a better solution.

source_doc: DIY, Save the mony. The detailer's wanted $1300. I watched 15 different YouTube Videos then decided on Adams. I do have a Quick Jack which made it a bit easier with the car lifted. It was easier than I thought ( I did do my homework). I took my time, started in a less noticeable spot and off to the races. I did have another advantage the car was freshly painted, I waited 3 weeks for the paint to gas off and I was done in 4 hours. It is a Miata MX5 a bit smaller than most cars. I left it in the garage for 24 hours before driving it. The first wash left beads of water and I dried the car with a 550 CFM leaf blower. Didn't even need a towel. I save me some big bucks and felt really good doing it myself.

source_doc: Dressing up the stairway. I had been looking for ideas to dress up the risers on the stairs going to my second floor and was thinking stencils, or different paint, when I came across YouTube videos where diy shows were using this type of dress up for that project.  I had been looking around for awhile for some pattern I liked and came across this one.  It's neutral colors of beige/taupe and blue/grey that should blend in well.  It has a variety of patterns so each stair riser would be different and I like that idea and the look.  Haven't started that project yet as I have to prep the area.  It takes me awhile but I will get to it and I am excited to see how it turns out.  I will post an update when I get to that point.  The strips are a little over 7 inches wide and about 40 inches long.  There are 15 pieces, each a different pattern, all in the same muted shades.  Each piece has backing to protect the sticky side.  Feels pretty sticky so should adhere well.  I believe well worth the $$ if I can get this project done with my time and $40!  We shall see.

source_doc: I use the conceal and perfect foundation and.. So I wanted to love this. I was like "ooh yay, a peach colored product for my eye bags". I had Hope's it would work as well as the LA Color one I use currently. I'm kinda disappointed because this was too sheer and not peachy enough.For reference I wear 2 Natural in Milani's conceal and perfect foundation. I LOVE that stuff. It's amazing. I wear NC25 in MAC.This was far too sheer. The applicator is ok but you're going to want to use a brush to pinpoint areas if that's what you're looking to do. Look.. I know hollows can't be fixed unless I get a bleph or filler. I don't have the money or sucrose father for that yet. So color corrector and concealers are the best I have. But this might be best for someone with very mild darkness and doesn't need a lot of makeup.

source_doc: Waste of money. Works great... until it stops working. I purchased two for a trip I took last December/January where it was going to be cold. I live in Florida, so I did not have to use them again until another trip up North about a month ago. I packed them along with the charger and when I got up there, found they were not working (the light would not turn on once it was connected to charger). Thankfully other friends packed extra disposable hand warmers. I emailed the company because I purchased this over disposable hand warmers thinking they would last a while, and I only used them for one trip that was a week long. I was two weeks past my 1 year warranty so I lost my money and nothing can be done. They suggested to charge every once in a while when they are not in use and offered to give me a coupon for my next purchase with them. I respectfully declined as I am sure that product would break as well. Would be great if they included that suggestion along with the product, so their clients would know to charge it every so often to make it last longer. Might just stick to disposables for next trip.

Let me tell you, I was pretty upset when I discovered these hooks had dug themselves into my floor and sratched it all up!  I had to grind these protrusions down and tape them to ensure they wouldn't scratch anything.  I tried the system after I assembled and do not feel confident that it will last more than a month.  Everything is cheap!  I am super upset that this thing is like this, and feel cheated.  Honestly, this is the worst piece of equipment I now own!!!

source_doc: Once Upon A Time. Once upon a time I used to stand on a metal box that I place on a chair just so I could reach the light bulb socket.  This light bulb socket is located in the hallway leading upstairs.  So I had to place a chair on steps that was dangerous.  Now that I am older (60 years), weigh more and not comfortable with relying on my stability, I searched for something that I could use to reach the light bulb socket safely.  I am so happy that I found this product.  I did not buy the pole but used a old sponge mop pole which worked just as well.A lot of people said that they had problems with the spiral light bulbs, I did notice that as I was screwing counter clockwise, the standard light bulb gripper also was unscrewing.  I just tightened the screw on the light bulb gripper onto the mop pole and it worked.  I haven't tried any of the other grippers but am looking forward to seeing if it will work on the flood light bulb outside.

source_doc: Do not waste your money. I had high hopes for these pads & was impressed by looking at them when they arrived. They are a great size & cover a lot of area. They are nice & thick & seem to be of a much better quality over thin pads I’ve gotten previously. Unfortunately that’s where the good part ends. They work horribly. I have a senior dog who is incontinent so I use these where she lays. She wears diapers but has leaks. I was hoping to have an added layer of protection by using these pads. I tested them by pouring a small glass of water on them & waiting a few minutes. The floor under the pad was wet. Not damp, but wet. I felt the top where the pad would have contact with the person or pet’s skin & it was also sopping wet. I double checked to make sure I had the correct side up and it was laid down properly. These pads are no different than laying down a towel. Very disappointing. I’m wondering if all these great reviews were done prior to actually using them. If I had rated on initial looks alone without testing; I would have given this an excellent review. Because of their thickness if you have to double them up for them to work, it is going to be uncomfortable to lay on. I wanted to love these but they were a complete disappointment.

source_doc: I wish I had known about Keychron before I bought my Ducky One 3 Daybreak. I bought my Ducky one 3 daybreak back in January of 2022 when I started to get really interested in keyboards. I wanted something with hot swappable switches and a variety of keycap options. After using that for about year the keys started to double type. I did everything from updating the firmware on the KB to replacing every individual switch after cleaning it out with compressed air. Unfortunately I concluded that it was a PCB (printed circuit board) issue, and none of it ever worked and so it's been sitting on my shelf since October.The Keychron Q6 is a breath of fresh air. I was hesitant to spend over $150 for a KB again after my previous experience but wow am I glad I did. Almost immediately you can feel the quality in this absolute unit of a KB. It is heavy, I cannot emphasis enough with how heavy this KB is. The sound is rich and comforting using their lubed reds. I thought I'd miss an illuminating RGB experience but I've gotten to the point to where this subtle south-facing RGB is perfect for my needs. The customization is endless using the VIA software that it recommends.I will absolutely 100% recommend this if you want something built on a proper platform with room to grow in whatever direction you so desire.

Fingers crossed with the next one I’m waiting to be delivered.

Unfortunately, I can't find my brand for sale on Amazon anymore so I decided to use all the lip balms I had laying around before I purchased anything new. What a mistake! It works great on my wigs, and I'm certain that it would work wonderful on natural hair, as well, and I would definitely recommend it!

This is pretty flimsy and really is meant more for like a 20-40 pound toddler not for an adult or anyone over 90 lbs. That's pretty risky, imo.

source_doc: Used for cabinets, WATER DOWN YOUR PAINT. I have never sprayed paint before and I bought this for a laundry room project to paint unfinished Home Depot cabinets.At first I hated this thing, it only has 1 PSI setting and it blows HARD. First pass with sanding sealer was a nightmare and resulted in large bubbles and all of my (quickly applied) masking tape and plastic getting blown off.Then I switched to paint and I kept getting speckles and not enough paint. I was about to give up and just roll the cabinets with paint, but after a huge mess and lot of trial an error I found that watering my paint down MUCH more than recommended worked great. You'll still see speckles or even globs of paint, but they dry fine and are not noticeable at all.I was using .5cup of water with the paint inside of the container (Sherwin Williams cabinet paint) of the gun and what I found to work perfectly was about 60% paint, 40% distilled water in the container. I had much better results and after 3 coats with sanding in between they looked awesome.I finished the cabinets with 2 coats of Minwax Polycrylic and they came out great. There are some remaining drips from my first coat of sanding sealer that I missed when sanding so I would just be careful to not apply too much and test a lot on cardboard.

source_doc: Best price to features for this type of product. I looked at others similar to this, Hart, Dewalt, Milwaukee, Bauer, etc.  I liked the Hart and this one because I have batteries for both of these.  The Hart was near 2x the cost, so I took a chance on the Meliff.  Two days after I ordered this, I found a Hart tool marked down due to a damage box - funny but it was actually cheaper.  I got this one in first, it worked well.  Quick to inflate, I liked the auto shut off feature.  Then I got the Hart in.  I tried the Hart out and it works well but has no cut off feature.  You have to hold the trigger the entire time.  Both are equal in speed and battery life.  Both weigh about the same and seem equal in construction.  The Hart is a little prettier in cosmetics.  End of the day, I prefer the Mellif and will be ordering another (they've jacked the price up 12% in past two weeks).

source_doc: I LOVEEEEE IT - but not for work. I eyeballed this keyboard for the LONGEST time before deciding to buy it.  I wanted something pink.  I wanted something backlit.  I wanted something CLICKY.  And this keyboard gave me all of that.  I don't like rechargeable keyboards because I never remember to charge them.  So this being wired made me happy.  I use it all the time for gaming and personal work.  However, when I am working I switch back over to my Apple keyboard.  Only because the clicks of the keys are loud and I don't feel like it is professional.  I prefer a muted keyboard when I am on the phone with clients and I'm typing away.  That's just a personal preference for myself.  I'm sure not everyone is bothered by it, it's just who I am.  So I can easily flip between my personal keyboard and my work keyboard.  That made this thing even better!

source_doc: Bummed. While initially I loved it, there were some things I didn’t like.The cord linked up often.The temperature when changing it sometimes would glitch back and forth and I would never know truly what temperature it was on.I purchased this June 25, 2021. This morning, January 12, 2023, this straightener officially died on me. I was straightening my hair before work when I noticed it was no longer very hot. I checked it and the light was off. I unplugged and tried turning it on and nothing. I moved to a different outlet, unplugged and tried again but nothing.I left it plugged in and set it on the counter and the light turned on. I picked it up and the movement caused it to shut back off again. I threw it away.$70 and I couldn’t even get a full year and a half out of it.

source_doc: Surprising results. I finally got a chance to try these dual lavalier microphones. I will admit that I was a bit skeptical but after I used them as advertised, I am happy to report that they work rather well. First, they are well-built. I did not notice any defects and even the pop-up foam blockers fit well. They are a bit bigger than expected, but nothing too excessive or distracting. They clip nicely on any piece of clothing and do not easily fall off. I appreciate the nice graphite-looking case, which houses both mics and accessories.I tested the microphones and recorded some content, and the audio came out surprisingly full and clear. There was a little bit of bass and very few pop-ups. I still would use my microphone while sitting in front of a screen, but if I need to move around, these mics will work nicely. The best opportunity to test them was during an online family meeting. I put the mic on myself and my wife. I then hooked up the laptop to the TV. The microphones came in loud and clear. We were about 10 feet away from the TV (it is 75”) and experienced no issues whatsoever.In the end, I found the BerrysParadise mics to be a very good value and I feel very comfortable recommending them.

source_doc: Quality seemed fine, but a major, unique screw was missing . . . . . . as it was "two-ended" with a smoothe surface in between that was required to hold the basket between two of the poles. Because China was the likely place I would've had to wait to receive it from, a return was suggested. I bought a larger one from a different company and all the hardware was there. I will say about the one I returned that you have to place four of the poles inside the cubby-hole portion, and it was impossible to see and get the screws lined up to screw into the poles inside, especially at the back area, as I kept thinking I'd gotten it, only to discover that I had not. I became frustrated after trying too many times in two different intervals, but I finally succeeded, only to realize that my efforts were futile due to that unique screw missing. The one I returned it for had the same requirement, but I had no problems with it, either due to a better design or due to the cubby-hole being differently shaped. Anyway, I suggest you read more reviews besides mine before deciding whether YOU want to give it a go.

source_doc: Only oil I use. I am glad that I have been able to buy this oil from this same vendor for years. You just can't find it in stores and if you do it is almost twice as much per quart or higher in some places if you can even find it. This is the only oil I will use in my zero turn Skag. I have been using this oil in my mowers for 30 years. I always change oil, OEM Kawasaki oil filter and air filter before start of every mowing season. Have always been able to get many hours of mowing out of my mowers without a problem. Might have to add very little at the end of mowing season. As far as I am concerned this is the best oil to use in warm and hot climates being how I live in Texas and it gets very hot in the summer. I might add that this is a residential property and I mow 2 acres once a week and I mow an additional 5 acres three times a summer. If you mow commercially you will have to change oil and filter more often.

source_doc: So much more than I expected. Ok, so I open my package and my heart sinks. I see this tiny little thing about 1/3 the size I imagined. So charging took about 2 hours and I was on pins and needles waiting for it. So fully charged connect it up and BOOM! Wow! So much more sound quality than I expected. The distortion and clean are exactly what I would expect. The bluetooth let me jam along with a backing track AND since BT and INPUT both have separate volumes you can mix it in perfectly. The delay AND delay time is precious and then you still have gain and a 3 band EQ! I can’t wait to run this into my Valve JR head and out my 2 12” cabs. Oh oh I wonder how harmonica sounds through it? Damn, gotta wait till tomorrow to “GET LOUD” I can’t turn this up more than 1/4 if I want to be able to turn my guitar up. So much louder than I expected… I might just have to call this thing a great affordable Christmas present for all my music jamming friends!
