source_doc: Don't fall for the same bait and switch I did. I had decided that I was going to purchase the carpet One, non-Pro version. When I pulled up the page, I was looking at prices and the carpet One pro had a $100 off coupon available. This made the price $499 which was the same price as the non-Pro version at the time, so it seemed like a no-brainer to me. A couple of days after receiving it, I went back on Amazon to see what current prices were and I was  let down. The non-Pro version is now selling for $349. They had obviously raised the price to get people to switch just like I did, probably because they needed to unload some. I contacted them about being upset about being duped, and their solution was to offer me a free bottle of cleaning solution. I felt that was rather insulting. The carpet One pro is definitely not worth the extra money spent. The Wi-Fi function is pointless. While the LED screen is fancy, it doesn't do much more than what the non-Pro version does. I do feel like the sensor showing how dirty the area is, or the sensor showing how damp the area is, are both gimmicks. I have not noticed any consistency with either of those functions. I do feel like it is a good carpet cleaner, but definitely not for more than $349.

source_doc: Cute but slows gameplay. These are so cute but unfortunately they do affect how I interact with the Joycon buttons. This might not be the case for everyone (hence the good reviews), But I found after nearly a week of using these buttons, they did noticeably impact my gameplay. The buttons themselves do not feel bad, they are smooth enough that they are not uncomfortable on your fingers, but because they are hard plastic, they change how quickly you can press down on the Joycon buttons. I did not realize they were hard plastic until after they arrived, I ordered them thinking they were silicone button covers. I put them on anyway because they were really cute but after several days, I noticed that when I would press the buttons on the right joycon, the reactions with my switch were slower. Even worse, when I pressed down on one of the arrow buttons on the left Joycon, the hard plastic button cover would push down on multiple buttons at once. So if I used the down arrow on the left joycon, my switch thought I hit the right arrow instead. It actually changed how I played games on my switch.

source_doc: Love this... and so does my soon-to-be 19-year-old Kitty! I purchased this on December 17th, 2022....  Came on the 19th.  I plugged it in and placed it in my elderly kitty's soft basket on top of his blanket.  At first he was hesitant, but I plopped him in there.  He had been slowing down and cold, and I had moved his basket next to the heater in the kitchen and he was happy.  Well, he has not left his basket since.  He loves this heating pad.  I have set it to No. 4 bar.  I have never turned it off and it's still working.  I am surprised.  I figured it would have burnt out, but so far so good! (Fingers crossed!!!)  He is walking better and so happy!  He loves it.  I haven't washed it yet.  I just turned it over.  I can't get him out of it to wash it.  I feel bad.  I did vacuum it.  LOL!  Now, it doesn't look all plush like in the picture, mind you, but it is soft.  As long as he is still alive, I will replace it if it burns out.  I think it helps him feel better.... Heat is good for old joints for all of us :)

source_doc: Surprised. I've often worried about my Shady being warm enough, especially this winter where it's been so cold. He mainly sleeps with me but he still feels cool to me. So when I came across this product, I put it in my wanted list. I felt it was a little expensive. And I have bought blankets and beds and he ignors them all. So am I going to spend this much money for him not to use it?As the cold days keep coming and not letting up, the more I was concerned about him not being warm. The last thing I wanted was for him to get sick. So I purchased the mat. I no more unboxed it and tossed it to the area on the bed he likes to sleep when not on me. He jumped on the bed and walked over sniffed it and laid down! I was shocked, I didn't have to put catnip on it to get him on it! My advice is order your normal Levi size, and you should be good to go.  Just so you know I weigh 220 and I’m 6-1 who wears size 36 in pants.  Hope this helps someone out there.

source_doc: Meh. I was really excited to get this car charger adapter for my spectra. Well, my excitement was short lived once I started using it. Once I plugged it in and turner my pump on, I could clearly hear the motor of the pump struggling. This adapter doesn't provide enough power to give my pump what it needs to function properly. As a result I need to pump longer, on higher settings/vaccum and my output is less than half of what I usually can get. I use this once I day while at work on my lunch break and as soon as I get home I have to pump again because I still have milk left that needs to be extracted. Is this adapter great for relieving pressure- yes. Would I recommend it for a reliable addition to your pump for every day use- that would be a no. Other than that, it's a sturdy item that came shortly after it was ordered and packaging was nice and cute.

source_doc: Brilliant self tightening design. I bought these chains to "keep in the truck" so I would be legal. Didn't think I would need them with 4x4 and snow tires. Sure enough, ended up in a blizzard leaving Yosemite national park while towing a trailer. Roads got really bad, really quick.  I pulled these out and was pleased with how easily they went on. Basically there's a notch for where your tire meets the ground, so you just slip it around. No pulling forward or backwards.  The chains weren't perfectly centered when I put them on, so I just drove 100 yards down the road and rechecked them. Sure enough, they have self centered and the tightening mechanism had taken up the slack on its own.  They stayed nice and tight and didn't slap around as we drove. Removal was ALMOST as easy as installing.  I was genuinely impressed.  I will be more likely to slap these on early when conditions deteriorate now that I know how easy they are. I will be buying a set for any car I own in the future.

source_doc: Great keyboard, but not for beginners. TL;DR: I REALLY like this keyboard, especially once you add different switches and keycaps, but it didn't work out because my accuracy sucks. Definitely not for beginners.Long review: I got the optical reds with this keyboard and it's definitely not for me since I'm a heavy typist. It's just too sensitive so I got the orange and bananas (yellow) optical switches to try them out. I do like the oranges but the ping on some of the switches is too dang loud and annoying so I settled with the bananas (yellow).Once I got them to my liking, it's time to test drive the keyboard. I'm not a typist per day but I can type. Not 100% accurate though, and that's where my problems arose. When I do make a mistake, I will almost 50% of the time would hit the "page up" instead of the backspace.. I do use "del" a lot as well and would hit the light switch instead.. If you're competent and have 99% accuracy when you type, it may work for you. Otherwise, get the K1 DE (what I did instead).

source_doc: Tire marks..avoid this sealer! I purchased with high hopes based on excellent reviews...sadly I've had nothing but issues since I sprayed it on my paver driveway. I applied the product as per the instructional video and after waiting 48 hours, I parked on the driveway. Over the past several weeks I've accumulated over 20 tire marks on my once clean driveway. I tried to scrub off with soap and water, but it made little difference. I contacted the manufacturer and they told me that the tire marks must have been on the driveway before sealing (definitely not the case) and after submitting several photos they sent me a .pdf explaining how black tire marks will happen with this time of "film forming sealer." Their recommendation was to soap/scrub and then pressure wash the marks off. I sealed my driveway so I wouldn't have to scrub it and pressure wash it frequently...but this low rate sealer all but guarantees I will have to repeatedly power wash on a regular basis to get rid of the tire marks that keep appearing. If I had a time machine I would go back and warn myself not to put this sealer on my driveway no matter how good the reviews were. Avoid this product for your driveway unless you enjoy frequent cleaning and the depressing feeling that you just paid nearly $300 for a product that will make your driveway more of a headache to keep clean. Zero stars if I could!

source_doc: I use this for my dog's toys. My dog, Hank, is overly spoiled and has a ridiculous amount of toys. The bin I used to have for the toys is no longer big enough, so I needed something bigger. This basket is quite large, and is the perfect size for his toys. It's pretty deep, so I don't think it would be great for a small dog. Hank is really tall (I'm 5'7" and he is almost as tall as me when he is on his hind legs), so it's easy for him to reach into the deep basket and get his toys. The material seems sturdy, so I think it will last a while. But, even using a hair dryer like they suggest, it's not really keeping its shape. Since I ordered this for my dog's toys, that's not a deal breaker for me. For what I wanted to use it for, it's perfect. It's also more of a dark grayish/black, but again, that doesn't bother me for what I wanted it for. It may be important for someone who is using it more as a nice, decorative way to store blankets, etc. though. I also may have done something wrong when I tried to form it. Despite those tiny quirks I love the basket and am really happy I ordered it.

source_doc: Exactly what I needed. These are great! I started woodworking and whittling as a hobby and the gloves are the best. I recently burnt my thumb while cooking and was still worried I'd stab my thumb while working. Sure if I intentionally tried to make the knife go into the glove it will happen, it's cut resistant not stab resistant. I have accidentally stabbed a few fingers but there was enough padding for it to cushion it so I didn't bleed or get seriously hurt. I mainly use whittling knives, though.The bumpy grip stuff is great. I have arthritis in my hands and sometimes things slip my grasp, but not with these.Make sure to order a size down because like the other reviewers say: they run big. I would fit a medium by the charts standards but I fit into a small. I have no problem with the finger length since I have "piano player length" fingers. Your hands will get sweaty if worn too long but isn't super horrible, I wear them for 3-5 hrs at a time.They don't wear down too fast. With what I do and judging by the one month I've had them, I could see them lasting 3-4 months before needing to replace them.I give all 5 stars cause it's exactly what I was looking for.

source_doc: Refreshing. Here I thought we have a really nice shower head until I came across this. How silly of me that I did not know a dual shower head/spray exists. It's not complicated to install, I actually thought I had to wait for the hubby to do it but I managed to do it myself. I love, love that it has 2 places where water comes out of so that I can shower more fully and quickly. Our current shower head has only 3 settings and with the highest pressure turned on, you don't get to cover lots of areas because the spray coverage is narrow. I love that I don't have to sacrifice the water pressure to get the most body parts washed. I also love that there are 9 different settings so even the pickiest person should be able to find the most suitable setting for their liking. Usually I'd have to take off the handheld to rinse properly but with the dual feature on this shower, I don't need to do any unnecessary work. I actually feel like I'm staying in some fancy hotel, it's really nice and refreshing.

source_doc: I absolutely LOVE it. I love this thing.  Got it on a lightening deal and so glad I took the plunge.  It took a while to put it together, but if you follow the directions exactly (something hard for my hubby to do), it goes together perfectly.  It was also very easy to hang. I love the little open shelf.  I put an extra hand towel and I will also add something decorative as soon as I find something that fits with my decor.  The only thing wrong was on my part.  I thought this was mission style doors, but they aren't.  My fault for not paying better attention.  I really don't care because I love it so much.  Oh, and I changed the knobs only because I wanted it to match the rest of the cabinets in the laundery room.  If not for that, I would have left the included knobs because they look really nice.  I would most definitely buy this again.

source_doc: Awesome!!! This pole is awesome I've never fly fished before because it seemed to be expensive and took some practice/skill to do butt this pole is super simple. I watched a bunch of videos then took a practice fly out in the yard setup a coffee can and started to practice before I new it i was able to pop that fly into the can with easy its all on the wrist. I like that the pole is all self contained i did get a line holder that attaches to the rod just above your hand so when collapsed you can just wind the line around it slip it in the tube and be on your way. I dont know that Ill every want to buy a fly rod I have several lengths and weights of tippet lines and most of the small streams and brooks I fish are tight quarters so your not able to cast a country mile anyway. I suppose on the bigger lakes you would want a fly rod too but the portability of this rod is awesome I would recommend trying one out especial if you already have the fly gear its quick to setup and be on the edge of in the water with 13 ft and a 12-16 ft  tippet you can get a decent amount of distance and accuracy. I think its a great setup for beginners or pro's its just another style of fishing.

source_doc: So far, so good. I hesitated quite a while before I bought this.  I don't have spam that often, but when I do I could never get the slices evenly cut.  Shouldn't be that big of a deal, but the thinner sides would always get overcooked while I finished the thicker sides.  This little gem has solved that problem.  Plus, all the picture I had seen had sliced the spam across the long side, giving smaller cut pieces.  I prefer slicing it the other way to get a piece that fits in a sandwich better.  I wasn't sure if I could do that with this slicer, but I can.  It's a tight fit, but it can be done.

source_doc: Secure and comfortable. I like these better than my name-brand ones I use for my cable machine at home and the ones available at the box gym I used to go to. The reason I like them better is because they are way more secure. The ones I have are all velcro and if you are hooked onto a heavy cable then the velcro has come off before. These ones do not entirely depend on the velcro because they are made with the two metal rings that close and then you clip to the machine with those. Much better and safer. They are padded so they are comfortable. The only thing I don't like is that I can't get the circumference small enough to tightly wrap my ankle so they are loose (I have small ankles). However, that's not too big a deal I still prefer these over the other ones. Additionally, they did come with a chemical smell which I do not like but I will leave them out in the open to air out. If it doesn't dissipate I will report back, but I anticipate that the smell will dissipate.

Good quality and the price is good..

source_doc: Simple versus Stanley. Simple modern every day hands-down! I bought this one because it had my football team logo on it even though I received a Stanley for Christmas. I have since bought two more simple modern tumblers.My simple modern is light weight and holds ice until the next day. It is perfect for my iced coffee. Of course no tumbler is spill proof when there is a straw involved however, it does not leak when it spills over unless it comes out of the straw when it’s been completely flipped. I found that out when I hit the brakes and my lunch bag went flying from the car seat to the floorboard upside down. With a Stanley, it does not seem to keep ice as long and I do get the water down effect and it is heavier. also when it tips it doesn’t leak not only from the straw but the straw hole in the sides of the lid. I do have the new Stanley H2O.Another great thing about the Simple Modern is the price.  It’s affordable and I definitely use it. There is a $10 price difference between this and the Stanley.I absolutely love this and and I am definitely more hydrated and I noticed that my skin does not look as dry. I would recommend this cup.

source_doc: Well made pullover for someone with an athletic build. I ordered this pullover because I was intrigued by Tom Brady's name attached to the item. I didn't know he was endorsing a line of athletic wear. I figured if Brady was willing to add his name to the product, it must be high quality. The pullover is indeed well made with quality materials. It is extremely lightweight, and great for moderate temperatures around 50 degrees. I am in my mid-50s, 5'9" and about 170. I run outside about 4 times a week and do strength training 2 times a week. I am certainly not an elite athlete, and I find myself walking up steep hills these days when out on a run. Usually a large is about the right size or just a little big on me. The large Brady pullover I ordered was definitely meant for someone with Brady's athletic build rather than my middle-aged build. There isn't any give when getting the item pulled over my head, so it isn't the easiest pullover to put on. However, while the fit is snug, once on it worked great for a warmer than usual January run. It kept the wind away and was surprisingly flexible for as difficult as it was to pull on. I would order again, but I would order a larger size.

source_doc: Ordered 2 new monitors. One was already opened. When I opened the first shipping box, I saw that the product box inside was not sealed. The tape appeared to have been cut or torn. I thought maybe i had cut it when opening the outer box, or maybe the tape had split. It wasn't until I started opening the second monitor's box that I realized the first one was used. The second one had a padded bag around the speaker. The first did not. The second one had the volume knob turned all the way down. The first one had it turned all the way up.I would have rated these 5 stars, easily. They sound great. But sending used products to people paying new prices is unacceptable. I don't know how much it has been used. I don't know if it was abused. I don't know if someone else registered the serial number, which could cause me issues if I have a warranty issue down the line. I would not have ordered these if I knew I would be getting a used one. So I'm knocking it down to 3 stars.

source_doc: Probiotic toothpaste. I am a huge fan of using probiotics for all types of products, so I was happy to try this product. It has a more delicate flavor than the toothpastes I’m accustomed to using, from America. There’s a subtle mint and sweet flavor, I found it refreshing. I don’t expect it to whiten my teeth… I use whitening strips for that, and even with those, it requires regular use for my teeth to get whiter. I like using whitening toothpastes though, sort of as daily maintenance. But I’ve never tried a whitening toothpaste on its own that actually made my teeth whiter.One thing I did notice is that I have a sensitive spot on my teeth that I started feeling after using this for a few days. I normally use Sensodyne because of tooth sensitivity. And the sensodyne definitely keeps that at bay. So I probably wouldn’t repurchase this for that reason, and also because it’s pretty expensive (currently $49 for a 3.52oz tube). But I did enjoy the other aspects of this toothpaste.

source_doc: A great stool to have around. Just the right size. I first bought one of these when I was one of those 'demo dollys' one finds in a store touting something new. I was supposed to stand at my table for like four hours but just couldn't  This stool was just the right height so I could take a load off my feet yet still be upright enough to be attentive to the shoppers I was demonstrating too.Now I have one in my kitchen. I am getting older and would rather not stand for any length of time if I don't have to. It is great for waiting for the microwave to finish when I'm fixing a meal. And when I don't need it any more it folds so easily - just release the catch and jurk upwards on the seat and it folds right up small enough to slip into that space between the fridge and the wall. I don't remember what the weight limit is supposed to be, but I weigh 265 lbs and it has no problem supporting me.

source_doc: Can I give this 3.5 stars? I wish I could. I really wanted my cat to like these. They came well packaged, in individual pouches. The ingredients list is impressive. My cat is getting on in years and the bone/joint support sounded promising. My cat is finicky about her food - she loves her greens, her Fancy Feast Medleys and her Temptations treats. But she also LOVES her Churus, especially the Chicken and cheese flavor. I thought this would be a great substitute for Churus and so I tried to entice my cat 2 ways: I placed a pouch of this (like I would her Churus) in a bowl and placed it where I put her treats. She tried it… and quickly dismissed it. I thought maybe I should have mixed it? But I tried again and was still unable to grab her attention. I then tried this as what the brand indicates- as a topper for her food…and my baby didn’t even touch her plate… and it was her FAVORITE canned wet food flavor. So although I wanted to like this, kitty didn’t like it and so I’m stuck with several pouches of a topper my cat will not eat… Serving size is 1 pouch for up to 8lbs cat weight. Price at the time of this review is 47 USD, which is inline with the quality of the ingredients but for my cat not in line on flavor.

source_doc: My feet don't hurt this morning. I expected these inserts to have an effect while I was wearing them - and they did. I was surprised about the impact the next day. My first steps after getting up were pain free, and I can't remember the last time that happened. I'm definitely sold on these insoles. Though the packaging says it can take two to three days to get used to them, my right foot was completely comfortable immediately. The left not so much. I won't call it UNcomfortable, but definitely more noticeable. That's a "me" issue, though.My feet were slightly more sweaty when I took off my shoes after about four hours, but not annoyingly so. Of maybe I just didn't notice because I live with a teen athlete and anything other than cleat feet doesn't register.I found the template a little annoying. Not enough to knock off a full star, but maybe an eighth of a star. Neither of the shoes I use these in has removable linings. I tried the template on the outside of the shoe, as it suggests, and, to no surprise, it said I needed the full-length insert, which didn't fit in my shoe. I got it right after three rounds of trial and error, but perhaps marking with template with shoes sizes (men's on one, women's on the other) would eliminate a few steps.

source_doc: Good keyboard for the money. This keyboard feels really good for the price point. I like the somewhat stiff action and the quiet clicking sounds. I enjoy using this keyboard and I use it all day. I have not tried it for gaming yet but for the everyday tasks that I do while working. My son tried it out with some games and he said it was pretty good. The RGB lights are fun, but they do not add a lot for me personally. I may just be too old to enjoy that stuff. ;)  I have two things that I wish were different. First, the indicator lights that show Caps Lock, Num Lock, and Scroll Lock are not very bright. They are white labels with white lights, and I can barely tell if they are on or not due to the reflection of my overhead lights. With all the RGB on the keyboard, I wish these indicator lights were bolder. Also, I was excited about having a keyboard for my PC that had mute and audio controls on it. Unfortunately, I have not found any way to invert the function keys so that I can use the audio controls without also holding down the FN key. The FN Lock just locks the whole keyboard which isn’t all that helpful on a desktop compared to its usefulness on a laptop, if those two items were fixed, I would give this keyboard a five-star rating.

source_doc: Unbeatable great value cable. I got this as a temporary cable while I wait for an actual high quality one to come in. For those, you must either pay big or you wait a month to get it. Enter this cable:Less than 15 bucks, arrives the next day (for me,) and works great. The price and availability are unbeatable. How does the cable perform? I haven't been able to to detect any noise on the video or the audio. If there's audio hum, I geneuinly haven't noticed it. These are cheap so I'm sure they're hit or miss and I doubt the wires are individually shielded. But the one I received murders the composite cable I was using. I would even say it surpasses perfect s-video quality. It's sharp colorful rgb video.The cable feels and looks cheap, but it IS cheap. And you're definitely rolling the dice on the build quality here, but I can at least vouch that you'll potentially receive a solid cable that looks a million times better than composite.I might come back later and compare it to a high quality scart cable to note the differences, but I would say go ahead and give this one a try if you want to save some time and money. Bottom line: the cable I got looks great.

source_doc: Didn’t Work. I bought one of these quite a while ago and never installed it. I finally got around to installing it. The concept is great, mine just didn’t work. I tried it on two different Leviton switches thinking that perhaps the contacts just didn’t quite line up on the first switch I tried to install it on. I made sure the switch (on the SnapPower faceplate) was in, power was in to the switch, and I covered the sensor/switch to test it. Nothing. I removed the SnapPower faceplate, inspected it, and tried again. Same result. I tried another switch, and same result. I had an extra Leviton switch, so I checked to see whether the SnapPower contacts line up with the screws. They do, not perfectly, but certainly enough to make adequate electrical contact that they should work. So either my SnapPower face plate is defective, or it doesn’t work if the hot and return wires are connected to the switch using the push-in connectors rather than the connector screws? It has been too long for me to return this one, so I’m stuck with an overly expensive spare faceplate. I’m pretty handy and technically savvy, and these are ultra simple, so it’s definitely an issue with the one I bought.

source_doc: Works perfectly for what I need. I just moved my toddlers into their own bedroom. While I do have a Ring Camera in there which sends motion alerts, I was needing something that would alert me of sound in real time. This monitor does just that.Set up was super easy. I like that the volume can be adjusted so I can lower it down while they’re settling to go to bed and turn it up when I myself am ready for sleep.I do not use the cordless feature as the parent monitor is plugged in to sit on my nightstand and the one in my kid’s room is also plugged in so I can’t comment on the battery life.The night light on the kid monitor is a really nice touch and I like that whenever there’s higher sound the parent monitor lights up orange to alert.When we have our next baby I will definitely be purchasing another one of these. They are really simple but work perfectly for what I need. I wish I bought them when my little ones were in the baby phase to help when we put them in another room for naps.

source_doc: Works well on my very fine, thin, and fragile hair. Not a mist... I love TRESemmé products, and this TRESemmé One Step 5-in-1 Volumizing Hair Styling Mist it's no different, other than one thing. It is definitely not a mist, and cannot be sprayed directly on the hair evenly. I spray it into one hand, rub my hands together, and then apply it to my hair, starting at the root area. I don't have a lot of hair, so it works well for my fine, thin, fragile, and rather curly hair.Whenever I go out, I wear wigs, but I still want my natural hair to look halfway decent at home. Not only does it work well on my natural hair it also helps to keep my wigs in place. For what little natural hair I have, it doesn't take much to do the job. If I blow dry it, it gives it quite a bit of volume, but most of the time I let it air dry. It starts out a little crunchy, but once I finger comb it out, it has more volume and looks much thicker.I wish the product sprayed out in a mist as its name suggests, but I still like it for my natural hair, and for my wigs, as well. For those reasons, I would definitely recommend it!

Когда я выхожу на улицу, я ношу парики, но мне все равно хочется, чтобы мои собственные волосы выглядели дома вполне прилично. Средство не только отлично работает на моих натуральных волосах, но и помогает фиксировать парики. Для того небольшого количества натуральных волос, что у меня есть, средства требуется совсем чуть-чуть. Если я сушу их феном, это дает отличный объем, но чаще всего я оставляю их сохнуть естественным путем. Сначала они становятся немного жесткими, но стоит мне прочесать их пальцами, как они приобретают объем и выглядят гораздо гуще. Мне бы хотелось, чтобы средство распылялось легкой дымкой, как заявлено в названии, но оно мне все равно нравится — и для моих натуральных волос, и для париков. По этим причинам я определенно рекомендовал/а бы его!

source_doc: Decent size for all the info. I found that the personal touch from the CEO with this letter and description of the company was beyond what I expected. I just got this and put it on my cat, I know it says SiliDog, but I loved that I was able to get the amount of information on this ID tag that I was able to. Its amazing so far. I was able to put information on both sides, which I wasnt able to with her previous one. Also its rubber and so easy to put on her collar that unlike a metal one it wont tarnish, like her previous one did because of her water bowl. So even though I just got it and Oreo seems to approve, because its not bothering her yet, I would say that I would recommend it.Oreo approved!!! Lol.Side note: I think whoever had it as an example that said "Only indoor cat. If I'm out I'm lost" is genius because I put it on hers!!!! Love that about it.

source_doc: A pleasant surprise! I have to admit to being skeptical about this head wrap. I fully expected it to feel too tight or too heavy, but I was pleasantly surprised by how comfortable it is to wear.While it does feel heavy when you hold it, I didn’t find it too heavy when it was on my head. And though it’s tight, it wasn't too tight. It stays in place well, so if you choose to be up and about while wearing it, it shouldn’t slip down. It’s possible to pull it down over your eyes or leave it above your eyes, whatever best suits you. Personally, when I have a headache, I want the cooling relief over my eyes.Since it’s winter here and was below zero when my package was delivered, even though I took it from the drivers hand, the head wrap arrived cold. I’ve realized it always feels sort of cool to the touch, but I keep in the freezer as I like it colder. I haven’t tested it in the microwave since I don’t intend on using it that way.

source_doc: I LOVE This Little Light Of Mine. All kidding aside, I really love this little tactical flashlight.  The light is extremely bright and and versatile.  LED really does make a difference and it seems like the battery life is extremely long after a full charge.  The price is absolutely reasonable and I have been using this little flashlight for over 6 months and oddly, I find myself having to use it more than I thought I would.  I usually always buy those cheapy ones at the hardware store, they don't last very long and aren't anywhere close to as bright as this one is.  The fact that you can recharge is definitely a money saving bonus.  This would make a great gift for anyone as well.  I have since purchased 3 more so that I can keep them handy in different locations like the vehicle, that tool box, my desk and the tackle box.  I highly recommend this one and I hope you find this review helpful!

source_doc: This continues to be very popular!  Three dogs, and they love it. I was dubious about how this would hold up, or that it would keep my dog's interest, but after three months it is still a hit!  I mean, I know it's the FOOD that makes them interested, but they all will keep moving around, finding every last piece of dog food out of it.  It takes some time to load, but I've found that I can just sprinkle regular dog food (small bite sized) while I'm spreading apart the folds and it goes pretty quickly.  I expected that with two puppies and an adult dog that they'd start chewing up the polar-fleece type fabric, but they haven't done that at all.  It's big enough that it doesn't slide around, since they're typically standing on at least part of it, and I like that I can just fold it and then roll it up, with the built-in strap holding it together like a small sleeping bag.  When I want to use it, I just unroll, load the kibble in, and then I let the dogs in from outside and watch them just go at it!  They're busy, busy, busy, with their tails wagging the whole time.  I love it!

source_doc: Love this kit, would love to buy another, but don't try to take throught TSA checkpoint. I watched a youtube tutorial or two, got the panotuner app, and ordered this kit.  I was able to get my parents' piano sounding much better in just a few minutes.  Unfortunately, I tried to carry the kit through the TSA checkpoint, and it would not go (the tuner device is a tool more than 7 inches) so I had to ship it to my parents' house, and I left it there.  My piano is also slightly out of tune, but I am hoping they will restock and I can get another kit like the one I got my parents.  Otherwise, I will be shipping that tuning kit back to me in a few months.  Much cheaper than hiring a piano tuner, and just as effective.

source_doc: First Canister Vac - So Pleased. I have gone through three stick vacuums in the past 5 or 6 years. I have had Dyson, Bissel, and Shark. I have three pets - 2 dogs and a long hair cat. My entire house is ceramic tile. The stick vacuums would clog horribly with pet hair. I had to take them apart about every week to deep clean just to get a lackluster clean on the floors. This vacuum, whoa! I have vacuumed my entire house, furniture, door and window frames. The attachments are fantastic, and the vacuum is just stellar so far. One caveat for which I didn't deduct a star, if you have never used a cannister vac like myself just understand that it takes a minute to adjust how you vacuum. I felt like everything was awkward and too big the first two or three times I used it. Like I said, first canister vac. After that, I have had zero problems. And I really do love it.

source_doc: Works great, no problem pairing but your camera App might not allow external microphones. If your video App allows you to select an external microphone, this will work very well. Any problems I had with this were the result of my smartphone, and the included Camera App and, not the fault of the product. When I first plugged this in and powered up the microphone, the two immediately paired. However, try as I might, I could not get my phone to use the microphone. Yes, my Motorola G7 has OTG and has worked with other products like endoscopes, Wallabot and other products. However, when recording video, the phone always used my internal microphone.Today I found out that the problem lays with my Camera APP that came with the phone. So, I downloaded an App called "Open Camera" from the play Store and, there is a selection to use internal or external (if plugged in). Once I selected "external" this wireless microphone has worked flawlessly.  I walked to the edge of my property (about 110 ft) and it clearly picks up me whispering and, the sound quality is as good, or better than my internal microphone. The nice thing about this particular app is that there are no adds at all so far.It took a bit to figure out but, I am now totally pleased. I just wish I did not have to use a different App to video something.

source_doc: Undecided on these stirrups. I bought these for an overseas riding trip in Ireland. I will be riding cross country and jumping. The place where I ride will outfit you with the horse and saddle, etc. however, I've brought my own stirrups and leathers before and just swap them out. The climate is pretty wet. I specifically bought these because when I ride there, my boots are always slipping off the stirrups due to the wetness of the land we're riding through. I have mixed thoughts on these. I like the light weight nature of the stirrups. I normally ride in MDC sport stirrups and they are quite heavy. I like that my feet don't slip out of my stirrups when my boots are wet. I don't like that they're hard to get your feet back in if you lose a stirrup because they lie flat against the flank of the horse. I'm not sure if they're more comfortable. I have been trying them out during my normal riding and lessons. I will keep the stirrups and take them on the trip but I think I'll switch back to my MDCs for normal riding.

I burn a lot of firewood and the LR is right next to the garage so I wanted an alarm that would add some protection in those areas.I love the idea of getting an alarm wherever I may be but I certainly want a true signal.

source_doc: Native DualSense touchpad on PS4 with new firmware. I love my DualSense controller, it's amazing, and I don't own a PS5 primarily being a PC gamer.  Recently dusted off my old PS4 to discover that I was running firmware 8.5, and thus could jailbreak it on 9.00, breathing life back into the old device.  The DS4 controller is good, but it's no DualSense, so I set out looking for a way to usef the DualSense on PS4.  I had previously purchased a Magic-NS a couple years ago to use it with a Switch, so I looked into Mayflash devices again.Enter the Magic-S.  All around it was exactly what I was searching for.  I could pair the controller to the device and then move it between the various platforms I game on without having to repair it.  Only setback was touchpad wasn't fully functional.  However I contacted the developers, discovered there is a way to do gestures on it, but it was clunky.  Well new firmware came out a day or two ago and now there is native touchpad with DualSense on PS4!  Freaking amazing!Highly reccomened if you are looking to use your PS5 controller on a PS4 or other devices.  And superb communications when I bumped into pebkac issues.  Thanks!

source_doc: I was really hoping for more than it delivered. UPDATE...After a lot of trial and error I have found the Mustang Micro to be much better than my original review. I have used it for recording and the results were very good.I have had a Fender Mustang V for a few years now and I record with it often. When I saw this device I thought it might be another recording option. Technically I can record with it. However, in the very short time that I actually tried it plugged into my 1970's era reissue Strat it sounded very overdriven. In every mode I tried. Don't get me wrong, I do like some nice overdrive. But this is too much. To the point of having a crunchy sound. I tried my 2010 Teloecaster. Same thing. Then my Epiphone Dot. Same. I tried other amp models, effects, EQ, different volume settings. All of them super crunchy. Which knocks this down from a possible recording amp to only a practice device. And even then the tone is highly unsatisfying. So if you are curious and you have an extra $120 lying around then give it a try. Maybe it's just what you are looking for. But if you like good tones coming from your guitar then move along. This is not for you.

source_doc: Unplayable. I really wanted to like this game.  Visually its a very appealing game and the background music is good.  However the controls are way too sensitive and combat is clunky.  These are things I think I could have gotten used to over time.  However what I can't get used to is the horrendously long respawn times after you die.  It consistently takes over a minute for the game to load back up after you die.  I even timed it and the load time was 1m 05s 95 seconds.  This is completely unacceptable.This game was free with Playstation Plus, but I will be deleting it because I can't even enjoy it when most of the time is the stupid loading screen.  Months ago, this game was on sale but for some reason I decided not to get it. Knowing what I know now, I'm glad I didn't waste my money for an unplayable game.Thanks EA for reinforcing a decision I made nearly 15 years ago to never buy games at price, if at all.

source_doc: Needed it to sleep outside. I’m not one to rough it in the outdoors.  And I don’t function well without sleep.  So, when I decided I’d like to try testing in preparation for camping again.  I knew I’d need something like this, and I was right.I picked about the coldest night to test this out.  I first laid out my bag and crawled my over six foot self in without this mattress.  I could feel every lump under my nearly 200 pound body.  I know that if I raked up the earth under me it would’ve been better but that’s not something I was prepared to do.So, I then unscrewed the valve cap to the mattress and it inflated very quickly.  I set my bag on top and got in it again.  It was quite a difference.  But, after 10 minutes or so, the mattress had settled some.  So got out and opened the  valve again.  It sucked in more air.  That held for the rest of the night.  And I needed this comfort to feel relaxed enough to sleep.It was easy enough to deflate, just open the valve and roll it up.  The strap works great to store it.For anybody who is thinking about camping in the woods after having not done it, I think you’ll want this.

source_doc: Comfortable but not slippery, cute steering wheel cover. This is my first time having a steering wheel cover. I have a 1st Generation Toyota Sienna. I measured my steering wheel and it was close to 15", so I figured this would work. It was a bit of a struggle getting it on but not too bad, I didn't need any help or tools. I do wish I would have given more thought to where the seam on the cover would be, because I didn't and it ended up being on the right toward the bottom which isn't as bad as if it were closer to the top, but I think I would prefer if it were in the middle at the bottom as a clear point of reference. It's a pretty thick seam. I don't want to have to remove the cover and put it back on though, it was a tight fit. I chose this Bohemian design because I think it goes pretty well with my old and ugly brown interior. The cover does make the steering wheel quite thick, which, I guess, is easier to hold onto. The fabric has a tooth to keep my hands from slipping, but it still feels pleasant to the touch. I'm picky about how fabrics feel on my skin, and this feels pretty good.

source_doc: Was really hopeful but my hope burnt out. I bought these for my truck cargo lights as well as my door lights.  When I first put them in I was amazed at how bright they were.  It was amazing and I was excited.  Then about 2 weeks after having them in I noticed one of the cargo lights started blinking.  I thought it might be the wiring in the truck but then shortly after I noticed the other light started doing the same thing.  I had my little daughter push on the brake to see about the brake light and it seemed to still be okay.  So I took 2 of the bulbs out of the doors and put it back in the cargo lights.  It was about 2 days later that both of those started to struggle as well.  Then I noticed the one in the brake light started to flicker as well.  I was so hopeful for these bulbs and am quite saddened that they stopped working so quickly.  I would understand it if was 1 bulb then it could be a fluke but I now have 6 bulbs total that aren't working any longer or flickering really bad.  Thankfully they weren't too expensive so it didn't hurt too bad when I threw them away.

source_doc: Strong, lasting fragrance...& rash. Update:Although I washed this off soon after because I couldn't stand the smell, I broke out in a rash on my arm where I tested this.I love the convenience of a spray sunscreen, but I couldn't tolerate the fragrance added to this one. While I detect the coconut and maybe it's the shea, it's overwhelmingly a chemical, plastic, perfume smell that reminds me of something you would spray your car with or buy in the dollar store. I only sprayed it on my arm, and it's giving me a headache. I can't imagine how awful I would feel if I sprayed it all over, not to mention on others around me. The spray is very strong and generous and dries quickly. I do like how lightweight it is. I also like the twist lock cap. Each of the bottles was sealed, and they were in a resealable bag. The trio is $45.60.

source_doc: Comparable to other standard wipers but is definitely not premium. I was fortunate in the fact that I got to utilize the wipers in the rain and slush right away on a 10 hour drive across state (California 2/24/2023) and it happened to rain 9 out of those 10 hours too. The wipers I would say were very quiet and I did not hear any noise from them what so ever, however they do bend a bit at the top tip when moving across the windshield which makes me question its longevity in terms of quality. The wipers were also labeled as premium and they are definitely not. I did get steaks on one of the wipers as it moved back into the down position and it did it every time throughout my drive but while going back up, it cleared it. For the price, I would say its worth buying and should last through the season I hope. Would I buy them again?... I most likely would not. On a side note, I did buy three sets for all my cars and none of them came labeled with the sizing so I had to measure the lengths to determine which was for which vehicle.

source_doc: Helps for arthritis-type pain. Many reviewers say the capsules are big. I agree. I take with a cupful of water and thoroughly wet it before swallowing but it still sticks in my throat for a few minutes. I don’t know why.That said, this supplement is amazing. Another reviewer mentioned it helped with her arthritis. I don’t know if what I have is arthritis, but for nearly a year I have had pain in my left hand and have not been able to close my fingers completely into a fist. Not even halfway. I tried creams, ibuprofen, Tylenol, and even dmso, and nothing helped the pain or changed how my fingers closed. It got to the point I became used to the pain and basically accepted it as my new normal until I got around to seeing a doctor—not easy to do in the rural area I live in. So when I read the review that mentioned how it helped with the person’s arthritis, I looked at my hand. I had only been taking it for 2 or 3 days, but the pain was gone, and I could close my hand almost completely. I hadn’t even noticed! I take only one capsule a day now (half the daily dosage), and take it with liposomal vitamin c for better absorption, and my hand is doing great. I’m sure it must be helping me in other ways I don’t recognize. Great product!

source_doc: i think it is great and fits my needs really well. for this price i was surprised that this sounds as good as it does. here is my use case: i live in a townhome so i had the idea for my band to plug into a mixer (e-drums used) and everyone wears headphones. that way we can crank it up and not anger the neighbors. lots of headsets, wires, headphone amp... i put some time into planning it out. what i did not account for was the guitars sounding like hell - i am running a line out from the headphone out of the amps directly into the mixer. so i started researching cab simulators, IR loaders, etc. to try and replicate the sound of a mic'd amp. the sonicake does this really well - it sounds authentic. i wasn't expecting a lot for the price, but i was happily surprised. if you have similar needs to me, i would highly recommend that you use the XLR out on the sonicake. i noticed a large difference in sound quality between that and the 1/4 inch out.

source_doc: Very easy to use. I bought this for my front door because I noticed light and cold air leaking through where the door meets the frame.  I must admit that I am not very handy and a bit of a diy dunce.  I really thought this would be a good temporary fix until I could call a handyman.  Much to my surprise,  it actually works great and I didn't need any help at all with it.  The whole process is fairly simple,  but don't skip the preparation steps.  Simply measure out how much you need and cut it to size.  Clean off the area first.  I used rubbing alcohol because it dries so quickly.  This helps the adhesive stick to the surface without getting messed up by dirt or dust.  Peel off the backing and stick it in place with a fair amount of pressure.  I let it cure for 24 hours before I used the door again.  That might be excessive,  but I wanted to be extra cautious.  The D shape is really neat because it expands into the little gaps.  Nothing is getting through now.

source_doc: Game changer for keeping the kitties hydrated! I was a bit leery about purchasing this, but boy-oh-boy am I glad that I went for it! It is better than I even imagined. We have a bit tight living space and I needed something that could fit in a small space. I was tired of carrying a full water bowl over to the cat’s “dining area” to then have one of them nudge my hand and then spilling the entire bowl of water on the floor! Plus I could never seem to be able to tell when their water bowl was empty. This unit has been a blessing. It didn’t take them any time at all to use it—they weren’t intimidated by the new look at all. I also discovered that the lid will screw onto a soda bottle also, so if there is a time when we need to leave more water out for them, I feel confident that I could use a larger size bottle if we will be gone for an extended amount of time. It will also be useful if for some reason the original bottle cracks (which I’m hoping it won’t). I would love to find another stainless food bowl for this unit so that I can have a clean one on standby when I want to wash the included bowl in the dishwasher. The extra ones I have are either too large or too small. This was a great buy!!

source_doc: Defective Tool From The Start. The first time I used this wrench to torque some wheels, it locked up and displayed gibberish on the final wheel. I rebooted the wrench and it seemed to work. I used it again and it seemed to work so I just took a mental note. I recently used it and the display locked up again and rebooted itself in the middle of trying taking a measurement. I finally accepted that this torque wrench was defective. I called the manufacturer who referred me to a company in WV. They said to send it and they would fix or repair. At this point, I wanted to switch brands. I didn't feel like shipping on my dime so I contacted Amazon. They said they would do a one time refund since it had been 4 months. I was ecstatic. I printed the UPS label and shipped it. I was then notified of the refund amount which was $30 less than the purchase price. I researched and found that you only get 80% back if the return is over 1 month. My future large purchases will be from local stores and I won't buy another Gearwrench torque wrench.

source_doc: Might work for others, but not for me. I am an older lady.  I have a small, older car.  It will probably be the last car I own, too.  So I wanted to try to protect the seats.  The problem is, I didn't think about how I get into my car.  Because it is a small car and I am older, I open the driver's door, turn away from the driver's seat and then lower myself onto the seat.  THEN I both turn and pull my legs into the car.  Because of how I pivot by turning and pulling my legs in, these lay-on-top covers just get all twisted beneath me!  You really think I want to try to lean up in the seat and fiddle with this tangled/twisted seat cover beneath me???  SMH...for this price these should be way better than they are.

I tried to adjust it but nothing I did made it straighten up. It's not a dramatic tilt or dip, so I don't think anything would fall out of it, but just something I observed. I removed a star for those two small things (jute in the description is misleading and the bottom basket tilts forward). But those are tiny things I can certainly overlook and I like the baskets a lot - they are a nice looking solution for my lack of linen closet storage.

source_doc: I do love this water bottle. I found this water bottle at a great deal when I was looking to add a new one to my collection. I love the colors - and there were a ton to choose from. The motivational writing on the sides is cute and I know works for some people. I don't necessarily follow them strictly during the day, but they do help to keep you a bit on track for water consumption. The outside has a good grip, even if you have melting ice trying to form some condensation. The handle is also great for carrying it around. It fits into most cupholders in the car or even in a backpack side pocket. The lid has been great for keeping the water inside the bottle and not leaking. I love the ease of pressing the button and having the spout pop up. The only thing I'm not a huge fan of is it is a little difficult to clean the straw. I haven't tried to force it from the lid because I don't want to break it. But I don't think you can detach it from the lid. I'm just extra vigilant about regular rinsing and soaking in hot soapy water and hoping no mildew or mold ends up growing in there. Overall a great water bottle and probably one of my favorites from the many I have tried.

source_doc: So glad I found this!!! I have experienced shoulder and neck pain for over 20 years now. I blame it primarily on a lot of customer service work and years talking with customers on the phone prior to the advent of headsets (and I had to crook the phone between my neck and shoulder). I am always on the look out for a good heating pad and massager. I had been using a standard heating pad (rectangular) but I was super excited to try this. I love that it is custom made for shoulder pain. Once on, it hugs my back neck and shoulders and supplies wonderful heat. The heat is evenly distributed and has multiple settings to give me just what I need. I love that this heating pad covers the whole area that I need help with. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a great heating pad for your upper back, neck and shoulders!

source_doc: Good but misses keys. I have had this keyboard for a while. About 2-3 months after I got it, I started having issues with the buttons on the far right not working (the enter button, the 9, 6, 3 keys. I have to try to hit them multiple times for them to register. Sometimes my 2 key sticks and does the number twice when only hit it once. And the D key doesn’t always register. It started off mild at first and kept getting worse. It’s now at the point that I can’t deal with the issues anymore. I deal with a lot of numbers on a daily basis and this keeps slowing me down. I need to get a new keyboard. I want to try this one again, but am worried about the same issue happening again. I love the colors and the quickness of the buttons (as long as they work) I would give it 5 stars if I wasn’t having issues with the keys reacting. This keyboard was exactly what I was looking for with speed, sound, touch and responsiveness. Hopefully won’t have issues on next keyboard

source_doc: You get what you pay 4 I'm just getting back into playing the cello after many years, so when I committed to lessons at the beginning of the year I had to move quickly to find an instrument. I found what appeared to be a good beginner cello for a great price. The instrument arrived the next day and was packaged immaculately. However the good stoped there. On first inspection everything seemed normal as I set up the bridge. However, as I started to tune the cello I noticed the tuning pegs would very easily slip out of place. Then I noticed the fine tuners for the D string on the tail piece was bent. I disassemble the bridge and strings to correct it and it just popped backed into the wrong place again. When I took my cello to my first lesson my instructor immediately noticed several things off about the instrument. The nut and bridge were too high, making the strings sit up too far away from the finger board. These physical issues made it very difficult and next to impossible to play. Save your money and go to a licensed string instrument seller. It might me a little more pricey but at least you'll get a quality instrument. I know I did.

source_doc: Stays in place all night! I ordered this sleep cap to try to keep my long hair from frizzing since I toss and turn all night. When I woke up in the morning and took off the cap, my hair was still smooth from the night before, so I believe this product works as intended. The cap material itself is really soft and smooth, so I can see why this is gentler on hair than a pillow case. Bonus, if you don’t wash your hair every day, this cap will keep your hair products from rubbing on your face and causing a breakout. I am excited to see if putting this cap on will preserve my curls to where I don’t have to completely recurl my hair the next morning.

source_doc: This gadget is freaking amazing! As it would happen, if things can go wrong, they will.  The day before I received a positive COVID test that not only knocked me on my ass, but the very next day the master bath toilet backed up.  I plunged and plunged, and plunged, and plunged to no avail.  So, I turned to Amazon and found this gadget. I thought it would be a rinkydink, use a couple of times before tossing into the garbage but to my surprise I was wrong.  I’m rarely wrong :).  In my now full on COVID ravaged body I easily assembled, pumped it up (29 pumps to be exact) shoved the gadget into the tank.  I kinda felt like Rambo as I pulled the trigger!  Yes, there is actual trigger.  To my surprise, the recoil felt like a shot a baby shotgun!  What I didn’t know is that I should have tried to cover the bowl because along with the recoil, a bunch of toilet water splashed back on me and the floor.  After I got over that shocker, I flushed and Wallace.  Whatever was stuck was gone.  It probably got blown to smithereens!  Run, and don’t hesitate to make this purchase!

source_doc: This thing is Awesome!!!! This air fryer is absolutely wonderful. I have to admit, I didn't think the steam option would be of much use, I was wrong!!! I have found more uses for using steam to cook and reheat with than I originally thought. It makes stale biscuits and rolls like they were fresh from the oven, and for reheating cooked foods it is phenomenal. When I bought this I got it for 64 bucks and change, and it was worth every dime. I had considered getting an air fryer from the competition, but I didn't need an air fryer with 2 compartments. It was just to big and more air fryer than I needed.I am pleased with this to say the least. It gets to temp fast, little time for pre heating. It cooks like a dream, and once you get used to using the steam and air fry combo feature when cooking you are going to love it. I was skeptical at first, but now I am glad I took the plunge and bought it!!!

source_doc: at 73yrs old, I need to be picky! Just read other reviews and am surprised that some do not like this.  I try many brands of drugstore foundations but hardly ever Almays' which is ironic since I have sensitive, allergic skin!  By chance I tried this one (first I love that it comes in a tube rather than a bottle) (seems more hygenic), and then liked that it has the word "prebiotic" in the name.  I am somewhat on the light side, with cool undertones, pretty descent skin for my age with some wrinkles, no age spots, average pours.  Skin is normal but can tend to be dry if I don't work at it.  I bought the 130 beige because in the pictures it looked like a cooler tone than the 120 color and I am more than happy with this.  It looks natural and very healthy looking and I am picky.  I put it on with my fingers all over my face including my eyelids.  I just love how this looks even out in the bright sunlight.  I would be one to highly suggest mature women like me try this out if you are on the fence, looking for a natural foundation that is hypoallergenic with descent products in it.  I would totally rebuy this a second time.

source_doc: This is the leash I never knew I needed. I bought this to use with my dog's therapy dog vest - I need a 4' leash when working.  I also wanted the short loop so I could have the dog fully in control.This is very nice.  It's quite light, but strong.  Excellent quality clasp. My dog is on the small size (18"), and this is just perfect for when I am working him in places where I need really close control.  I usually use a 6' leash, held in my right hand, with the left controlling the shorter length.  However, the second handle just makes it much simpler - one less thing to juggle and more solid control.My dog's vest is red with black, so the black leash with the red flashes looks sharp.  I use it with the vest (like harness), with his standard collar, but also with a Gentle Leader when we are doing therapy work.  The light weight is important with a small dog with the Gentle Leader - I did not want to put weight on pressure on his delicate nose. I may change out the clasp for a slightly lighter one just to relieve some of the weight.Good product for a working dog - light but well made, well designed, and it seems durable.

source_doc: Pretty good lemon flavor, better when mixed with water. I've been trying to live a bit healthier lifestyle and have been trying drops like this as I see them so when I saw this I thought ok ill give it a shot.  The package came just fine without any leaks or cracks in the bottle.  Opening the bottle it doesn't really smell like anything and I was a bit worried but I shouldn't have been.  I took the dropper and put a couple of drips on my tongue and it was a sweet lemon flavor, kinda reminds me of lemon drops but didn't linger.  I tried this mixed with water also and with 2 drops per 8 oz I couldn't even notice the flavor at all so keep that in mind if you aren't 100% sold on the flavor.  As I have just started trying it I have not seen any results but I have not seen any negatives and that works for me.  All in all, if you like sweet lemon and want to try it in liquid form this is pretty good.

I am very disappointed in my purchase and the fact that I spent $30.00 on this. My window to return has now closed and that's my own fault, but I buy a lot on Amazon and can say this has been one of worst purchases.

source_doc: A very nice inexpensive Irish whistle! I have some experience with Native American flute but am new to the pennywhistle. The first thing I looked at was craftsmanship; this whistle was flawless from what I could see; solid paint job on the brass tube, no little scratches, etc; holes were drilled cleanly; mouthpiece well-formed.  The first time I played it there was a lot of screeching; I was trying to overlay how I play NA flute onto this new little whistle. The second time I played it I tried to let go of my NA flute experience (except the basics like making sure all the holes are well-covered) and let nature find it's own way re breathing, ... ; here came the solid and clear notes! Since I do have a few other Irish whistles to compare to, I can say that this Feadog Pro D definitely has it's own voice, and it's a very pleasant one. I'm glad I added it to my instruments; it's fun to play.

source_doc: Finally I can see the road. After driving around at night with old foggy zero visibility headlamps for the last ten years, I came across these. Wasn't really interested in high-tech LED lights as they are not in character with my truck. I found the only hard part about installing these was the lower screw positioning which is right behind the bumper, a real pain to get to...  So I improvised I drilled a one-inch hole into the bumper as you can see in the picture, a service hatch, to get to the screw which I will stick a plug into later.  Maybe I got lucky they seem to be in the exact spot, light-wise, so I have not needed to adjust them.  The only issue with them is because they are not two-part lenses like the stock type if you have to remove the indicator bulb you will have to basically remove the headlamp screws and pull the headlamp forward, which I discovered when I noticed the indicator bulb was out. It is also a bit of a tight squeeze to get the headlamps in. Overall for the money, you cannot beat them. And I would buy it again if needed.

source_doc: Great product and great company. I got this high chair for my 2nd baby. It converts to a little chair when it’s not needed to be a high chair anymore. It can also attach to a dining chair which is great for space saving. I’ve had the chair for over 2 years now. As you can see my son picked at the face, Chewed it and all that. Anyway I was dissatisfied because I wasn’t happy with how it looked but I kept on with it until it got to the point of the picture I posted. So I went to the manufacturer and told them about the problem and asked if they had any replacement parts I could buy. They emailed me back, asked for details and that was the last I heard from them when I sent the email back. Well today 6-8 days later I got a new replacement part sent to me for free. I love when a company listens and goes above and beyond. I’ve had this chair so long I was fully willing to pay for the part but they just made it happen. The chair is durable and easy to clean and it’s cute. I would buy this again and again.

source_doc: Cheap upgrade. I am fairly new to the sax and I bought one of the cheap Eastar $200 altos. I won't knock my Eastar, I LOVE that in 2023 there's such a thing as a $200 saxophone (didn't exist when I was a kid), but I COULD NOT hit those altissimo notes! Obviously I assumed it was because I was a beginner and I needed to practice my embouchure, and I could hit a very squeaky high F# maybe 30% of the time (the lowest altissimo note). It's been a couple months now and I was starting to get the feeling that the problem wasn't me, it was the hardware. I just got this Yamaha 4C in the mail today, plugged it onto my cheap sax, and hit a perfect high F# first try! I swapped back and forth between the mouthpieces and the Yamaha notes sound noticeably smoother and clearer.TLDR: If you've got a cheap sax then this is a cheap way to instantly improve your playing.

source_doc: My teeth squeak all the time now. My teeth squeak all the time now. Not in a cheesey mouse way or a "squeaky clean", but whenever I eat anything they start squeaking. It is the most uncomfortable thing ever and I only used two of the packets (one of the rapid ones and one of the normal) two weeks apart. Basically feels like the equivalent of nails going down a chalkboard but with your teeth.My teeth were never very sensitive and I would die for them to be super white so when I saw the deal on Black Friday, I HAD to cop. I was super excited to potentially see results, but after the two I used that obviously had no results, I was hoping that I could at least keep using them to try to get them to lift. However, for some reason a few days after my last strips I craved almonds. And that is when I first found out how teeth squeaking feel like. I thought I was going insane and looked it up and sure enough, almonds do make some people's teeth squeak. But it wouldn't stop after that. Just eating certain foods will make my teeth squeak and it made life a little more unenjoyable. Literally would have felt a little better if my teeth lifted a little bit. Thanks, Crest.

source_doc: Nice half cup size for baby and toddler food. I got these to have a set of same-sized containers for when I make baby food, and I really like the 1/2 cup size.  Currently I’m putting the food in various containers I have, and I am wanting to be more orderly.  I like that the lids are sunken in the middle so one container can sit on top of another without sliding off.  Because these are plastic, they are lightweight if I need to take them on a day trip.  I like the various colored lids for sorting fruits, veggies, and meats. I have also found that the screw lids are leakproof, which is necessary for traveling.  I will say that they are indeed plastic, not brittle thin but not super thick either, so I do not expect them to last forever.  If they get too close to the dishwasher heat element I suspect they would melt. These state that they are microwave safe but I would not do it.  I would purchase glass ones if you need to microwave.

source_doc: I use this for my dog and cats. This camera is decent for what I wanted it for. I actually got it so I can monitor my cats and dog, while they hangout, or play, on my fenced in porch. The camera isn't rated to be outdoors, but I have an overhang that keeps the camera dry, and then I just move it inside at night. Since setup is super easy, it's easy for me to move it back and forth as needed.If my animals had it their way, I would be hanging out on the porch with them the entire time, which I don't mind doing, but unfortunately, I have chores to get done. So, this camera gives me the ability to go back into my house and do a little work while they hangout. I can monitor what they are doing, and if they are misbehaving, I can call their names through the two way talk, and it's clear enough that it actually will stop them in their tracks. The picture quality isn't fantastic, but like I said, it's a decent monitoring camera for what I intended it for.

source_doc: Good inexpensive Shower Bench. This is not exactly what I wanted, but I needed a shower seat for the roommate immediately due to his recent leg surgery. The shower bench is very sturdy with two bolts in major stress points, is easy to assemble and comes with an extra parts— an extra of everything except the hex wrench.  It even has an extra plastic no-slip cap for the leg bottom.  I was truly impressed by this foresight since one of the grommets didn’t allow the machine screw to go all the way in; I swapped it with the spare and presto— assembled.  The bench doesn’t wobble or shake; it’s a steal for the price I paid.  I have no idea about longevity, but I plan to replace with a stone bench if/when I find one since I was looking for a stone bench that would allow me to use a steamer ia the shower prior to this immediate need.  I almost purchased a bench 2-3x the price; I’m glad that I chose this one.  I will update this review in the future if my opinion changes over time due to longevity issues, but keep in mind it’s low price.  See the pictures for size and the box it arrives in.

source_doc: Do not overtighten the bolts. I bought this about a year and a half ago based on the features and reviews.  I don't run a windshield on my cruiser, so my phone gets hit with direct wind when I ride.  I have gone 75+ mph with no trouble at all and no concern that my phone would come loose.  I do occasionally have to re-tighten the knob, which shouldn't happen but isn't a big deal.I only rated it 4 stars (debated about 3) because I had to remove it today and the aluminum mount snapped in half next to one of the bolts when I was attempting to reinstall it.  I didn't think I had cranked on it too hard, but maybe I have some of the blame.  I'm just glad it didn't break while I was riding.  I just bought another one, so that should say something about the quality.  I will be more careful not to overtighten the bolts when I install the new one and see what happens.

source_doc: Easy to use, feels professional. I must admit I was skeptical about buying this because of it's price! So many options to try now.. I like that!A more manual espresso machine may give you better taste or more crema...... Maybe.. I do not know and I do not plan to find out, manual is just too much work! I think this is a great combination of quality and ease of use.I'm saying goodbye to nesspreso.

source_doc: Works great for pets. I am using this item to secure my dog's car seat/booster seat. The lap belt of my rear seat hooks into her car seat. I liked that I could actually lock the belt nice and tight so in case of an accident, her seat would be as immobile as possible. This way, in an accident, I know the lap belt is locked, and I don't have to depend on seat belt locking itself.l Also, the lock mechanism for the belt release button is also handy in case I am in the back seat, wrangling groceries and packages, and accidentally hit the belt release buttons. This is a great invention, and I wish I would have found it when caring for my grandfather who had dementia. I can't tell you how many times I would slow down the car to park, and he would be releasing his seat belt and trying to get out of a still moving car. I did have a little trouble getting the belt locking clip on my seatbelt. (I have a 2018 or 2019 Buick Encore). I took a little trial and error, but after about 5 minutes, I locked it where I wanted it.

source_doc: This is a compact unit that will work with your existing ratchet wrench or breaker bar. This tool has a solid, compact storage case, and the unit will work with 1/4, 3//8, and a half inch drive.  The unit will display and work with numerous torque measurements and specifically inch-pounds and foot-pounds that I need. To test its functionality I loosened a wheel lug on the tractor.  I then connected the electronic torque tool to my existing click adjustable torque wrench.  I adjusted the electronic device to 83.5 foot-pounds and the click adjustable to 86 foot-pounds.  As I tightened the bolt, the electronic device began beeping at just under 80 pounds.  My initial thought was "this isn't good".  So I next set both to 86 foot-pounds.  The beeping began around 83 foot-pounds but I kept going.  At 86 foot-pounds I heard the click and the tone switched from beeping to solid simultaneously.  Great, I figured out the beep is "approaching" and solid means you're there.  I later went back to the manual and found a "note" explaining the beep means you're within 20% of the target.  So, I like the unit and the audible feedback.

source_doc: It worked great till it didn't. I have to say I don't have any complaints about this unit, except for the tire inflator. My first one I received wouldn't hold a charge and was sent back. The new one was perfect. I have had it for exactly 2 years. The only problem I ran into is that I have only used the inflator maybe 6 times. I pumped up a basket ball, my sons bike tires a few times, and my two front tires. Unfortunately in putting air into my tires it stopped (main reason for buying). I pumped one tire, let it rest, and started the other one. After about a minute, the compressor was running, but no air was going into the tire. It just stopped, not to sure what happened. This unit is still like brand new, and has been well kept. Everything else still works, and I can use it as an alternate power source. I am not happy that it doesn't inflate anymore, but I can still find uses for it as another power source. So there is that.

source_doc: Handiest thing you never knew you needed! Absolutely loved these clips! I bought them originally because those hanging toys made for the car seats always slipped everywhere on the baby’s car seat handle. Drove me nuts! I looked for these and they did not disappoint! I use them for everything! I probably could have gotten a smaller pack but it’s fine because I keep a set in everything: car, stroller, car seat, house….. my favorite thing to use this for is as a shade for my baby while he’s in the stroller. I would try and maneuver my head to block the sun but now I can just clip his Muslim blanket on the car seats handle and clip the other on the stroller handle and there you have it a shade that’s breathable and I’m the exactly place you need it. Can hand it off the side. Helps keep the blanket hooked over the car seat if it’s windy/dusty and it won’t move. Holds toys in place that can hang. I’ve used them before to clip a Muslim blanket to my shirt so I can nurse when I’ve forgotten my cover. So many things! They are durable and I have yet to break any.

source_doc: Pickleball is tough but fun.  This set is great for beginners learning how to play. I used to play tennis in high school, and I loved it.  Over the years I've not played tennis nearly as much as I wanted to given work and life schedules.  Pickleball is something that I had heard of a couple of years ago but never really looked into it.  Now, it's the newest sports fad, and this set from Deerfamy is one that I ordered to get me back into something that is like tennis.  This set comes with two lightweight pickleball rackets, two indoor court (orange) and two outdoor court (yellow) balls.  There's also a carrying case that everything fits into.After my first attempt at playing pickleball, I have to say it's a tougher sport than I thought.  If you're familiar with tennis, there's a LOT of fast-paced volleying.  That was the part of tennis that I hated and the main reason I stayed back on the baseline.  I'm not a net player, but pickleball sort of forces you into that.  The equipment from Deerfamy was good at helping me practice.  It's lightweight and had a nice grip on the handle.  I had control of the racket when swinging, so I can't blame the racket.  I'm just not good at pickleball.... yet! :)

source_doc: Fantastic , portable amp. This is my second positive grid amp, I also own the the bigger 40 watt version. This one is much smaller, easier to carry and just as easy to use as its bigger brother. I love that it has a built in battery and charges via usb C. I haven’t charged it in almost a month and it still holds a charge. Given, I don’t play very often. I would say about 2 hours a week. So I imagine you’d be charging it more often if you play a lot. It only has a couple of built in presets, so you must have a tablet or smartphone to get the best use out of it, but that isn’t a huge deal for me. I like it. I like being able to search an almost infinite library of tones that people have shared. You can also play music and jam along with the app. I love it! I can even Connect my wah or flanger pedal to this without a hitch. I don’t regret buying this. It’s perfect for home jam sessions. If I had to pick between this and it’s bigger brother I’d go with this one, just because of the built in battery and usb C port.
