source_doc: Screw holes not machined well and doesn't fit handlebars or steer tube perfectly. I bought two of these. The first one broke as I was installing it. One of the handlebar screws popped out as I was screwing it in and the threads in the hole completely just stripped out. So I got a refund and wanted to give the benefit doubt to the product so I ordered another. It lasted me roughly 9 months and as I was removing the stem to take my fork off, the bolt hole snapped and stripped out again. For the price it isn't bad. If you don't intend on ever taking the stem off and you carefully install it, I think it could be good. But I travel with my bike and this happened as I was traveling so it nearly ruined my trip. Luckily it was just one hole so I was able to make due with it temporarily but I will not be buying this stem again. Another weird thing about this stem is that it didn't fit my handlebars perfectly and there was a gap between the front plate and the stem. It also didn't fit onto my steer tube very well and it  took a lot of effort to remove/install.

source_doc: Love this grinder and the bag it comes with. I've been getting into whole bean coffee here recently and I wanted something that I could fine-tune better than an electric grinder so I got this.  It came packaged just fine and I didn't see any defects or dings on the grinder.  In the package, you get the grinder, a storage bag, and two cleaning brushes. It is basically 3 main pieces the handle which has a nice wood knob, the grinder which has all the guts, and the collection bin which catches your grounds.  I got a whole bean that I hadn't tried before and loaded it up and got to grinding.  It was really easy to grind although I set it for a bit too fine on my first go-round so unless you are old hat at manual grinding you will probably have to play around with it to find your preferred setting.  Cleaning it was a breeze too, it says not to get it wet so I took it most way apart (I left the grinder guts in) and took my electronic duster, and just blew it out. What I really like about this one compared to the others I have is it comes with a storage bag so I don't have to keep it in a big bulky box.  All in all, I do really like this and its matte black color looks great.

source_doc: Looks nice, seems to blunt sounds. I used these in my office to reduce sounds from coming out and disturbing others in my house while I am working or just watching videos. I hope this review is helpful.

source_doc: Very messy.  Needs a better applicator. This mascara went on really wet and clumpy.  I had to grab a cotton swab and use it multiple times to clean up around my lashes.  I feel like the applicator was partly to blame.  I couldn’t get good separation with this style of applicator.  The bristles weren’t very deep or thick.  Luckily, I had a spare applicator that I pulled out and used to clean up and separate my lashes.  Once I cleaned up the mess, my lashes were still a bit clumpy, but looked okay.  This mascara does add length to my lashes.Typically I need to reapply mascara at the end of my work day - and it smudges below my eyes.  With this mascara (if I applied it heavily), I had no smudging and I still had good coverage up to 12 hours after applying it.  If I apply the mascara lightly (in order to control the wet and clumping), it doesn’t make it through the day.  Heavier coverage lasts longer.  I did have flaking towards the end of the day.  It cleans up with soap and water well.

source_doc: Works very well. Works very well to track steps, calories, distance and work outs. Data is accurate and battery life is excellent. I wear it 24 hours and the sleep data has been very helpful. I also use the smart wake feature so an alarm doesn't wake my partner since I get up a couple hours before him. The smart wake sends vibrations which buzz the arm. It works surprisingly well. Even though there is a water lock to allow user to wear in shower or swimming, I have not tried it yet, but plan to. The sensors on the sides are easy to use for the EDA scan and heart rhythm scan. I would prefer to have the apps in a different order but that is just a personal thing. The only other issue I have had is the phone app occasionally acts up and won't allow me to sync data. It self resolves but can be annoying. I chalk it up to consequence of having so much tech these days.  I am glad I chose the 5 over the 4 version for the built in GPS & water lock capabilities. I also recommend getting the fitbit premium account if you are serious about getting your health better. It has additional insights and data analyses that you won't have access to without it. Overall extremely happy with the Fitbit 5 and I do recommend it.

source_doc: It works best for my neck and shoulders. I ordered this bath cushion realizing that the reviews were polar extremes. My tub is pretty uncomfortable so I thought I would give it a shot anyway. I took into consideration the review that said suction cups were necessary, so I put those on first. They were not as difficult to insert as I had anticipated. You just have to use two hands and pull one of the honeycomb openings apart, then using the thumb and finger on one of your hands insert it into the opening. I had no trouble doing it, but my mother with arthritis could never manage it.I first tried this on my lower back and it was comfortable but a little bulky. I know that my issue taking a bath is a scrunched neck so I slid the pillow up on the tub to my upper shoulders and lower neck and that gave me the support that I wanted and needed. While it is still a little more bulky than I I would have preferred, it really helps my neck. I'm pleased and glad I chose it.

source_doc: Who owns a Karaoke machine? This guy! (Woohoo's with glee!) I have always thought that I would never have any reason to own my own karaoke machine, but now that I do, I can tell you that I can find a reason to own one almost every week. It is a party machine. I would say that is the biggest valid reason to own your own karaoke machine. If you sing, and love to sing in front a crowd, but you still don't have a recording contract, then this machine allows you to increase your odds of landing a contract by increasing the volume of your voice. I mean, it can't hurt, can it? Sing loudly and sing proudly. This machine is well made and has not had a single problem since I received it 6 months ago. It has been to the beach and back it did well. It sounds good, it gets loud, and the two microphones that it comes with are a cinch to use. They are up and running in less than a minute after I power up the speaker. It comes with a smartphone holder so that you can display a song's lyrics as you sing. The speaker rolls on two wheels, and it has a pull-out handle like a rolling suitcase. I have had a lot of fun using this machine and I have had zero problems with it. If you are looking for a karaoke machine, this is a good choice.

source_doc: CRUSHED green fuzz algae! For months I tried everything. Everything in my low-tech freshwater tank seemed right. I had my light down to 3 hours a day. I stopped feeding for periods.  I even blocked out the sides of the tank to prevent ambient light from getting in.  Nothing worked.  The green fuzz algae was all over my plants and surfaces.  I cleaned, I did water changes, got an algae eater & snails. This was trial and error over months and nothing I tried showed any result. The green fuzz got so bad I had to cut down all my plants. Wish I had tried this product sooner.  I dosed just as the directions stated and within 1 week the green fuzz algae had been noticeably diminished.  It went from being bright green to a dull brown color.  Hoping this restores balance so I can begin fertilizing again so my plants will regrow. Amazing product!

I was about 5 feet from the console when using it, so there should be no reason for this. I actually have a second Xbox Series X in my living room, so I tried it there and experienced the same issue. I decided to exchange the controller and get a new one. Now that I have the second controller, this one has stick drift in the left thumb stick. I've tried every troubleshoot with Xbox support, but now they recommend that I send it to them for repair. I am just going to return it and go with a different option. Also, I did not play with the controller to cause the stick drift. I noticed it fresh out of the box, so it was not dropped or damaged and it is not dirty from use. It's literally brand new. Extremely disappointed, I wanted to really like this controller.

source_doc: Bought for dog chew toy. I have a Australian Cattle Dog AKA "Blue Healer" puppy we got a couple months ago. He will shred through any dollar store toy you give him in a matter of days and I had read another person's review with the same kind of dog that he gave his dog a broken Diaphragm and the dog has been chewing it for over 10 years so for $8 bucks I think it was when I bought it, I said what the heck.Got the thing in the mail and the first thing I noticed was that it gets stuck because of the shape of it if lands with the round part up instead of landing like a dish shape with the edge accessible so I cut it in half and gave half of it to my Father In Law for his dog. So far they both love them and even after ripping and shredding at it, my healer hasn't even scratched it now after weeks of use and seems to really like it I assume because it's similar feeling to flesh. Anyway for the price and what I bought it for it's a great deal. Not sure how it'd be for it's designated use since I have nothing to test it for in that regard but it is heavy duty so I would imagine it would work well for that as well.

source_doc: What is going on with these keyboards? My daughter got one of these keyboards for Christmas. The 1st keyboard we had types randomly into text boxes on the screen. Just random characters. It was freaking them out so I contacted the mfgr. They said that I should update the software. I downloaded the tool to do so, but it's all in Chinese (I assume)? I don't know which button is update and which button is identify but I poke around and figure it out. The SUCCESS/FAIL text box is also not in English so I don't know the status and the window doesn't close. Either way, nothing fixes it. The company sends out a new keyboard and this one turns off randomly while in use. Since this is a gaming keyboard, you KNOW that can't happen, or GAME OVER. They suggested I update the software, but we had already plugged in the old keyboard in the meantime. I finally get the chance to do that and now the thing is dead. Like dead dead. I plug it into another computer, still won't light up. Uninstall/Reinstall/Repair/Update software, hardware (in DevMgr), restart over and over and over...and nothing. Now it's just a brick. Guess we're stuck with the ghost keyboard. Side note: Customer service was responsive in their attempt to help, but they couldn't solve the problem. Ended up offering a $20 credit, but I didn't purchase it, so that didn't make sense. I just want something that works!

source_doc: Nice!! This is my first experience with a pet water fountain. At first I was unsure where the cord went because it didn't really show it with part in the water. But I figured it out. It's very sleek and looks perfect where I have if. Luckily there was an outlet where the animals eat anyhow. It's quiet and the little fountain goes along keeping the water fresh. I haven't caught our cats drinking it but my dog really drank! I did have to find a spare bathroom rug and I put the cat food bowl, dog food, and the fountain on it. I found my dog dripped water more than usually drinking from this fountain. One more thing, I used half cold water from our fridge dispenser and half from the faucet. I was very surprised that, about 5 hours later, the water still seemed pretty chilled, which is nice. It isn't stainless steel or anything so I am not sure how it maintained its temp but I am glad.I looked at several water fountains and landed on this especially because it had a viewing area to see the level of the water. Again, I am very impressed with this little machine!

source_doc: Like my 100W so much I might be upgrading my main tank. I actually got this to warm water change water, but I love the features so much I might get a 300W for my main tank.  Mostly I liked that they external reader tells the temperature of the tank which I wanted so I could tell when my water was ready for changing into the tank.  Now I wish I had that feature in my main tank.  I also like the peace of mind that there is an automatic shut off.  My son lost his whole tank to a shorted heater that cooked his fish.  I hope this will prevent that from happening to me.And the kicker is that I paid about the same for my heater without the temp readout.

source_doc: Not really that bright. I got these for my 2002 F350 SuperDuty.  I installed them and was excited as I was replacing my old incandescent bulbs that seemed very dim and yellow.  I read the description and was looking forward to the bright new fog lamps.  I put them in and waited for nighttime to come.  As I was driving I turned them on waiting for the great reveal and I didn't even know they were on.  I actually at first thought that they didn't come on at all.  I actually waited to pull behind a car where I could see the reflection and saw they were indeed on.  Unfortunately it really doesn't make a different.  I'll leave them in for now though they really seem more like driving lights than fog lights to help see the road.  I won't buy these again.

source_doc: Love the Zero Water concept; Filter Quality Control Is A Problem. Normally I try to be positive with my reviews of products, however with these replacement Zero Water filters it is a struggle. Love the 23 cup Zero Water I purchased. The  original Filter that came with the dispenser worked perfect. Came time to replace the filter, I purchased the 6 pack, (I was committed). First filter I tried I let set overnight to give it "a chance". Next morning, no filtered water, surprise, surprise. Opened a second filter and installed it. Fourteen hours later I had 8 cups of water. 2 for 2 bad. Too late smart, I looked on the web for other people having a similar experience. I found I was not alone, in fact I was one of many, many people experiencing quality issues with the Zero Water filters. Since I purchased them as a 6 box set, I have to return them as a set. I can't begin to tell you how disappointed I am with this whole experience. And by the way, they were original equipment manufacturer with the name proudly emblazoned on the side. Love/hate, you have to be ready for a measure of both with this product.

source_doc: A complete waste of time and money!! Do yourself a favor and look at other tankless rv units by OTHER manufacturers! The listing says that it will fit and opening but this is false! I originally purchased this to go in a travel trailer but it was entirely too small to fit in the opening. I never installed it but decided to hold on to it for my next RV. I recently purchased another RV and the existing water heater was shot so I got this unit out and placed it in the RV. The first time that I used it, it worked great!! I was pleased. The next morning when I tried to do dishes I kept getting an error code and the hot water would immediately shut down. When I very first turn the water on the sensor says that the water is 199 degrees so the unit thinks that the water is too hot. So, now I have to order and install a new temp sensor after using this unit 1 time! A ripoff. I can get no support or warranty repair because I purchased it 2 years ago even though it was kept in the box in new condition I have no support! A complete waste of time and $600.00.

source_doc: My cats love this bed! I just ordered 2 more! The bed arrived in great condition and was easy to fluff up. My cat immediately left her old bed and climbed into this one. I waited to write this review until I washed the bed, and I am glad I did. It came out great. I washed in in cold water and dried it on a medium heat. When I pulled it out of the drier it had fluffed up even more than when I first opened the bag on delivery. And you really can't beat the price. source_doc: Nice! Recommended. This product was not the brand I thought I ordered but it is the same style and string number and I like it very well. Looks like the above picture of Byla 27-string lyre harp with accessories. I could not tune the strings as noted above the tuning pegs because they got too tight toward the high end, but I added an F# after every F and that has worked out very nicely for me. I play hymns and have used the F# strings for several hymns that I would not otherwise be able to play. With the F#s added, it has been very easy to tune. It is a lovely instrument and has good sound. I used sharpie markers to color code my tuning pegs and strings. I tried several other lyre harps before this one, but this is the one I really like. Glad I bought it. Shipping took a bit longer, but the seller contacted me about that through Amazon and I was willing to wait for it.

source_doc: I wonder about the quality. The connector should work ok for lighter duty applications.  I dont think I would use it on a car or truck.  The contact surface at the base of the black knob is nowhere near the contact surface of the battery post connector, although it is about the same as where you would connect the cable.  the connector is two parts with just a plastic bushing/insulator between the two parts.  I was able to move the two parts some, but did not try and seperate them, but I think I could if i used more pressure.  The square headed bolt is too small to self hold as it is designed to, or the ridge designed to hold the flat side of the bolt is to far away.  The square head will spin and not hold against the flat side as you can see in the pictures.  The unit does appear to be brass or at least a brass alloy.  I did file a small amout off one edge and got the same color underneath.  The cable connector end has a short area with threads but I tried the clamp bolt in there and it fit but was a really sloppy fit.  When I install the switch I will most likely drill out those threads and just clamp the battery cable eyelet with a bolt and nut.

source_doc: I just wanted it to tell time with a red display. The first one I got was defective. It would not power on when plugged in. I returned it without issue and was sent a replacement. Second one was just fine. Simple to set time, I like that it has a red display. It isn’t too large but still able to see it from across the room. I purchased it so I could tell what the time was in the middle of the night without having to turn on a light or expose myself to blue light. I have a very difficult time sleeping and any other color display would be too stimulating and keep me from sleeping. I have to take medication at particular times during the night. I don’t use the alarm function but I do like that if I needed to, it has the ability to have a softer or louder alarm option. It also has a battery backup option. Simple, effective at telling time without being too bright or stimulating in the middle of the night. Bonus, my husband can see the time without looking at his phone and lighting up our bedroom. So nice not to have that happening anymore. Hopefully it lasts a long time.

source_doc: If you put together many items, this is a great addition to your toolbox. I throw out the "helpful" tools the manufacturer sends with their chair/table (whatever).  I have a drill with hex bits and this ratcheting wrench set - it shaves about half the time to put the item together, for real!  The last set I put together was a gliding outdoor chair that I love, but had I used the included items, I know putting the glider chair together would have taken me at least 4 hours to complete. Woo-hoo!  Thank you drill and ratcheting wrenches for that!  The heads included should help with most of the items you will encounter in household item builds and for me, that's enough!

source_doc: Good product for my dogs. First I want to start by saying that I tought this was CBD, I didn't know hemp is a bit different. I still don't fully get it. I give it to her daily in a higher dose than stated as she is most anxious and  has her bad eye. I am on the second bottle and just ordered more.

source_doc: Skeptical at first, but I will not play without them again! I had just seen these grips on social media when a friend who had a set  recommended I give them a try. Usually my hands get sweaty after about an hour or so, but that did not happen with c2 Gripz, even after three hours. I bought the mediums, and my hands fit perfectly around the contoured grooves. This helped separate my fingers and naturally placed my hand over the controller. The ridge at the bottom gave my fingers support and being above the controller also gave me better control.I have also noticed less strain on my hands after long gaming sessions. I have carpal tunnel, so sometimes I get flare ups during longer sessions, but I have noticed a big improvement with less strain on my hands and forearms since using C2 Gripz.I have been using them for almost two months, and I will never play without C2 Gripz again. Oh yeah! As a bonus, I like how the controller can stand on its own because of the base of the gripz. This is a perfect added feature for people who like to use their controller as a tv remote. I highly recommend this product 10/10.

source_doc: Had a horrific allergic reaction - swollen eyes, teary… Is this even FDA approved?? It reminded me of the slime my daughter used to make in elementary school (if not identical.) Some of those recipes use Borax, which is indeed toxic, so perhaps that is what I reacted to… It did a great job cleaning some used camera gear I was prepping to trade in though, I have to say… Next time though, I will look up a recipe for nontoxic slime instead.

source_doc: Woks well for fine, straight hair. This is one of the better hair masks that I've found at this price point for my super fine, straight hair. While I wouldn't say it makes a hugely dramatic impact, it's noticeably stronger than regular conditioner. It adds a bit of shine, detangles, and makes my hair more manageable overall. I really struggle with volume, so the fact that this smoothes without flattening is a huge win for me. I also like that I can see its benefits while sticking to my extremely basic hair care routine. I use my normal shampoo and conditioner beforehand and simply comb and air dry afterwards.It does work a bit slower than similar treatments I've used, so I always make sure to thoroughly saturate my hair and leave it on for at least 7 minutes. If I rinse it much sooner, I don't notice the full effects. A little goes a long way though. I start with a small glob to avoid wasting it and usually add a little extra to my ends, as they tend to dry out. It doesn't magically fix split ends, but they do seem to occur less often when I use this mask a few times a week. One tub lasts me several months that way. I think it's a good value overall and will continue purchasing it!

I do, however, know that this water bottle has not yet leaked on me. I like how the ml of water is labeled on the side. source_doc: I actually doubted I would like this but I do! I have neck problems and had surgery for scoliosis many years back. So I figured I might not like the pillow if I can't side sleep with my arm under it but so far I've been doing good with it.It is very comfortable to be on my back and also be comfortable on my shoulders. My shoulders seem to perfectly rest against the pillow and it has an ideal firmness about it that is comfortable for my neck and head to rest on. I still sometimes sleep with my arm underneath while I'm on my side. That's still pretty comfy but I'm trying to get myself to be mostly on my back 🤦‍♀️

source_doc: This little tool is fantastic! True confession: I have horrible calluses and cracked heels. They don't bother me during the summer but as soon as winter hints, I start hobbling around, wondering why I never deal with it. The reason that I haven't dealt with them is that using a pumice stone has always made it worse.I got this kit because I thought it might help. I was so afraid that it would do more harm than good, that I avoided even hoping the box. I just found my courage.It's a wonder tool! First of all, it weighs next to nothing. There are two separate roller heads. I think that the rougher one would be too much for my feet in the current state but the smoothe one is perfect. I used it gently and felt the skin before and after and it was so much smoother. I think that if I don't over do it but use it consistently, I might be able to get my feet in summer shape. I'll consider it my New Years' Resolution.

source_doc: Mind blown. These were easy to get setup. Fill water to the fill line then drop one of the tubes in and stick the sprayer in and twist tight until you hear it click. It's fun to watch the concentrate go in the water. Each one has its own scent and are for certain areas and materials. It suggests spraying the soiled areas and let them soak for 10 minutes. Then I take the color coordinated cloths that came with them and wipe up the mess. It literally works really well. So far I've used the kitchen one my countertop. I purposely left my cupcake mess from the night before and just cleaned it and I could not believe how easy it was to wipe off( and there was hard frosting on there). Then I used the glass and sprayed the mirrors. I've always used a foam and paper towels but I used the cloth and I seriously couldn't believe it. There were NO streaks and I didn't have to go back over the areas. The last one I used tonight was the shower. I didn't go all gung-ho on the shower but I sprayed it on some areas that get build up quite often and let it sit for a little bit. Again, I couldn't believe how easy the grossness comes off. Tomorrow I'm tackling the bathroom with a blacklight and will update with video!

source_doc: Works The Best Of Anything I've Ever Used. I have very calloused feet from wearing flipflops all the time.  My heels are always pretty rough. I have tried lots of methods to get my feet smooth, and I have to say, this glass foot file is amazing!  I used it at the end of my shower, when my skin had softened up.  I soaped up my foot, used the coarse side first, then finished up with the smoother side.  It made my feet really smooth, really quickly.  It works much better than my rechargeable rotary foot file.  I like that you don't have to charge it.  The one I had that you had to charge always seemed to be not sitting just right on the charger and then it wouldn't work when you went to use it.  It is a little big and bulky, but I just put it in the cabinet when I'm not planning on using it.  When I plan on using it, I put the stand right next to the tub on the floor.  The stand seems a little rickety, and I don't want it to tip over and scratch my tub.  The file is quite coarse on one side, and I'm afraid it would leave scratches.  This works the best of anything I have ever used to smooth my feet.  I highly recommend it.  It seems like it will last for a long time too.

source_doc: Worth every penny. I was skeptical that this would work as well as people have said but we had a small grease fire and I decided to give it a try since entering else had cleaned the stove very well. I had read it is best to smear it on and let it sit for a few minutes before scrubbing so I smeared it all over the stove and under the lid making it really thick in the bad areas. Almost everything wiped clean and I only needed a little elbow grease in a couple spots. Even the spots I had to scrub didn't need much effort. As you can see in the pictures that the stove is spotless! Next came the metal drip pan under the burner that caught fire. Included is a before and after picture. I did two rounds of smearing it on, letting it sit for about 5 minutes and scrubbing. As you can see it cleaned most of the burn off! I am amazed. Im sure if I continued a couple more times it would have removed the remainder (but honestly this was good enough for me as im going to cover it with foil anyway). I am amazed and highly recommend this for the tough jobs! Oh also, I didn't notice a strong offensive scent and I was elbows deep in this stuff.

source_doc: A game changer for hunting. I used to talk smack on hunting accessories like this, but now I am older and wiser and want to take ethical long distance shots more often that free hand. I haven't used this to reach way out and hit targets, but I did use it in a stand to take a fox this year. The shot was about 90 yards with a 17 WSM. Could I have done it free hand? Most likely. Was I more confident in my shot placing with this stick? You're darn right.It makes a little bit of noise when adjusting the height with the thumb button. I plan on doing a light disassembly and lubing up the spring inside. Either way, it barely makes any noise. It may scare a deer that's less that 15 yards out, but they normally don't get a chance to get that close to me, so it doesn't affect my hunt at all.I sit in a chair, I am 6'3" and the stick has plenty of adjustability to meet my needs. I have not tried adjusting it to full length to see if I can use it comfortably standing. When I have used it out walking, I just kneel and adjust the stick with the thumb button accordingly.If you are looking for a solid rest that packs down tight, this should fit your needs.

source_doc: Great for Gross Garden Feet! I take baths instead of showers, and I just never cared for bath mats. But when I saw this one is machine washable and has the foot massage nubs and rectangular soft nubby foot-cleaning area, I decided to get it. I work out in the garden a lot, sometimes in clogs that get red-clay muddy (along with my feet!) and sometimes barefooted (even worse), and I can't believe how easy it is to just run a little water into the tub, sit on the side, and scrub/clean/massage my feet. I don't even have to take my clothes off. Easy to drain and rinse off with a sprayer, and then I can fill the tub with water and epsom salts for a nice soothing soak. I even enjoy the feel of the nubs on my butt! LOL! It remains to be seen if this will stain from red clay over time and not come clean, but I don't care about that. I'm the only one who has to look at it.Be sure to follow the directions for flattening it and sticking it down. I put mine on the bathroom floor with a bottle of vinegar on top of the most-curled end for a day or so before using. If you have a smooth floor, you could even use it as a floor mat in front of your toilet so you can massage your feet every time you have to go.

source_doc: SMELLS SO BAD, that’s the only flaw. I bought this car seat because after getting in an accident, I realized I wanted the most safe infant car seat I could find, rather than my previous cheap one with very little padding, that easily pops out of the base. So I got this MaxiCosi after talking with several friends about their favorite brands, and I love everything about it EXCEPT the smell, oh my gosh it is so strong smelling of chemicals, almost a burning plastic type smell, and it makes my baby and her clothes stink so much I bathe her and wash the clothes first thing when we get home. I’m grateful for the extra padding, and that it’s still in a great price range (on the higher end though), but please be aware even after washing & then soaking the car seat fabric parts in borax, it will still be overwhelmingly strong. I also used my Bissell fabric cleaning machine and it still smells… just an FYI, maybe not all of them are like that and I got a defective one, I’m not sure, but if I didn’t absolutely need to have a good car seat in my car right now, I would return it.

source_doc: Skunk odor shampoo. This product did not work. It was night of course when my dog got sprayed by a skunk. I did not have this shampoo,  so I did a quick Google search on how to remove the skunk smell. It was recommend to use peroxide,  baking soda and a drop of dish soap. I left my dog outside,  and grabbed a bucket. I quickly mixed solution in a bucket and grabbed a rag. I gave my dog a sponge bath outside with this solution. I left it on for about 15 minutes and  then brought her inside to shower to rinse off. I applied some conditioner,  then gave her another good rinse. It really worked well. I could barely smell any odor. I then ordered this shampoo. I received it 2 days later. I gave my dog a bath again using the shampoo straight from the bottle on dry coat, I then added water and began lathering it up well. I let it sit on for 10-15 minutes. She now smells like a skunk again,  I was very disappointed,  I am returning the shampoo,  waste of time and money.

source_doc: Not Worth Purchasing. I am a 52 year old hobby drummer and am not a rough player. I figured these would be cheap but thought that with my easy playing they would be good enough to last a year and save the $20-$25 for Vic Firth Rute's or Promark Hot Rods. I sent these back after playing with them 3x. The first time I used them I noticed after about 10 minutes that the rods started coming out. I would push them back down but then they were uneven. Play a little more and push them down. It only became worse with each time playing so I sent them back.The rods themselves seemed just as durable as the more expensive ones but I will never know for sure since I returned them. All they have to do is put some glue in the end piece before putting it on and the rods would stay in place. I have had a pair of VF Rute 606's for over a year and they are still going strong. The rods have never moved and they show only a little wear. The ends are spreading out some but it just makes them quieter. I guess there is a reason they cost more and I will not mess with the cheap one's in the future. Save your time and money, unless you want to mess around fixing these yourself.

source_doc: Great for reptile enclosure!! I got this lock for a 4x2x2 Dubia reptile enclosure for my Uromastyx. She does a lot of window surfing and I wanted to be sure she couldn't slide it open and get out. I also wanted peace of mind to prevent me from leaving the enclosure open. It was very simple to install. My husband screwed it on for me while I held it in place. Probably don't even need two people to do it. I just wanted to make sure it was exactly where I wanted it placed. It comes when two keys. We just leave the keys in it at all times. We don't have children in the home so don't need to worry about that. The price is great. I had seen some locks that were cheaper, but went with this one because I read a review stating it was longer. I keep it all the way to the last locking point. So even if the enclosure gets opened, my Uro can't get out. I have made a routine so that once I finish spot cleaning or feeding, I put the lock back on ASAP. So no more being at work suddenly wondering did I close it all the way. I would get this again. If I get another Uromastyx I will get this lock.

source_doc: I don’t think this product was tested. My Indie is drinking gallons of water in her old age so I ordered the 4 gallon size to keep up. Chewy had one cheaper but I liked the idea of filtered water for my dog. At first fill I did notice the water bowl wasn’t really filling with water well. My dog would drink and it would not refill the bowl. So I took the filter out which helped…. But wait I paid more for this bc I wanted the filter! I had accidentally ordered two of these so I had given one to a friend for his houseful of furry paw friends so I called him to see if he had the same issue. He said he did until he modified the holes to be larger so the water could flow better. So, as suggested I drilled more holes to increase the water flow. It worked, I guess. But the water never fills past about 1/2 inch and my indie prefers a deeper bowl. I don’t think this product was tested before production. I might return it but unlikely they’ll give me a refund since I’ve now added 5 more holes to it!

source_doc: Very useful and best of all, small and light. Talk about timing, this battery came just in time for when I was due in a VR meeting and I forgot to charge the headset.  The battery fastens very easily to the side of the headstrap, but I wonder how long the battery strap will last.  I pulled it tight to prevent sagging, and it seemed like I might stretch out the strap holes and eventually it might break apart.  Aside from that, the battery worked perfectly.  I was in VR for two hours using this battery, but I will say that I think it charged my HMD very slowly.  I didn't think to look at the battery status until it had 94%, and it seemed like it took forever to get to 100%.  Then again, I was using it at the same time so maybe that's normal.This battery is light and small, much unlike the 3rd party batteries that I used to have to wear for the Quest 1.  I would highly recommend this battery to anyone who needs one for their headset.

source_doc: Comfortable. I am not a woman of color and have very fine hair, but I do have issues with keeping my hair out of the way at night. I usually put it in a topknot when I go to sleep so I don't roll over and pull it. That has a couple issues - the hair band slipping and sleeping with a hard bump under my head, and putting ponytail ridges in my hair. I also thought I'd get this for my daughter who has long, curly, thick, red hair that is often dry and frizzy. I had heard that bonnets help keep your hair moisturized so I thought between us we'd give it a try.The bonnet is comfortable and the band is not constricting. It is easy to put on. Maybe because my hair is so fine it didn't stay on all night, but it seems that it was on most of the night. (when I woke up in the middle of the night it was still on). My hair feels soft and not dry, so I'll try it again. I couldn't get my teen daughter to try it, though I think it would be helpful for her hair and I'll keep trying. My other daughter tried it and she recommends it highly for keeping the cat from chewing on her hair every night!

source_doc: It works fast!! Awesome product. My dog had these raw dark splotches in the creases by her legs. She was constantly licking. It was driving me crazy, plus making her miserable! I already had her on allergy supplements,  so I tried mixing organic coconut oil in her dry food. And putting pure aloe gel on those areas. All she did was want to lick it off(aloe is non-toxic but still). I also started bathing her weekly myself with an antifungal shampoo. But I think it's because of having the heat on, and blankets and the creases are where she sweats(I assume). Or air doesn't get to that area enough. I ordered this stuff as a last resort before a costly vet bill, and I was floored. Not only does it smell great, immediately after spraying those areas, I could tell she felt immediate relief!! She has never once even tried to lick the area. She doesnt like me fussing over her, but when I go to spray her, she pulls her leg back so I can get to it better!! lol which tells me she knows it is helping. I've only used it for 3 days. One side has cleared about 70%, the other about 50%. She is no longer miserable, she's back to playing. And I'm only on day 3 twice a day. Pretty amazing. I'm so thankful that I found this, I immediately just ordered more. Game changer!!!

source_doc: This thing went on so incredibly easy. I never leave reviews but I need EVERYONE to know how easily and beautifully this screen protector went on my Switch OLED. When smart phones and screen protectors first came out, it was like doing surgery to handle them and get them on correctly, and maybe, maybe after three tries you got it right.I am no expert, so when I got my Switch today, the absolute last thing I wanted to do was put the screen protector on. I’ve had the people at the store do them for my phones, because I just worry I’m going to get bubbles or dust under it.But this went on like butter. I used the wet wipe and then the dry and then peeled off the first step layer and I was careful in positioning it (having a case on helped) and then all I did was drop it down gently and it smoothed itself out, and then I pressed gently with my finger to make sure. After peeling the second layer off, it was PERFECT. No bubbles. No dust. I did it on a whim because you can’t let the screen protector see your fear — and I cannot be more amazed at how utterly effortlessly it went on.Plus, you get three for this price and should something ever happen to it, I have backups. source_doc: Maiden voyage success. I was looking for an affordable sleep system that didn't frustrate me like the perpetual tangled mess I was in my mummy bag but that would still be cozy and warm. I'm a toss-n-turn sleeper from side to tummy to side and mummy bags are too tight around the legs and don't let you roll over. I tried this for the first time tent camping at Valley of Fire in late December and it worked out great. Temps were in the mid-'30s to low '40s and I was plenty warm with this and my r4 sleeping pad. I did pull it up over my head for added warmth during the night when it got windy. (I'm 5'7", 155 lbs) It has slick fabric on both sides so that was the only minor drawback. It slipped off my body when I rolled over but I was wearing silky long johns so I will revisit my sleep clothes for future trips. I swapped the compression sack it came with for one that has four straps and was able to decrease the packable size. I didn't wear it as a poncho this trip but I'm heading to the Grand Canyon in late Feb so I may use it to hang around camp.

source_doc: Capstar. I have 6 cats and they all came down with fleas. Considering they are all indoor cats and I live in a building they have no option to escape. Either way, we have fleas! 2 of my boys recently went to the vets. I think that's where they picked up a flea or 2. I didn't realize it until this week. That's when I went into action. 3 of my cats are semi feral and I have no ability to put drops on them. So I opted for an oral flea killer. I just gave them a dose tonight. Unfortunately I opted for a food that is heavily gravied,  next time it will be a pate. I used a pill crusher to mask the pill. I think that one of them did not get a full dose. He ateat least 85% of his dose. What he didn't finish the rest of his food his sister did, she has fleas too. Now, I'm just waiting to find dead fleas. My adults get drops tomorrow so I'm not worried about them. It's almost bedtime so I don't want to find fleas jumping off the cats and onto me! Bad enough I had 1 bite me inside my eye muscle. I guess my eye got in the way of its jump. LOL

source_doc: Not a lot of head pressure. I use this to pump diesel out of canisters into my car. I was hoping that I would be able to place the canisters on the ground and simply pump into the car, which is not very far up. I have been using a siphon, and I wanted a setup that was a little cleaner. To make sure that I had maximum power coming from D cell batteries, I also ordered a set of rechargeable lithium d cells to go with this. The pump does work, but don't have any high expectations for flow rates. If I have the container on the ground and I am filling to a fuel cap near my waist, the flow rate at max is barely more than a trickle. However, lifting the source canister up two or three feet brought the flow to a satisfactory level. Ultimately, I decided to place the canisters on the roof of the car, as I had done with the siphon. That works very well but if the pump falls out of the canister, it can be a bit messy, which is what I was trying to avoid. It is a very slick product, but needs a larger pump or more power.

source_doc: Soooo much easier than I thought. My slider was in such bad shape it took Rocky to open it. I didn’t want to pay megabucks for a repair man so I decided to try myself. I am a 56 yr woman but I am handy. I did need help getting the door on and off because it is heavy. You lift and pull out from the bottom. Now that’s the hardest part! With my particular door I only needed to take out 2 screws on each side and the rollers removed in a slot next to the screws. Replace the rollers and screws that’s it. One of the screws gives you the ability to raise and lower door. I wish I had done this a year ago. I can not tell you about how long this item will last but I can tell you I can open my door with 1 finger now. Hint.. when putting the door back on be sure the rollers are level with the door, not sticking out.The product itself seemed flimsy to me. Not as solid as I thought but it was I believe $20 and works great. Now If I need to replace it soon I won’t cry over my $20If your a newbee like me. Just do it.

source_doc: I would buy it again if needed. I couldn’t find the spring isolators for a decent price so I bought this kit. I figured if the springs were junk like everyone said I would still be money ahead buying this kit and a set of springs. Great news, the kit was great. Springs are a good ride height and everything went in easy. I don’t know why this product had such mixed reviews. Install took about 2 hours with good tools. Extending the axle enough to put the new spring in was expectedly tough because I couldn’t find my spring compressor but I was able to use a small bottle Jack to get the axle separation I needed. If I buy another sequoia I will buy this air spring delete instead of working on the air suspension every 6 months.

source_doc: Excellent USB Hub. I work in IT and needed to get rid of all the USB adapters I carry for one dependable/portable hub. I think I found that hub. This hub is made of metal is looks very durable. Looks to have good ventilation but it is a little on the big size for me. I guess it has to be with everything it does. I connected it to my Surface Pro 7 and away I went. No drivers needed which is very important to me. I tested the VGA port, Micro SD port, USB 3.0 ports, and the ethernet port and all worked flawlessly. I tried to connect my USC-C thunderbolt docking station to the 100w PD port, but power didn’t pass through. I’m not saying it didn’t work, it just didn’t work with what I had. I could buy a 100w USB-C charger if needed but this hub passed my tests for the ports I really needed. Now, I would be willing to trade the VGA port for a serial port. I guess I have to keep carrying my USB to Serial adapter. All in all, this hub rocks.

It is a little on the pale side, but i honestly could mix this with a darker shade of foundation and I think I'd be just fine. I was pleasantly surprised at the coverage and the overall ease of application. I literally just rubbed it on like I would sunscreen and i did not need to do anything else. If I took the time to apply it, I think it would look even nicer and I would be even happier. This is definitely a brand I personally would be interested in seeing what other products they have, because I was immediately impressed with this, and I usually can not say that when trying new products. I am extremely happy with this, and definitely will be ordering more when this bottle is gone. Took a photo of the color it is, as that was a question I had  before ordering. Hope it helps.

source_doc: Better than expected. I used this as a junction box on my utility trailer. My trailer doesn't have brakes so I didn't need all the lugs but I wanted a box like this to use in wiring the trailer and didn't find anything like it for a four wire setup so I went ahead and got this one and I'm glad I did. I did add a rubber gasket and I sealed around the wires with silicone RTV where I brought them into the wiring box through the rubber plugs that came with the box.The box itself is pretty stout but the strain relief clamps on the ends of the box could definitely stand some beefing up. It would be a better product if the side enty ports also had strain reliefs.In spite of its shortcomings, I like this box well enough that I bought another one which I intend to use when I rewire another trailer of mine next summer.

source_doc: Back to basic, it’s what works! Who ever said newer and more technical is better was wrong. When I had my daughter 20 years ago we used the basic bulb sucker at home but this style in the hospital where I worked as a nursing student. I had my second child this year and saw that nasal aspirators had advanced, they’re electric with lights and sounds now. I of course got one immediately but when my baby got his first stuffy nose I came to realize they don’t offer very much suction and it was more work than it was worth. I tried a few others before going back to the basics. I remembered the one at the hospital working better than my bulb sucker so when I saw this I decided to try one more. This nasal aspirator works great! It has wonderful suction and I like that you control just how much. There aren’t a ton of parts that need cleaned afterward and nothing has to be done before using it in the middle of the night with a scared crying baby. You can tell it’s made with quality material and the little etching of the bunny is a cute addition. I’m very happy with this purchase and relieved I have a way of helping my baby breathe easier.

source_doc: Teachers, this is a game changer for your students. I am a professional cellist and teacher. I had the mother of my 6 year old student order this for our little cellist. I have not been impressed with other products in the past, but this looked like it was worth a shot. It's much easier to assemble and lighter than a similar animal themed product- hint, hint. Despite the bulk, it was comfortable in my hand and in her tiny hand. You can pop it on and off with ease. I will never use the beginner thumb on the ferrule bow hold again. I will forever start my students with this gadget. In her 30 minute lesson she graduated to a "real" bow hold with and without the grip aid. I could see the instant change from her fingers to her elbow and shoulder positioning. Hallelujah!! I am ordering one or two for my studio. I think it will be a wonderful aid for my experienced students struggling with bad habits they developed before getting into private lessons. If I was still teaching orchestra in the public schools I would purchase a classroom set. I will definitely be recommending this to my Youth Orchestra cellists.

source_doc: Best Wipers I Ever Owned. My 2004 Toyota Avalon XLS had squeaky wiper since the day I bought it. Car is in excellent condition and I replaced the wipers originally with something like Bosch. They still dragged and squeaked horribly. I thought perhaps the motor was bad so I replaced the wiper motor, still squeaked. I bought another "Silicone" type wiper blade and they squeaked. I though maybe my wiper linkage was bad so I replaced the entire mechanical arms. Still squeaked. I lived with this for about 2 years and driving to work in the rain one morning, my wipers were squeaking when I noticed that about 8 inches of the passenger wiper blade peeled off from the frame. The wipers instantly stopped squeaking. Crazy.I ordered the "Rain-X 830124 Silicone Endura Wiper Blades", which is a bit misleading because it is only one blade. I assumed there were two since the cost was enough for two, but it was only one. I ordered the other blade as well and these things are buttery smooth, no squeaking at last!Highly recommended.

source_doc: FINALLY - no more tangled hair or itchy scalp. Name a shampoo and I have probably tried it over the years.  My hair is thin and wavy, so it tangles very easily. I want to try the Viori conditioner next!

source_doc: Works for Me But Hard to Inflate. I got this for my small older dog. He sleeps on the bed with me but sometimes he gets up and moves around on the bed and once he fell off the bed onto the hard floor. I got this bumper so that when he moves around, he won't fall off the bed. I found the directions to inflate it a bit difficult to follow since there is minimal directions. It took me a few tries to get it all set up correctly to inflate but once I did, it worked. It stays inflated on the bed. I like the little carry bag that is include in case I would need to take it with me but I don't know if I could get it all packed neatly back into the bag. I have not tried to deflate this once I got it inflated. The plastic flaps that are supposed to fit under the mattress were too short for my bed so I wasn't able to secure it that way. I put it under my fitted sheet and so far it has stayed in place. My dog walked over to the side of the bed where I have it installed and he was under the covers but once he go to the bumper, he turned around and walked away from that side so I hope this will work for him to keep him safe on the bed.

source_doc: Does not stay on well. I need to preface this review by saying that I am new to doing my nails at home. I have always been a nail biter and picker. So, before spending money on going to a salon and have my nails professionally done only to tear them up, I thought I would try it at home. I used this gel in particular to attach nail extensions to my natural nails. I then used a dip powder to polish them. During the entire process three nails came off very easily. I simply figured I had not used enough of the gel and replaced the nails using more gel. However, once all was said and done, and I was finished with the manicure, the nails still popped off quite easily. So in my very unexperienced opinion, this gel does not seem to stay on your natural nails very well. I still gave it three stars because it could entirely be user error on my part.

source_doc: So far, So good  a tip. NORMAL temps can range for different people, different ages.  I'm concerned more with how HIGH my goes.

source_doc: 5 stars isn’t enough! I have a 1968 Yamaha F230 12 string that I bought brand new and the strings have over time raised up off the neck and made it very difficult to play. Now I plan to take it to a luthier to get it worked on but in the mean time wanted to pick up something cheap. So I took a chance on this Tario. I figured if this was junk it would make a beautiful wall hanger, and it is beautiful. The strings that came with it were junk so I put a set of Elixirs on it. This guitar has exceeded my expectations 10 fold. It plays beautifully and sounds fantastic. I had a buddy play it who owns a Goodall and he looked at me with a smile and said this thing is great. If I could have given it ten stars I would have. I try to stay away from buying things made in china but I have to admit this thing is worth ten times what I paid for it. I then bought a Gator hard shell case for it.

source_doc: Serious Stomach/Gas Issues. I purchased my bulk unflavored canister directly from the Armra website about 4 weeks ago. I agree with the commenters who find the taste of the unflavored product similar to powdered milk - I thought it was fine.  I was pleased enough with the sleep improvements to want to continue using the product, but I developed serious stomach pain and gas issues on my left side in the area of the pancreas. The pain was severe enough across several days to consider going to the doctor but I finally remembered I had started this new product and I stopped taking it during week 3. Fortunately the pain and gas eased within 24 hours and was gone in 3 days. I rarely react to foods and supplements so this was unexpected. I checked the ratings here and see a small but notable group of users reporting similar gastrointestinal issues. I don’t know why some of us have such a significant reaction but it is something to be aware of.

I had to sand the handle a bit because of some sharp bits and it arrived busted out of the box since the box the shipper chose was way too big for this item and it knocked around during transit.  That said it did not sustain any damage in transit. It was bubble wrapped well.  It has a few miner scuffs and chipped paint but I don't care about any of that stuff just mentioning it for the people who are concerned.  I made an awesome choice.

source_doc: Fantastic beginners microphone. I purchase this microphone to make videos for my YouTube channel. The reason I went with the ATR is because it is a dynamic microphone. Apparently, this type of microphone is very good at isolating only your voice, and not picking up background noises. Since I am making these videos in a non-soundproofed room, it only made sense to get this microphone. There are newer, looking and cooler looking microphones if you’re a neophyte like me and it would’ve been easy to choose them however, I am very happy with the choice I made.I wish I purchased the boom package as well as I now recognize that the boom makes it so that there are no extraneous sounds making it into the recording. Tapping noises, if close enough to the microphone will unfortunately make it into the recording. So now, I am looking for a boom.Are use this microphone with my iPad Pro 2021 and also with an OWC thunderbolt hub. It works well. I did not choose to go down the XLR option but instead I am using the USB-C option. I highly recommend this microphone.I also purchased a wind blocking cover for the microphone head it seems to be helping.

source_doc: Please don’t try and use these for more than a few months. These have been great, I got a set , then had a another set gifted to us for our daughter less than a year ago. It isn’t the only way I wash these utensils, it’s 50/50 with hand washing but something is not ok. Please ONLY use these short term. I thought I was doing something good getting a recycled item but I feel like I screwed up getting these.

source_doc: Didn't think I needed it until I got it ... I have an organization problem.  No matter what I try, I always seem to lose track of things, only to discover them weeks/months later.  This happens with small things mostly -- things that have a tendency to disappear behind other things.I use processed American cheese for grilled cheese sandwiches mostly -- it melts better than anything else and tastes great (I grew up on it, so ... ).  I especially like the individually wrapped variety as it stays fresher longer.  That is, until I lose track of the last few slices in a package and find it months later as part of an unintended science project in the back of the fridge.Enter this little box.  And that's all it is, really -- a cute box made to fit exactly the individually-wrapped slices of cheese.  I simply put the slices in the box, the box in the door of the fridge, and I know exactly where it is.  No more errant slices hiding in the far corners of the fridge.It's sturdy, well made, nice hinge, and a slight "snap" to the lid so it doesn't come open until I want it to.Just about perfect, really.  Glad I purchased it!  Solid 5 stars: it does what it's supposed to do, does it well, and has proven to be of benefit in helping me stay organized.

source_doc: Reliable, versatile and an extra 9 string... Decades ago I had to re-learn a new playing style due to a slight HAND-icap. I have found that hybrid sets work best for me. In this time, I have tried many brands, materials and gauges, and still, I keep falling back to Rotosound Nickel Hybrid Electric Guitar String sets (9 11 16 26 36 46). I have a couple fallback brands that are very good...but this is where I land these days. As long as I keep them Clean, they're bright, they maintain their tone over time, and stay in tune. (and you get an extra high E string)To clarify, I'm not a guitar or string snob and I'm not rich, but maybe I may have experience that might be useful to others. That said, my baseline for strings is that <I use the strings I can afford and that get the job done.>I don't have expensive guitars but I have had several for 20 years or longer...and I know how to adjust the neck, string height, properly install the strings on the posts and make sure there's no hang-ups in the nut, yatta yatta. In short, with as much bending and hammering strings I do they, for the most part, stay in tune.

source_doc: Great replacement and easy to install - All tools were included. I've had my Aeron chair for nearly ten years. I picked it up used to replace my crappy old chair from one of the big box stores when it finally gave up the ghost. So recently I heard a "crack" and saw that the back frame of the seat had finally worn down and broken.I was beside myself. I didn't want to buy another chair, so I looked for repair shops in the area. One of the shops referred me direct to this product page and said, "order this, and if you want, I can install it." So I did.Fast forward and, still sitting on the broken seat, busy with work, I decided to look up what the repair entailed. I found a tutorial on youtube. Four bolts for the seat. Two nuts to transfer the j-bars. I figured I could handle it.This replacement seat kit came with the hex wrench needed to undo the seat, and a fitted wrench and a T25 torx driver to quickly transfer the j-bar. It took a few minutes, and a bit of leaning in because the bolts were really in there, but the replacement was easy. I literally didn't take out my toolbox because I had everything I needed in the kit.Really well designed chair and replacement was super easy. Five stars.

source_doc: i love these diapers but they’re not perfect. i love these diapers but i can’t give them 5 stars. my baby turned 4 months old today and i just finished my first box of 68 size 3 diapers… they fit her but they’re on the verge of being to small, to the point of me being unsure wether or not i should order a size up on our next box. I had to buy a pack of pampers in the mean time and noticed a significant size difference between pampers size 3 and these size 3s, i think it’s safe to say these run small. These are also the first diapers my baby has managed to pee through and have a “blow out” with but it may just be because they’re on the smaller size. i’ll have to see how the size 4 does for her. i will continue to buy these diapers though bc they’re so stinkin cute, after 2 boys, i ended up having a surprise pregnancy that has given me a baby girl & im fully enjoying all things girly.. including these slightly overpriced, not the best functioning, but ridiculously cute diapers! i love the girly bright prints, they’re so much prettier than any of the others i’ve come across! I did try Hello Bello diapers and they’re a definite no, they’re cute but way worse on the absorbency, her skin would be visibly wet when i’d change her diaper with those!
